title: Founding Engineer
description:
Founding Engineer at Ref

The Problem

Resumes are rapidly becoming obsolete. AI-enhanced applications are flooding hiring pipelines, making it impossible for companies to identify truly qualified candidates among thousands of submissions. Meanwhile, professionals struggle to showcase their full potential beyond a static resume. The hiring sector remains tethered to this outdated system, and even AI solutions are hitting a ceiling on what they can achieve with limited resume data. It's time for a new approach to hiring.

About Ref

Ref is an AI-Native hiring platform designed to address the challenges faced by hiring teams AND candidates in today's AI-enhanced application landscape.

For hiring teams we provide advanced predictive talent and hiring tools that tackle their most pressing hiring needs. Our platform streamlines the candidate screening process, transforming it into an efficient, data-driven operation that significantly reduces time-to-hire while improving the quality of matches.

Complementing our company-focused tools, we're developing a comprehensive professional history platform for job seekers. This includes creating persistent profiles validated by references, with detailed professional histories, and integrations with platforms like GitHub, design portfolios, and other sources that provide insight into a professional's history. This approach will furnish hiring teams with a substantially richer dataset to analyze, offering deeper insights into candidates' skills, experiences, and potential fit beyond what traditional resumes can provide and automate the painful process of custom resume tailoring for every application.

By connecting what companies need to know with what candidates can meaningfully showcase, Ref is building a more transparent, efficient, and effective hiring landscape. Our goal is to facilitate optimal connections between talent and opportunities, benefiting both hiring teams and job seekers in the process.

Our Traction

We have developed a fully operational AI candidate screening platform that is currently being used by a major tech company with a global presence. Our product has moved well beyond the MVP stage and is actively streamlining hiring processes in a real-world, enterprise environment. Building on this success, we are rapidly expanding our functionality to include AI-native assisted interview preparation, a sophisticated candidate outreach CRM, and intelligent new hire onboarding tools. Our stack leverages AI and cloud technologies, including Python, FastAPI, Postgres, AWS, LlamaIndex, React, Anthropic and integrations with leading AI inference providers.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a curious, committed, and hacker-minded engineer to join the team and assist our development efforts. You'd work on the development of our core products, potentially impacting both the company and professional sides of our platform. As an early team member you would be ready to wear any hat that is needed. You:

  • Have a hacker mindset: You're an excellent coder, love to tinker, and are a generalist who can build an end-to-end tool. You're a nerd who we could go win hackathons with. We prefer a skillset founded in Python.
  • Are familiar and involved with the latest transformer models: LLMs, Vector Databases, Agentic Functionality, RAG, LLM Frameworks, etc. are things you have been diving into.
  • Have relevant experience: We're not going to put a number on the years of experience you have. Have you worked at a startup before? Do you regularly engage with domain experts? Are you a regular contributor to an open source community? We want to set you up for success to lead a huge initiative, so you tell us what you've done that shows off that you can do this.
  • Are empathetic: We love hackers but we also love people and we consider empathy to be #1. Can you build while being mindful about the larger needs of the company? Do you believe in user feedback and talking to customers directly? Do your instincts drive you to solve for problems, instead of building features? Can you pull excellence from your team and care about their professional growth?

Skills/Experience: Advanced Python programming, AWS services, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Instructor, vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, Pgvector, Weaviate, Vespa), Postgres, Redis, database design and query optimization, Machine Learning and NLP techniques, API development and management, Git for version control, CI/CD pipeline experience, automated testing, implementation of security best practices, building scalable and fault-tolerant architectures. Experience with React for front-end development is a plus.

Our core goal is to continue enhancing our product and expanding its capabilities. This role will:

  • Further develop and refine our AI candidate screening platform.
  • Contribute to new features such as AI-assisted interview prep, candidate outreach CRM, and new hire onboarding tools.
  • Help define Ref's technical vision, tech stack, and roadmap.
  • Work directly with the founders and team to talk to customers, review feedback, scope the product, and define quick iterations.
  • Work with the team to rapidly address any bugs or outages.

This job is fully remote, with a preference for San Francisco/Seattle but that is in no way a requirement.

Ref is currently bootstrapped, and our strong preference is for this role to be equity-only until our first round of funding is complete, likely in Spring 2025 after securing multiple enterprise customers. We believe this arrangement allows you to fully benefit from the potential upside of our venture. We are intentionally avoiding funding to maximize our leverage at our raise. We can consider offering compensation in lieu of equity, but it's important to note that the role would be significantly different as a hired developer versus a founding engineer with an equity stake. There is a huge opportunity to join the team early, shape the company's future, and learn cutting-edge technologies that will advance your career. We believe in everyone sharing in our success, and joining as an equity partner demonstrates a shared commitment to our vision. It's a personal decision to join a very early-stage startup, one that requires unique life circumstances given the lack of compensation and we recognize that. These are the trenches of early startup life: high risk, but potentially high reward. This is enterprise plus startup, it is ambitious! We're looking for those who are excited by this challenge and ready to grow with us.

Not sure if you're a fit? Feel free to apply anyway! We are looking for exceptional talent:

  • Have a different skill set but love the concept and want to see if there's a fit.
  • Don't have AI experience but you're a hacker who's passionate about learning.
  • Can't commit to a role full-time because you work at a top org but would love to work with Ref part-time.

The Team

We are a tight-knit group of 5 hard workers, including AWS and Google engineers, a CPA-ish, and a high-school grad who all take pride in what we do. title: Senior full stack data governance engineer
description:

This hands-on role combines full-stack application development, data engineering, AI engineering, and cloud platform integration to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions supporting data quality, lineage, access governance, metadata management, data discovery, and regulatory compliance.

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of full-stack data governance products and self-service capabilities on Azure and Databricks.
  • Develop scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations using Python, FastAPI, Azure services, Informatica, ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph, and other enterprise platforms.
  • Build modern front-end applications, governance portals, workflow solutions, and dashboards using ReactJS, TypeScript, data visualization frameworks, and Power BI.
  • Design and implement metadata management, data lineage, data quality, access governance, and workflow automation solutions.
  • Develop AI-powered capabilities using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, RAG, vector search, prompt engineering, and agent-based workflows.
  • Integrate Databricks Unity Catalog, Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow to support governed data processing and AI/ML use cases.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, application security, monitoring, and DevOps best practices using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and Git.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of full-stack application development and Azure cloud engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of Databricks experience, including Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog.
  • Strong Python development skills with FastAPI (or similar frameworks) and REST API design.
  • Hands‑on experience with Azure services, including Web Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Services, and Azure DevOps.
  • Experience building data‑intensive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, ReactJS, TypeScript, and modern data visualization frameworks, with strong focus on user experience, performance, and data storytelling.
  • Experience developing AI-powered solutions using Azure OpenAI, RAG, vector search, prompt engineering, and agent workflows.
  • Experience with Informatica IDMC (CDGC, CDQ, CDP, CDI), CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and Git.
  • Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis skills, with the ability to translate business and governance needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, architecture, security, data governance, product, and business teams.
  • Ability to mentor engineers, contribute to engineering standards, and drive high‑quality delivery through code reviews, design reviews, and technical leadership.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Extensive experience with Informatica IDMC, including data integration, data quality, data profiling, metadata management, governance catalog, operational monitoring, ClAIre AI and lineage capabilities.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience working in a federated data governance model across global organizations.

When you join our team:

  • We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
  • We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well‑being and inclusion are more than just words.
  • As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Title: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Any Ipsos Canada Location

Who We Are:

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets.And,we’reproud tosharewe’vereceived our Great Place to Work Certification in 2024, for thethird yearrunning!

ABOUT The Ipsos DataHub

The Ipsos DataHub is a uniquely positioned group within Ipsos. It is a next-generation data platform designed to unlock the full value of data across the organization. By bringing together information, technology, and expertise in a seamless and secure ecosystem, it empowers teams to move faster, think bigger, and deliver deeper, more meaningful insights. DataHub is at the heart of Ipsos’ vision to transform how data drives decisions, innovation, and impact for clients worldwide.

We’re looking for someone with a deep interest and expertise in data engineering and the dedication to apply that passion. We need someone with the technical expertise to expand and optimize our existing data pipeline and architecture. The ideal candidate will have experience using cloud-based platforms, like Google Cloud Services and AWS, to build and maintain serverless data pipelines to efficiently process and warehouse large scale datasets. The role also requires conscientious attention to detail, an ability to work well on a small team, and a self-starter approach to problem solving and debugging.

What you can expect to be doing:

  • Lead the architecture, design, coding, testing, and delivery of cloud-based data pipelines and platform components that process and store large-scale datasets.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical guardrails for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and serving.
  • Design and optimize data warehouses and distributed data systems for scalability, security, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through solution design, code reviews, debugging, production support, and mentorship of data engineers.
  • Own production readiness and reliability practices for the data platform, including service-level indicators/objectives (SLIs/SLOs), observability, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and failure-mode analysis.
  • Lead incident response for data-platform and pipeline disruptions; drive root-cause analysis, blameless post-incident reviews, and corrective actions that reduce recurrence and operational toil.
  • Improve software delivery and operations through automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, runbooks, release controls, and operational tooling.
  • Drive the migration of development code into production and ensure systems are supportable, maintainable, well-documented, and production-grade.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to translate business and project needs into technical architecture, delivery plans, and clear trade-off decisions.
  • Continuously troubleshoot and improve existing infrastructure and codebases, and responsibly incorporate AI/LLM-based tools where they improve engineering productivity and quality.

This might be the job for you if you have:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or a closely related field, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field required; master’s degree or higher preferred.
  • Proficiency in Python and advanced working knowledge of SQL.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GCP services, including BigQuery and GCS; familiarity with other cloud platforms is an asset.
  • Hands-on SRE or production-engineering experience, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, monitoring and alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, reliability automation, and operational readiness.
  • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices; experience with tools such as Terraform is preferred.
  • Prior success designing, deploying, and operating large-scale data pipelines and distributed storage/compute systems in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of production failure modes, performance tuning, capacity planning, data quality, and disaster-recovery/recoverability concepts.
  • Experience with collaboration tools (e.g. Atlassian suite) and version control systems (e.g. Git).
  • Experience incorporating AI/LLM-based tools into data engineering workflows, with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate outputs and apply sound engineering judgment to accept, adapt, or reject suggestions.
  • Strong technical communication skills and the ability to explain complex engineering concepts, influence technical decisions, and work effectively in a highly collaborative, consensus-oriented environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, excellent time-management skills, and a track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.

In accordance with Ontario & British Columbia law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $140,000 CAD. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discrimatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications.

If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to!

What’sin it for you:

At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture.

To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit:Why Work at Ipsos | CA

Inclusive Workplace Commitment

Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees, creating an environment that promotes inclusion, and enabling employees from all walks of life to flourish. Ipsos encourages our employees to act in a respectful and responsible manner, in line with code of best practices concerning diversity and inclusion, human rights, equality, and civility for every individual.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

We are looking for a curious, mid-to-senior Software Engineer who embraces AI as part of their engineering craft to join our Platform Engineering Productivity team.
In this role, you will help ensure our products are released to customers with high quality while improving the developer experience for engineers across Elastic. You’ll thrive here if you think systematically, enjoy solving complex problems, and are motivated by building tools, frameworks, and processes that help teams develop, ship, and operate software effectively at scale.

  • Creating and maintaining ephemeral developer environments.
  • Defining and enforcing release gates based on key quality criteria.
  • Building tools and infrastructure that support product deployment and release.
  • Improving the overall developer workflow across build, test, package, and release stages.

What You Bring :

title: Senior Project Controls Analyst
description:
TD Thornton

TD Thornton is a premier consulting firm specializing in project management and project controls solutions. We provide strong onboarding and ongoing support to help our people succeed. We welcome applicants from engineering, construction management, project management, business analytics, scheduling, and related backgrounds who thrive in a collaborative environment.

Job Overview

Title: Senior Project Controls Analyst
Sector: Electric Utilities
Seniority: Senior
Location: San Jose, CA
Work Type: Hybrid (1–2 days per week in office)
Compensation: $130,000–$150,000 annually

TD Thornton is seeking an experienced Senior Project Controls Analyst to support cost, schedule, and project performance management across a portfolio of major construction projects within the electric utilities sector.

This role combines hands-on Primavera P6 scheduling with financial forecasting, cost analysis, project controls reporting, risk management, and project governance. The Senior Project Controls Analyst will work closely with project managers and cross-functional stakeholders to identify performance trends, maintain accurate forecasts, and provide leadership with clear visibility into project cost and schedule performance.

The ideal candidate has strong technical project controls experience and can independently analyze project data, identify potential issues, and communicate meaningful insights and recommendations to project and senior leadership.

Your Day-to-Day Activities

  • Develop, update, and maintain detailed project schedules using Primavera P6.

  • Develop and maintain work breakdown structures, dependencies, resource allocations, cost loading, and schedule baselines.

  • Prepare project financial forecasts, cash flow projections, and cost analysis.

  • Support project managers with business cases, budgets, forecasts, and contingency management.

  • Track and analyze cost and schedule performance, including variances and emerging trends.

  • Manage project accruals, financial tracking, and cost validation activities.

  • Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that provide clear insight into project performance.

  • Support contract administration and change-order processes.

  • Identify project risks and assess potential cost and schedule impacts.

  • Prepare concise project updates and presentations for senior management.

  • Facilitate project controls and performance meetings and track follow-up actions.

  • Maintain project documentation in accordance with governance and audit requirements.

  • Provide clear, data-driven project updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate meeting minutes, action logs, financial records, and project controls documentation.

The Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 7+ years of relevant project controls, scheduling, cost controls, or related experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Primavera P6, including dependencies, baselines, cost loading, resource loading, and resource leveling.

  • Experience with project financial analysis, including forecasting, accruals, budgets, and cost variance analysis.

  • Ability to analyze project cost and schedule data and identify risks, trends, and potential performance issues.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate project controls data into clear updates for project managers and leadership.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.

You’ll Stand Out If You Have

  • Proficiency with SAP for project financial management and reporting.

  • 2+ years of experience supporting electric utility construction or large-scale infrastructure projects.

  • Experience supporting a portfolio of capital construction projects.

  • PMP or comparable project management/project controls certification.

  • Experience developing management-level dashboards and project performance reporting.

  • Demonstrated leadership, ownership, and interest in mentoring or developing other project controls professionals.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $130,000–$150,000 annual salary

  • Paid holiday, sick, and vacation time

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

  • Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Annual Bonus

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

Since 2005, TD Thornton has been helping our clients bridge organizational gaps by providing best-in-class consulting services and staff augmentation. Whether we are part of the contractor’s team or serving as an owner’s representative, we offer a wide spectrum of construction management support services to help our clients mitigate risks and deliver successful project outcomes.

We believe our diversity is part of our strength and are proud to be a woman-owned and minority-owned company.

10+ years experience in internet/ intranet-based business systems or e-business consulting.

- 10+ years of business analysis experience, ideally with experience on high volume transactional web applications

title: IC 2027 System Architect
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

System Architect – Senior Member of Technical Staff

The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a wide-ranging and dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities.

The Architecture Concepts Department (ArCon) provides expertise in architecture methods, processes, and tools to an extremely broad range of customers, including National Space Security (NSS) and other defense programs, NASA, NOAA, NNSA, DHS, and others. ArCon staff participate in and lead architecture trade studies, architecture conceptualization studies, architecture modeling tasks, and program assessment analyses at multiple levels of complexity, ranging from prototype systems to full scale acquisition systems in the space, ground, communications, and network domains. ArCon applies disciplined system architecting principles and leads cross-functional teams to provide impactful guidance to assist our customers in making key acquisition and operations decisions.

Work Model: This position will follow an in-person work model with a minimum of 4 days per week of onsite work required in either Chantilly, VA or El Segundo, CA.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Work as a key contributor and leader in one of ArCon’s flagship capabilities, the Concept Design Center (CDC) System Architecture Team (SAT), a concurrent engineering design team responsible for performing mission concept design, analysis of alternatives, and architecture-level trade studies for various government agencies.
  • Apply and develop disciplined system architecting methods, processes, and tools in a broad range of architecture-level assessment, modeling, analysis, and conceptual design activities
  • Apply and develop innovative methods, processes, and tools to architect and implement model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and digital engineering (DE) capabilities
  • Use, develop, and integrate analytical methods and tools to evaluate architectural concepts and system conceptual designs for cost, schedule, performance, risk, and resilience to disruptive events or threats, and other characteristics
  • Inform system architecting and acquisition decisions with expertise in relevant systems, technologies, threats, policy, and the industrial base in the space and/or nuclear weapons domains
  • Collaborate with other Aerospace personnel to marshal technical expertise in multiple technical disciplines and domains to enable concurrent engineering approaches to address complex problems
  • Work with Aerospace program office, customer, and contractor personnel to elicit and identify needs, requirements, and constraints for studies; build cross disciplinary teams; scope, plan, and execute the study; and effectively communicate task status, methods, results, and recommendations in briefings and formal technical reports.

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Senior Member of Technical Staff:

  • PhD in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, science, or related technical field

    (pursuing or conferred within last 12 months)

  • 0-1 year of industry experience
  • Prior internship with The Aerospace Corporation
  • Experience in system or enterprise architecting, systems engineering, concept design, and/or model-based systems engineering through relevant work and/or graduate school experience
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present methods and results effectively in briefings, formal reports, and informal communications.
  • Ability to learn new skills and acquire knowledge through self-study and proactive engagement with mentors and subject matter experts
  • Available and willing to travel domestically and internationally approx. 5-10%
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance
  • Transcripts required

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • Demonstrated success in organizing and leading cross-functional, cross-organizational teams to execute studies and assessments and generate quality products
  • Experience with space system architecture conceptual design, analysis, and concurrent engineering techniques
  • Experience with spacecraft, payloads, ground systems, launch systems, missile systems, nuclear weapon systems, and/or aircraft systems
  • Relevant work and/or graduate school experience in system or enterprise architecting, systems engineering, model-based systems engineering, or digital engineering
  • Hands-on experience with system or enterprise modeling in the Systems Modeling Language (SysML), Unified Architecture Framework (UAF), or Unified Profile for DoDAF and MODAF (UPDM)
  • Current active TS/SCI security clearance

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

title: Automated Affidavit Representative
description:
About the Role

Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time | $+ Equity

The Automated Affidavits Representative supports Column’s affidavit operations from generation through completion. This role monitors automated affidavit workflows, reviews and signs affidavits, resolves exceptions, and helps ensure our affidavit processes remain accurate, efficient, and compliant.

This person will also support affidavit compliance by researching state, jurisdiction, publication, signing, and notarization requirements and helping translate those requirements into clear processes, documentation, and workflow improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor and manage automated affidavit workflows, including identifying and resolving affidavits that require manual review or action
  • Review affidavits for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
  • Serve as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column and support electronic notarization
  • Monitor changes to affidavit requirements and help determine their impact on existing processes, templates, and workflows
  • Identify potential compliance gaps or unclear requirements and escalate when additional legal or operational review is needed
  • Partner with internal teams to implement confirmed requirements into affidavit templates, processes, documentation, and automation
  • Manage affidavit queues and prioritize work based on deadlines, urgency, and service level expectations
  • Identify and resolve errors, missing information, workflow failures, and other exceptions that could delay affidavit completion
  • Identify recurring issues, manual work, and opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, or automation of the affidavit process

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns
  • Strong research skills with the ability to interpret requirements and translate findings into clear operational processes
  • Interest or experience in compliance, legal operations, regulatory research, document processing, or a related area
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to manage high volume workflows and competing deadlines
  • Good judgment and the ability to determine when an issue can be resolved independently and when it should be escalated
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills
  • Comfortable learning and working across multiple systems and automated workflows
  • Comfortable serving as an authorized signer on behalf of Column
  • Reliable, adaptable, and able to maintain accuracy in a deadline driven environment

What Success Looks Like

You keep Column’s Automated Affidavits workflow moving while helping ensure the process remains accurate and compliant. You can independently manage day to day affidavit operations, identify and resolve exceptions, research compliance questions, and recognize opportunities to strengthen our processes and automation.

Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days: Learn the Workflow and Requirements

The first 30 days focus on understanding Column’s affidavit operations, signing responsibilities, systems, and compliance requirements.

You will:

  • Complete training on the Automated Affidavits workflow from generation through delivery
  • Learn Column’s affidavit signing and notarization procedures
  • Understand the different affidavit workflows and when manual intervention is required
  • Become familiar with existing state, jurisdiction, and publication specific requirements and compliance resources
  • Learn how affidavit exceptions and compliance questions are researched, documented, resolved, and escalated
  • Begin reviewing and signing affidavits with support as needed

By Day 30:

You can independently review and sign standard affidavits, navigate the Automated Affidavits workflow, recognize common processing and compliance issues, and know when additional research or escalation is needed.

Days 31 to 60: Own the Workflow and Support Compliance

During your second month, the focus shifts to independently managing daily affidavit responsibilities and contributing to compliance research.

You will:

  • Independently manage affidavit queues, signing responsibilities, and routine exceptions
  • Consistently complete work within established accuracy and service level expectations
  • Research and document affidavit requirements when questions arise
  • Identify discrepancies between confirmed requirements and existing workflows or templates
  • Keep compliance documentation current as requirements are confirmed or changed
  • Escalate unusual or higher risk compliance questions appropriately

By Day 60:

You independently own your standard Automated Affidavits responsibilities and can research, document, and apply routine compliance requirements with minimal oversight.

Days 61 to 90: Improve and Strengthen the Program

During your third month, the focus expands from managing the existing process to helping improve it.

You will:

  • Independently handle more complex affidavit and compliance exceptions
  • Proactively identify compliance gaps and areas of operational risk
  • Review workflows and templates against documented requirements
  • Identify recurring manual work, errors, and requirements that could be addressed through process improvements or automation
  • Contribute to stronger compliance documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Serve as a reliable internal resource for routine affidavit processing and compliance questions

By Day 90:

You operate independently as an Automated Affidavits Representative and authorized signer while also serving as a strong resource for affidavit compliance. You help ensure our workflows are accurate and efficient, our requirements are documented and understood, and potential compliance gaps are identified and addressed.

Must Haves

  • Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns
  • Strong research skills and the ability to interpret requirements and turn findings into clear, actionable information
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to manage high volume workflows and competing deadlines
  • Good judgment and the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate further, and escalate when appropriate
  • Comfortable learning and working across multiple systems and automated workflows
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned work, and consistently meet deadlines and service level expectations
  • Comfortable serving as an authorized affidavit signer on behalf of Column
  • Experience working in a technology or SaaS environment

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with affidavits, notarization, legal notices, or other legal documents
  • Experience in compliance, legal operations, regulatory research, or a similar environment
  • Experience researching state or jurisdiction specific requirements
  • Experience working with electronic notarization or Remote Online Notarization processes
  • Experience working in a high volume document processing or operations environment
  • Experience maintaining compliance documentation, standard operating procedures, or internal knowledge resources
  • Experience identifying process improvements or opportunities for automation
  • Notary experience

Why This Role Matters

Public notice compliance relies on strict state guidelines, complex notarization standards, and exacting execution. An overlooked requirement, faulty signature, or inaccurate detail can create significant consequences for the customers who rely on Column.

The Automated Affidavits Representative plays a critical role in making sure every affidavit is processed accurately, efficiently, and fully compliant. By managing workflows from generation through completion, researching jurisdictional requirements, and translating rules into clear processes, this role helps Column deliver a reliable experience while scaling automated affidavit operations across the country.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $55,000-$62,000 based on experience
  • Equity participation in a high-growth, mission-driven company
  • 401K with match
  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based)

title: Data Engineer
description:

Meet the Team

We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Data Engineer to join our core data platform team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining the scalable data platforms that power our business intelligence and analytical initiatives. You will also drive platform optimization, automation, migration initiatives, and operational best practices while collaborating with stakeholders to support business needs and continuous improvement.

  • Familiarity with modern DataOps practices, including data observability tools (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations) and FinOps principles for cloud cost optimization.

Why Cisco?

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Our externships are flexible—they can range from two to eight weeks during the year, according to your college curriculum – but are typically two or three weeks in length. Your schedule will include days, evenings and weekends.

Extern students are expected to be enthusiastic and effective participants in our patient care activities, upholding the professional and ethical standards of our practice. Students participating in the externship program are suggested to review the Veterinary Practice Act in regard to the scope of duties that may be performed, and to be familiar with the type and degree of veterinary supervision that is required. These should be followed carefully in order to protect both yourself and our practice.

Requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited DVM program.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Note: This is a 6-12 month Contract Position.


Position Summary

Vesta Corporation is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of our global enterprise network. This is a senior individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of complex multi-site networking, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and PCI compliance. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, deep fluency with AWS network architecture and security services, strong familiarity with both commercial and open-source tooling, and the ability to drive infrastructure modernization initiatives with limited oversight.

Key Responsibilities

On-Premises & Hybrid Network Infrastructure

• Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure network infrastructure across data centers, remote sites, and AWS/Azure cloud environments.

• Architect and operate routing and switching infrastructure including BGP, NAT, VLANs, Spanning Tree, IPsec VPNs and HSRP.

• Manage and tune enterprise firewall platforms (Cisco, pfSense, Check Point) in alignment with PCI DSS segmentation and access control requirements.

• Administer and optimize F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM for application delivery, load balancing, and traffic steering across production environments.

• Manage Cloudflare DNS, WAF, and network security policies for internet-facing properties.

• Maintain network security policy management via FireMon; contribute to access path analysis and rule lifecycle management.

• Manage Proxmox-based virtualization as it relates to network-adjacent workloads and VM/LXC networking.

• Coordinate with vendors and carriers to manage WAN circuits, resolve outages, and drive cost optimization.

AWS Network Design & Operations

• Design, deploy, and maintain AWS Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) including subnet design, CIDR allocation, route tables, internet gateways, and NAT gateways across multi-account and multi-region environments.

• Architect and manage VPC-to-VPC connectivity via VPC Peering, AWS Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink to support secure, scalable inter-service communication.

• Configure and maintain AWS Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect circuits for hybrid connectivity between on-premises data centers and AWS environments.

• Design and enforce AWS Security Group and Network ACL policies as network-layer access controls, aligned with PCI DSS segmentation requirements.

• Manage DNS architecture within AWS using Route 53 for private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding, and DNS failover across hybrid environments.

• Configure and manage AWS NAT Gateways, Elastic IPs, and Elastic Load Balancers (ALB/NLB) for workload exposure and traffic routing.

• Maintain AWS network connectivity for partner data and compute workloads migrated into cloud environments, including GDPR and data sovereignty considerations.

AWS Security & Compliance

• Implement and maintain AWS security controls at the network layer including Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Flow Logs, and WAF rulesets on CloudFront and ALB.

• Enable and manage AWS CloudTrail across accounts to ensure comprehensive API activity logging; integrate with centralized SIEM for alerting and audit evidence.

• Configure and maintain AWS GuardDuty for threat detection; triage findings and drive remediation in coordination with the security team.

• Manage AWS Security Hub to aggregate and prioritize findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and third-party integrations; produce compliance posture reports for PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audits.

• Administer AWS IAM policies, roles, and permission boundaries as they relate to network resource access; enforce least-privilege principles across VPC, Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway configurations.

• Use AWS Config rules and AWS Organizations SCPs to enforce network security standards and detect drift across multi-account environments.

Monitoring, Observability & Automation

• Monitor AWS network health using VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, Transit Gateway Network Manager, and Reachability Analyzer.

• Build and maintain CloudWatch dashboards and alarms for network throughput, latency, NAT gateway utilization, VPN tunnel status, and Direct Connect metrics.

• Evaluate, deploy, and operationalize FOSS tools as replacements for commercial products where appropriate (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox)

• Contribute to Infrastructure as Code for network resources using automation; enforce configuration consistency across environments.

• Maintain comprehensive documentation for network topology, configurations, and operational runbooks; support PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audit evidence collection.

• Participate in on-call rotation and be available for after-hours work including unscheduled incidents.

• Travel to domestic data center and office locations as needed to support deployments or incidents.

Technical Expertise & Core Competencies

Required On-Premises

• 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience in large-scale, multi-site environments.

• Expert-level Cisco routing and switching: IOS/NX-OS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, QoS.

• Enterprise firewall administration: Cisco ASA/FTD, pfSense, and Check Point. Rule management, segmentation strategy, and change control.

• F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM: virtual servers, pools, iRules, traffic policies, and GTM topology records.

• Cloudflare: DNS management, WAF rulesets, and security policy administration.

• FireMon: policy analysis, rule review workflows, and access path validation.

• Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing/switching protocols, and secure remote access.

• Experience operating in PCI DSS compliant environments including control implementation and audit evidence collection.

Required AWS Networking & Security:

• VPC architecture: subnet design and CIDR planning, route tables, internet gateways, NAT gateways, and VPC endpoints.

• VPC connectivity: VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, and AWS PrivateLink for inter-VPC and cross-account routing.

• Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect configuration, BGP peering, and failover design.

• Security controls: Security Groups, Network ACLs, and VPC Flow Logs for traffic visibility and PCI segmentation enforcement.

• DNS: Route 53 private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding rules, and health-check-based failover.

• Load balancing and exposure: Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Elastic IP management.

• Monitoring and observability: CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards; VPC Flow Logs analysis; Transit Gateway Network Manager.

• Security and compliance services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, IAM policy review, and ACM.

• Multi-account governance: AWS Organizations, SCPs, and Control Tower network guardrails.

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Proxmox VE: VM/LXC provisioning, cluster management, and software-defined networking.

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or CloudFormation for network resource provisioning and drift detection.

• Experience deploying FOSS tools to replace commercial networking or monitoring products (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox).

• Azure networking: Azure Firewall, NSGs, and Azure DNS private zones.

• Zero-trust / overlay VPN concepts and implementation (e.g., Tailscale or Wireguard).

• AWS advanced networking: CloudFront distributions, WAF on ALB/CloudFront, PrivateLink endpoint services, Network Firewall.

• Scripting or automation: Python, Bash, or Ansible for network task automation.

• Vendor management: circuit provisioning, carrier escalations, and hardware lifecycle coordination.


Qualifications

• 10+ years of enterprise networking experience in complex, multi-site or global environments.

• Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with AWS networking and security services in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and drive projects to completion without heavy oversight.

• Strong vendor management skills, able to coordinate service delivery and incident resolution with carriers, ISPs, and hardware vendors.

Preferred Certifications

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description:
EVOCS OVERVIEW

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

Cybersecurity Intern

Long-term internship, 30+ hours per week | Remote, United States | Reports to the Director of Cybersecurity | Path to full-time

🎯 Role Overview

EVOCS is looking for a cybersecurity intern to work alongside our security team on real work. Not shadowing, not busywork. You will be given actual tasks, with oversight, and the expectation that you learn fast and take on more.

This is a long-term internship, not a summer placement, and it is built as a path to a full-time role. If you do well, we want to hire you. You will work directly with the Director of Cybersecurity, who will supervise your work and be the person you learn from.

🧩 What You Will Work On

  • Microsoft security. Configuring, hardening, testing, and documenting across the Microsoft Cloud and Endpoint security stack (Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra, Defender, Intune, Purview). Reviewing settings against benchmarks and finding what is misconfigured.
  • Threat and vulnerability research. Stay on top of new advisories, CVEs, and attack techniques, work out which ones actually matter to our environment and our clients, and write short, clear briefs on what you find. Not AI slop!
  • Building and automating. Write scripts and small tools that remove manual work: pulling data, generating reports, collecting evidence, checking configurations. If you build something that saves the team hours, that is a win here. AI-assisted coding is welcome, provided you understand what your code does.
  • Compliance support. Control evidence collection, access reviews, vendor reviews, asset inventory reconciliation, and keeping documentation and ownership mapping current.
  • Engagement support. Helping prepare material behind our client security work: research, data organization, and first-pass analysis. You will not be client-facing, but you will see how real engagements are run.
  • Security tooling. Evaluating, standing up, testing, and documenting security tools, and helping decide whether they are worth keeping.

🧠 What You Will Bring

  • Foundational security knowledge from coursework, certifications (Security+ or similar), or self-study. No professional experience required.
  • Comfortable across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and willing to dig into unfamiliar tools without being walked through them.
  • Some scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, or equivalent) or clear evidence you can pick it up quickly.
  • Clear written communication. A lot of this work is taking something messy and explaining it plainly.
  • Accuracy and follow-through. Much of this work is only useful if it is right and finished.
  • Curiosity, and the willingness to ask a question rather than guess. Guessing quietly is the one habit that causes problems here.
  • Available 30+ hours per week on an ongoing basis, based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship.

🛠️ Show Us You Actually Care About This

You will not have much professional experience, and that is fine. What you have built on your own time is the best evidence we have, and here it counts more than coursework.

  • A home lab: a SIEM you stood up, a detection lab, a small AD domain you attacked, anything you broke and rebuilt.
  • A GitHub profile: scripts, parsers, automation, tools you wrote because something annoyed you.
  • CTFs, HackTheBox, TryHackMe, or writeups explaining something technical to other people.
  • Anything else that shows this is a genuine interest rather than a job search: a blog, a project, a talk, a tool nobody asked you for.

It does not need to be polished. Send links and tell us what you learned building it.

⭐ Nice to Have

  • Any exposure to Microsoft 365, Entra, and Azure.
  • Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Experience with a SIEM, EDR, or vulnerability scanner, including free and open source ones.
  • An interest in how AI is being applied to security work, and to building things generally.

🎁 What You Will Get Out of It

  • Direct mentorship from the Director of Cybersecurity, with your work reviewed rather than rubber-stamped.
  • Hands-on experience across the Microsoft security stack, compliance operations, and live client security work.
  • Real projects you can point to, including anything you build.
  • A genuine path to a full-time role. That is the intent of this internship, not a footnote.

📋 The Details

  • Type: long-term paid internship, 30+ hours per week, with the intent to convert to full-time.
  • Location: remote, United States.
  • System access: assigned progressively as you demonstrate judgment, starting with supervised work.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Job Overview: We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our software development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software testing methodologies, excellent analytical skills, and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the software development life cycle by designing and executing comprehensive test plans, identifying and documenting defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the overall quality of our software solutions.

Responsibilities:

  1. Test Planning and Design:

    • Collaborate with development teams to understand project requirements and functional specifications.
    • Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
    • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to testing activities.

  2. Manual and Automated Testing:

    • Perform manual testing of software applications to identify and document defects.
    • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
    • Execute automated test suites and analyze results to ensure software meets quality standards.

  3. Defect Identification and Documentation:

    • Identify, document, and track software defects using established defect tracking tools.
    • Work closely with developers to isolate, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.

  4. Regression Testing:

    • Conduct regression testing to ensure that previously identified defects have been addressed and new features have not introduced new issues.

  5. Performance and Load Testing:

    • Plan and execute performance testing to evaluate the scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of software applications.
    • Analyze and report performance test results, identifying areas for improvement.

  6. Collaboration and Communication:

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of project requirements.
    • Clearly communicate test progress, test results, and any testing-related issues to relevant stakeholders.

  7. Continuous Improvement:

    • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in testing methodologies.
    • Propose and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in software quality assurance, including both manual and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

Education and Experience:

  • Relevant certifications in software testing (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
EVOCS OVERVIEW

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

As an IT consulting firm, we work with our clients to understand their needs, identify the right technologies, and deliver solutions that improve performance and support their business objectives.

Today, EVOCS is a trusted technology partner to a growing number of organizations and industry leaders. Our team combines technical expertise, business understanding, and a commitment to quality to deliver effective solutions and build lasting client relationships based on responsiveness, consistency, and results.

Cybersecurity Engineer

Full-time, permanent | Remote, United States | Reports to the Director of Cybersecurity

🎯 Role Overview

You'll join a team that's still building -- hands-on work across detection, telemetry, and vulnerability analysis on live client environments, with findings that hold up under review.

You will be responsible for the work behind the work: tuning detections, onboarding log sources, analyzing telemetry and configurations at scale, and turning scanner output and evidence into findings a client's security leadership can act on.

🧩 What You Will Do

  • Log source onboarding. Connect, parse, and validate telemetry sources into a SIEM. Confirm what is actually arriving, in what fidelity, and what is silently missing.
  • Telemetry and configuration analysis. Extract and analyze firewall configurations, log data, and device state at fleet scale to support security assessments, and pull the evidence that sits behind a finding.
  • Detection engineering. Write and tune detection logic, cut false positives on noisy rules, and build content for coverage gaps found during engagements. Platforms vary by client, so what matters is that you have done this somewhere, not that you have done it in one product.
  • Vulnerability analysis. Turn scanner output into a prioritized picture using exploitability and asset criticality rather than raw CVSS, and track remediation to closure.
  • Evidence and documentation. Assemble the evidence behind findings so each one is traceable and defensible under review.
  • First drafts. Draft findings, report sections, and weekly status reports to a standard that needs review rather than rewriting.
  • Automation. Build playbooks, scripts, and tooling that take repetitive work out of engagements.
  • Research. Advisory and CVE analysis, platform and tooling comparisons, and technical research that feeds client recommendations.

🧠 What You Will Bring

  • 3 to 5 years hands-on in cybersecurity: SOC, detection engineering, security engineering, or an MSSP delivery team. Hands on keyboard, not coordination.
  • Real SIEM and SOAR experience on any platform, commercial or open source. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic, Wazuh, Security Onion, Graylog, TheHive, Shuffle: we do not care which. We care that you have built and tuned detections in it, not only watched its dashboards.
  • Detection logic you can write from scratch. KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, Sigma, or equivalent. You should be able to walk through a rule you wrote, why you wrote it that way, and what it missed.
  • Blue team background. Alert triage and investigation experience, and MITRE ATT&CK as something you have applied rather than read about.
  • Network literacy. You can read a firewall configuration and rule base and understand zones, segmentation, and what a rule actually permits. You do not need to be a firewall engineer; you need to not be lost in the data.
  • Enterprise or data center IT experience: a real production environment with change control and uptime pressure, not only a lab.
  • Scripting for analysis and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or equivalent).
  • Writing that survives light review. Much of your output becomes material a client's security leadership reads.
  • Willingness to say what the data does not support. Overstating a conclusion is the one habit that does not work here.

🛠️ Show Us What You Build

The strongest people in this field tinker. If security is something you work on outside work hours, that counts here as much as anything on your resume, and at this experience level it often counts more.

  • A home lab: a SIEM you stood up yourself, a detection lab, an attack range, anything you broke and rebuilt.
  • A GitHub profile: scripts, parsers, detection rules, automation, tools you wrote because something annoyed you.
  • Published detection content, Sigma rules, or contributions to open-source security projects.
  • CTFs, HackTheBox, TryHackMe, or writeups and talks explaining something technical to other people.

Send links. A good repo will get you further with us than another certification.

⭐ What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Certifications: SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or GIAC or any other relevant cert.
  • Microsoft security stack experience (Defender, Entra, Azure security), which appears frequently in our client environments.
  • Fortinet exposure (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) or equivalent enterprise firewall platform experience.
  • Vulnerability management tooling (Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys).
  • Data center, colocation, critical infrastructure, or OT-adjacent environments.
  • Threat hunting, SOAR, or automation development.

🤝 How We Will Work Together

You will not be sent into client meetings alone or handed an engagement to run before you are ready. Scope, severity calls, and client communication sit with the Director of Cybersecurity. Your work goes through review, and that review is where you will learn fastest. As your judgment develops, you take on more, including leading pieces of engagements outright.

You will move between detection work, assessment analysis, and vulnerability work in the same week, across several client engagements at once. If you want to sit inside one platform doing one thing, this is the wrong role.

description:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us at Kajabi.

The people who use Kajabi are building real businesses. They're creating transformative learning experiences. Showing up for their customers and communities every day. What we ship becomes part of how they do that work. That's the weight of this job, and it's what makes it worth doing.

Our founders just came back to lead the company. The energy is different now. An ambition to take big swings, ship fast, and build something that matters to real people. That's the moment you'd be walking into.

We're obsessed with getting it right. The interaction that feels just right. The moment that makes someone stop and say "wow." Experiences that feel obvious in use. Clear, stable, and thoughtfully composed.

Here's what that actually looks like.

What You'll Do

Kajabi is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Irvine, Ca. This is a full time, in-person role at our headquarters. You'll work on a cross-functional product team, owning systems and features that directly impact how thousands of creators build their businesses.

This isn't a heads-down coding role. Senior Software Engineers here are expected to think like product owners, ship like engineers, and use AI tools to do both faster. You'll bring technical judgment into product conversations, shape what gets built and why, and help the team deliver solutions that customers actually value.

The Impact you will make

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable systems and APIs in Ruby on Rails and React.
  • Take ownership of systems end to end including reliability, observability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work, accelerating delivery, prototyping solutions, and writing better code faster.
  • Bring genuine product thinking to the table: engage in discovery, ask questions about user behavior, and help the team make smart trade-offs between customer value and technical complexity.
  • Use data and customer research to inform your technical decisions and advocate for the right solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, and Design; not just during implementation, but during planning and discovery.
  • Lead system design conversations and contribute to architecture decisions that affect your team's long-term direction.
  • Write clean, testable, maintainable code and bring that same standard to your code reviews.
  • Mentor other engineers by sharing context, giving thoughtful feedback, and helping them grow.

Attributes for Success

  • You have strong, hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails, React, and Postgres. You're comfortable across the full stack.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
VerTALENTS is a subsidiary of VerSprite Cybersecurity. Specializing in technology staffing and utilizing a network of technical clients, VerTALENTS connects top level technical talent with industry clients through various methods and expands not only clients talent network, but candidates job search as well. At the bottom line, VerTALENTS adds value to both clients and candidates alike.

We work with clients to fill both full-time and contracting opportunities, so If the following job interests you, please apply to learn more!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong expertise in Kubernetes and modern CI/CD practices. In this role, you will design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-native platforms that support multiple engineering teams.

You will help manage the full lifecycle of containerized applications—from image build and deployment through observability, performance validation, and reliability improvements—while contributing to a resilient, well-governed platform environment.

Why This Role Matters

• Help ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of critical platforms

• Influence how infrastructure is built and operated as the organization grows

• Work across teams to enable faster, safer software delivery

• Improve systems, processes, and tooling—not just maintain them

What You'll Do

• Design, deploy, and manage production Kubernetes clusters, including workload scheduling, resource quotas, network policies, ingress/egress controls, and RBAC

• Develop and maintain deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and Kubernetes operators

• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps principles

• Provision and manage infrastructure using tools such as Terraform or similar automation platforms

• Build secure container images and manage image versioning and promotion across environments

• Implement observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies

• Conduct load testing, resilience validation, performance tuning, and capacity planning

• Perform Linux administration, troubleshooting, and system hardening

• Support stateful workloads including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and Kafka

• Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement initiatives

• Document architecture, operational procedures, backup and recovery processes, and infrastructure lifecycle plans

What We're Looking For

• 2–5+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles

• Hands-on experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience working with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Strong containerization knowledge and security best practices

• Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills

• Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language

• Understanding of networking, Kubernetes security, and deployment strategies

• Experience with load testing and performance analysis

• Ability to work effectively across technical teams in a collaborative environment

Additional Information

• Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States

• Visa sponsorship is not available for this position

• Salary range: $85,000 – $100,000, based on experience

• Bonus eligibility available

• Remote (US) position with occasional travel as needed
