title: Customer Engineer
description:
Position Overview:


As a Customer Engineer, you will interface directly with customers to support the introduction and deployment of our devices and software within their networks. Inseego provides a range of Fixed Wireless, MiFi, and WiFi devices to Network Operators and Enterprises across Oceania, including Australia, New Zealand and Pacific Islands. You will work closely with the Inseego R&D team as required to provide technical support, troubleshoot customer issues, and ensure timely resolution of customer issues.


You will play a pivotal role in ensuring customer satisfaction by supporting the successful introduction and deployment of Inseego hardware and software in the field. As a key representative of Inseego, you will work closely with customers while supporting the Sales and Solutions teams in preparing RFP response and quotations.


You will also be responsible for providing product training and developing support documentation to help customers effectively deploy and use our solutions. These activities may occasionally be delivered remotely; however, on-site support will be required, primarily in Melbourne and at other customer locations across Oceania, as required by the business.


Customer Engineering requires a strong technical background in Fixed Wireless Access, mobile devices, and related technologies, combined with excellent communication, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.


Our work environment fosters teamwork and creativity, encouraging you to leverage your expertise to solve complex technical challenges and deliver exceptional value to our customers.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop comprehensive Fixed Wireless Access and device test plans.
  • Conduct mobile device/network performance and interoperability testing.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts.
  • Identify, troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues.
  • Conduct regression testing and maintain test beds.
  • Create clear test documentation and reports.
  • Collaborate closely with development, engineering and network teams.
  • Stay informed with FWA, WiFi standards and technologies.
  • Deliver product and technical training courses.
  • Work closely with all stakeholders to manage the overall technical relationship with customers and internal teams.


Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, with 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Hands-on experience with RF and radio communications technologies, particularly as applied to 4G and 5G cellular networks.
  • Strong knowledge of 5G Standalone (SA) and Non-Standalone (NSA) architectures, including end-to-end network architecture.
  • Thorough understanding of 3GPP radio standards and specifications.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting RF network issues encountered by cellular service providers across 4G/5G RAN, with a strong understanding of key RF parameters.
  • Hands-on experience using QXDM for log analysis, as well as proficiency with Wi-Fi testing tools and equipment.
  • Familiarity with Wi-Fi standards and protocols, including IEEE 802.11.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and architectures.
  • Hands-on experience testing mobility devices, including 5G FWA devices, MiFi devices, and handsets.
  • Proven knowledge of FWA, Wi-Fi 6/7 gateways, CPE, and routing gateway functionalities.


Location: Remote, Melbourne, Australia

Please note, the successful candidate must be based in Melbourne, Australia, with the ability to provide on-site support at customer locations across Oceania as required.

title: Consultant, Finance
description:
Consultant, Finance

Financial Consulting | Management Consulting | Financial Analysis

Victoria, BC | Edmonton, AB | Hybrid / Remote within British Columbia or Alberta

Turn complex financial questions into clear, defensible decisions.

Elevate Consulting is looking for a Consultant, Finance who can take complex financial, operational and organizational information, make sense of it, build rigorous analysis and turn that work into recommendations senior leaders can actually use.

You may be building a multi-year financial model one day, assessing funding or cost-management options the next, and developing an executive presentation that distills complicated analysis into a clear decision.

This is a consulting role for someone who enjoys both thinking and doing. You will need strong analytical capability, sound judgment, excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in an environment where the answer is not always obvious.

What You’ll Do

As a Consultant, Finance, you will work across a variety of client engagements involving financial analysis, business planning, organizational decision-making and transformation.

Your work may include:

  • Developing complex multi-year and multi-variable financial, economic and scenario models.
  • Conducting financial reviews, assessments and analysis.
  • Completing cost-benefit analysis, benchmarking, activity-based costing and options analysis.
  • Developing financial forecasts, funding models and cost-management strategies.
  • Assessing project, program or organizational benefits and benefit realization.
  • Reviewing financial information and identifying key risks, opportunities and implications.
  • Translating detailed analysis into clear recommendations for executives and decision-makers.
  • Creating concise, executive-level reports, presentations and decision materials.
  • Supporting workshops, client meetings and stakeholder discussions.
  • Managing your own workstreams and contributing to larger consulting engagements.
  • Supporting business development, including identifying opportunities, contributing to proposals and helping develop new client relationships.

What We Want to See on Your Resume

We want to see enough evidence to understand the work you have done and the level at which you have operated. We will be looking for experience such as:

  • Financial modelling, economic modelling, forecasting or scenario analysis.
  • Financial reviews, assessments or business-case development.
  • Cost-benefit analysis, benchmarking or activity-based costing.
  • Development of funding models or cost-management strategies.
  • Preparing analysis and recommendations for executives or senior decision-makers.
  • Consulting, advisory, corporate finance, strategy, public-sector finance or a similarly analytical environment.
  • Advanced use of Microsoft Excel and strong capability with Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience contributing to client relationships, proposals or business development.
  • Experience working with public-sector organizations, public-sector financial reporting, government funding structures or similar environments is a strong asset.

Relevant education may include:

  • CPA or another recognized accounting designation.
  • MBA.
  • Degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
  • An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

What We’ll Look for When We Meet You

While your resume tells us what you have done, it does not tell us nearly enough about how you think. During the interview process, we will be paying close attention to your ability to:

  • Break down a complicated problem and identify what actually matters.
  • Apply judgment when there is no perfect answer.
  • Ask thoughtful questions before jumping to a solution.
  • Explain complex financial concepts in plain language.
  • Write and communicate clearly.
  • Listen carefully to clients and colleagues.
  • Work comfortably with incomplete information and changing priorities.
  • Manage details without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Take ownership of your work and follow through.
  • Receive feedback, challenge assumptions respectfully and improve your thinking.
  • Use technology and AI thoughtfully without outsourcing the thinking itself.
  • Balance analytical rigour with pragmatism.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical exercise. We are interested in seeing how you approach the work, organize information and communicate your thinking.

You’ll Probably Thrive Here If You...

  • Like solving difficult problems.
  • Enjoy producing tangible work rather than spending your entire day in meetings.
  • Care deeply about the quality of what you deliver.
  • Can manage several priorities without needing someone to organize every step for you.
  • Are curious enough to ask why.
  • Are confident enough to offer a point of view and thoughtful enough to change it when the evidence says you should.
  • Enjoy being part of a small consulting firm where everyone contributes.
  • Understand that great consulting requires both thinking and doing.
  • Get genuine satisfaction from helping clients succeed.

This Role Is Probably Not for You If You...

  • Need highly prescribed work with limited ambiguity.
  • Avoid detailed analytical work.
  • Struggle to manage competing priorities independently.
  • Prefer talking about the work to producing the work.
  • See quality control and self-editing as someone else’s responsibility.
  • Expect AI to replace critical thinking, professional judgment or accountability.
  • Are uncomfortable working directly with clients or receiving candid feedback.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 to $130,000 CAD annually.

Placement within the range will reflect the depth and relevance of your experience, financial and analytical expertise, consulting capability, ability to independently lead client work and demonstrated business development experience.

Elevate also offers a broader total rewards package that includes:

  • Comprehensive extended health benefits.
  • Health Spending Account.
  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements.
  • Additional employee benefits and programs.

How to Apply

If this sounds like work you would be good at and a consulting environment you would enjoy, we would like to hear from you. Please submit:

  • A one- or two-page resume.
  • A brief cover letter telling us why this opportunity and Elevate interest you.
  • The location you are nearest to: Victoria or Edmonton

Applications must be submitted through the Apply Now process. We appreciate every application. Only candidates selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be contacted.

title: Senior Network & Systems Infrastructure Engineer (Cisco & VMWare)
description:
About the role

This is an onsite, Monday through Friday position in Fort Lauderdale / Miami area. We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize our enterprise network and virtualization infrastructure. The role covers end-to-end administration of Cisco network switches, routers, and firewalls, as well as VMware virtualization platforms and associated storage systems. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on technical skills with a proactive approach to configure monitor, capacity planning and documentation of core IT infrastructure.

What you'll do


Network Infrastructure

• Install, configure, and maintain Cisco switches and routers across LAN/WAN environments.

• Manage routing protocols VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, and inter-VLAN routing.

• Configure and administer Cisco firewalls, including access control policies, NAT, site-to-site and remote-access VPNs.

• Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity and latency issues, and perform root-cause analysis.

• Implement network segmentation, QoS policies, and security hardening in line with best practices.

• Maintain firmware/IOS upgrade cycles, configuration backups, and change control for all network devices.

Server & Storage

• Administer On-prem VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi hosts, vCenter Server and resource pools.

• Manage VM lifecycle: provisioning, templates, snapshots, migrations (vMotion/Storage vMotion), and decommissioning.

• Perform configurations, performance tuning, monitoring and patch management.

• Support backup and disaster recovery solutions for virtualized workloads (e.g., Veeam or equivalent).

• Administer SAN/NAS storage platforms (e.g., Dell EMC) including LUN provisioning, zoning, and datastore management.

• Manage storage connectivity (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS) between storage arrays and the VMware environment.

• Monitor storage capacity, IOPS, and latency; plan expansions and optimize utilization.

• Implement and test storage-level replication, snapshots, and data protection policies.

General Infrastructure & Operations

• Respond to incidents and service requests within defined SLAs; participate in on-call rotation as required.

• Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation: network diagrams, IP address management, runbooks, and configuration standards.

• Collaborate with security, application, and vendor teams on projects, upgrades, and audits.

• Support datacenter operations, including hardware installation, cabling, and environmental monitoring.

• Contribute to infrastructure improvement initiatives, automation (scripting), and technology refresh planning.


Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise network and virtualization infrastructure.

• Strong expertise in Cisco networking: switching, routing, and firewall administration.

• Proven experience administering VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter) in production environments.

• Solid working knowledge of enterprise storage technologies (SAN/NAS, iSCSI, FC, NFS).

• Strong understanding of network security principles, VPNs, and access control.

• Experience with monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, vRealize/Aria Operations).

• Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.

Preferred Certifications

• Cisco CCNA required; CCNP (Enterprise or Security) preferred.

• VMware VCP-DCV (Data Center Virtualization).

• Storage vendor certification (e.g., NetApp NCDA, Dell EMC) is a plus.

• ITIL Foundation is an advantage.

Desirable Skills

• Scripting/automation experience (PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Ansible).

• Experience with backup solutions (Veeam, Commvault) and DR planning.

• Familiarity with Windows Server and Active Directory environments.

Soft Skills

• Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams and vendors.

• Self-driven, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Commitment to reliability, security, and continuous improvement.


Working Conditions

• On-call availability for critical incidents and scheduled maintenance windows (evenings/weekends as needed).

• Onsite required: Monday - Friday, 8am-5pm

title: Software Engineer II - Builder Experience - Platform Engineering Productivity

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

We are looking for a curious, mid-to-senior Software Engineer who embraces AI as part of their engineering craft to join our Platform Engineering Productivity team.
In this role, you will help ensure our products are released to customers with high quality while improving the developer experience for engineers across Elastic. You’ll thrive here if you think systematically, enjoy solving complex problems, and are motivated by building tools, frameworks, and processes that help teams develop, ship, and operate software effectively at scale.

What You Will Be Doing :

As part of the Engineering Productivity organization, you will contribute to initiatives that improve the end-to-end software development lifecycle. The team serves as an enabling function, providing reusable components, frameworks, and guidance that product teams can adopt and operate independently. Your work may include:

  • Ensuring CI infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and efficient.
  • Managing systems and processes for building releasable artifacts.
  • Creating and maintaining ephemeral developer environments.
  • Defining and enforcing release gates based on key quality criteria.
  • Building tools and infrastructure that support product deployment and release.
  • Improving the overall developer workflow across build, test, package, and release stages.
  • Partnering with teams across the organization to solve productivity and release engineering challenges.

What You Bring :

  • Solid experience in one or more programming languages such as Python, Go, Bash, Java, or Scala.
  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, including building, packaging, testing, and releasing software.
  • Experience with modern development environments is essential. Proficiency in cloud and infrastructure technologies such as Terraform, Kubernetes, and Docker, along with a solid understanding of cloud platforms and configuration management tools.
  • Proficiency with CICD and version control systems, especially GIT.
  • Experience executing or contributing to release engineering and quality strategies.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, troubleshoot systems, and improve code quality while maintaining ownership of outcomes.
  • Ability to move effectively across projects, codebases, and teams as priorities evolve.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a distributed team using direct, transparent, and asynchronous communication and comfort in navigating ambiguity.

title: Project Manager
description:
Position Responsibilities:


Lead cross-functional new product introduction initiatives from initial concept and business case through validation, production launch, and post-launch stabilization. This role owns project execution across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, sales, and supporting functions while ensuring launches achieve schedule, budget, quality, safety, and performance objectives.

  • Manage multiple NPI programs of varying scope, complexity, and priority from concept through stable production.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive project plans covering scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, responsibilities, risks, and target completion dates.
  • Facilitate project kickoffs, design reviews, Stage-Gate reviews, launch-readiness assessments, and post-launch evaluations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across product management, engineering, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, supply chain, finance, sales, and customer-facing teams.
  • Translate customer, market, and business needs into actionable project objectives, requirements, and deliverables.
  • Drive prototype builds, pilot runs, testing, validation, first-article activities, preproduction efforts, and production ramp-up.
  • Ensure tooling, fixtures, materials, equipment, documentation, routings, bills of material, inspection methods, work instructions, and training are production-ready.
  • Champion design considerations supporting manufacturability, assembly, inspection, reliability, serviceability, and cost objectives.
  • Manage project schedules, spending, capital requirements, tooling costs, product cost targets, resources, and financial assumptions.
  • Identify technical, manufacturing, commercial, quality, supply chain, cost, and scheduling risks while maintaining appropriate mitigation and recovery plans.
  • Maintain risk registers, action logs, decision records, project changes, and stakeholder communications using Planview Project Advantage.
  • Coordinate supplier decisions, make-versus-buy evaluations, and procurement activities involving long-lead materials and equipment.
  • Monitor early production performance across quality, delivery, scrap, rework, productivity, cost, and customer feedback.
  • Lead launch-related issue resolution and transition completed programs into normal production ownership.
  • Capture lessons learned and promote repeatable NPI practices that strengthen future product-development and launch performance.

Position requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, project management, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience spanning project management, new product introduction, product development, manufacturing engineering, or operations.
  • Demonstrated success directing cross-functional initiatives from concept development through production launch.
  • Proven ability to manage schedules, budgets, project risks, deliverables, resources, and stakeholder communications.
  • Hands-on experience using Planview Project Advantage for project plans, milestones, resources, risks, deliverables, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience operating within a formal Stage-Gate product-development methodology, including gate preparation, reviews, decisions, and follow-through.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing operations, production processes, and product-launch requirements.
  • Strong planning, organization, prioritization, problem-solving, risk-management, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to influence and lead multidisciplinary teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Effective written, verbal, presentation, meeting-facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, manufacturing documentation, and project financial information.
  • Proficiency with project scheduling, spreadsheet, presentation, and collaboration tools.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.
  • Ability to work within office, engineering, laboratory, and manufacturing environments and participate in prototype builds and production trials.
  • Ability to travel periodically to facilities, suppliers, customers, or project partners.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Project Management Professional certification or comparable project-management training.
  • Background within engineered products, tooling, machining, fabrication, automation, or discrete manufacturing environments.
  • Experience using ERP, MES, PLM, PDM, project-management, or business-intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with bills of material, routings, engineering drawings, specifications, change-control processes, and quality documentation.
  • Experience coordinating projects across multiple facilities or global teams.

Reasons to Apply:

  • Competitive salary plus a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Health coverage, retirement plans, and other company-sponsored perks.
  • Generous paid time off, including holidays, to support work-life balance.
  • Flexible schedules and work life balance.
  • Strong focus on employee development with on-the-job training and career growth.
  • A positive company culture that values diversity and collaboration.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer – AI/ML
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer – AI/ML

About Nomad

Nomad is building the financial operating system for fleets: fuel cards, real-time transaction processing, invoicing, and working-capital finance, increasingly automated by production AI. We are a small, fast-moving team that cares deeply about doing right by our customers, which in our business means getting the numbers exactly right, every time.

About You

You are a passionate and resourceful Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong experience building scalable, secure applications across the front-end and back-end. You are experienced with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud technologies, and have hands-on experience applying LLMs, machine learning, or data science to real-world products.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of features from design through production, and solving complex technical problems. You care about code quality, security, reliability, and building AI-powered experiences that are practical and production-ready.


Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Engineering

• Design, develop, and maintain secure and scalable applications using Node.js, TypeScript, and React.

• Build and maintain REST APIs, backend services, and user-facing applications.

• Architect and implement cloud solutions using Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Own features end-to-end, from technical design and development through testing, deployment, and production support.

• Review code, troubleshoot production issues, and provide technical guidance to team members.

AI, LLM & Data

• Build and integrate AI/ML-powered features into Nomad's products and workflows.

• Develop applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms.

• Work with technologies and approaches such as RAG, embeddings, vector search, AI agents, prompt engineering, and LLM APIs.

• Apply machine learning and data science concepts to solve product and business problems.

• Work with structured and unstructured data and support data-driven product development.

• Evaluate and improve the accuracy, reliability, performance, and cost of AI-powered applications.

Security, Cloud & Production

• Implement security best practices across the application and AI/ML stack.

• Manage authentication, authorization, secrets, and customer data securely.

• Manage CI/CD pipelines and follow established code review and change management practices.

• Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and production support processes.

• Maintain technical documentation and support SOC 2 and other compliance requirements.


Required Qualifications & Skills

Full Stack

• 5–7+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications.

• Strong experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js.

• Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.

• Strong understanding of modern software architecture, testing, and development practices.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or a comparable cloud environment.

• Experience with Git, CI/CD, code reviews, and production deployments.

AI / ML / Data

• Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/ML capabilities into production applications.

• Practical experience with LLMs and Generative AI.

• Experience with one or more of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, prompt engineering, or LLM APIs.

• Experience with Python for AI/ML, data processing, analytics, or backend development.

• Strong understanding of machine learning and/or data science concepts and their practical application.

• Experience working with structured and/or unstructured data.

• Ability to integrate AI/ML capabilities into full-stack applications.

Security & Cloud

• Strong understanding of web application and API security, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, CORS, and common application vulnerabilities.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, monitoring, logging, and deployment.

• Familiarity with secure SDLC and production security practices.


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks.

• Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, Vertex AI Vector Search, or similar vector databases.

• Experience with scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks.

• Experience with Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or similar AI platforms.

• Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows.

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or microservices.

• Experience in SaaS, fintech, financial services, payments, transportation, or other data-intensive environments.

• Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation of $120,000- 140,000 based on experience and qualifications.

• Flexible work schedule.

• Growth and development opportunities.

• Team outings and social events.

• Excellent extended medical, dental, and vision benefits plan.

At Nomad, we love using AI to make our processes smarter—it helps us draft engaging job descriptions, organize information, and stay on top of details.

Feel free to use AI tools to prepare, research, or practice for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT fans 👀!). But when it comes to the conversation, we want to meet the real you—no AI substitutes needed. Bring your authentic, unfiltered self, and we promise we’ll do the same.

  • Manage project accounts payable—subcontractor and vendor invoices, approvals, and payment terms—ensuring costs are accurately captured and cash is optimized.
  • Reconcile AR and AP to project cost and revenue, and monitor net working capital and billing-vs-cost position (over/under billings) on each project.

Commercial & Contract Management

  • Own commercial and contract management for assigned projects—review, interpret, and administer contract terms (pricing, payment terms, retention, liquidated damages, warranties, and risk allocation) and safeguard the company’s commercial position throughout execution.
  • Maintain contract compliance through timely notices, consistent correspondence, and substantiating records that support entitlement.
  • Lead the change-order process end to end—identify and quantify scope changes, price and document change orders, secure approvals, and ensure they are reflected in budget, forecast, and billing—so margin and entitlements are protected.
  • Manage claims and dispute economics, working with legal counsel to defend and pursue entitlements.
  • Interface with customers, vendors, and joint venture partners on all commercial and contractual matters.

Procurement & Buyout

  • Partner with Procurement on project sourcing, subcontractor and supplier selection, purchase commitments, and cost-down opportunities.
  • Support project buyout—analyze subcontractor and supplier proposals, support issuance of contracts, and track buyout savings against the project budget.
  • Manage subcontractor accounts—review valuations, address contract performance issues, and ensure payments match claimed value, contract rules, and agreed valuation methods.
  • Support supplier and subcontractor negotiations, ensuring commercial and payment terms align with project cash flow and risk objectives.

Risk Management

  • Maintain a live project risk register—identify commercial and financial risks early, quantify exposure, and drive mitigation and contingency treatments.
  • Monitor contingency drawdown and evaluate the margin and cash impact of change orders, claims, and emerging risks.
  • Provide early warning to leadership on projects trending off budget, margin, or cash targets.

Business Partnership & Reporting

  • Act as a true business partner to project managers and other project stakeholders—including customers, suppliers, subcontractors, legal counsel, and internal leadership—providing the financial insight that drives project decisions.
  • Prepare project reviews, dashboards, and executive, investor, and lender reporting on portfolio performance.
  • Support bid and proposal pricing, sensitivity analysis, and go/no-go decisions.

Systems & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the NetSuite and project-accounting implementation and reporting build-out.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, accuracy, and accountability.

  • 8+ years in project finance, commercial or project management, or FP&A—ideally construction, infrastructure, data centers, or energy; a senior individual contributor.

  • Understanding of project accounting principles—earned value, cost variance, and cash flow.
  • Strong financial modeling skills; experience with ERP and project-accounting systems; familiarity with the NetSuite ecosystem is desirable.

title: AI Evaluation Lead
description:
The Mission

We live in a paradox: AI is accelerating the world’s capabilities, yet the average person feels more financially precarious than ever. Inflation is rising, wages are stagnant, and the traditional “retirement” model is broken. We aren’t building another chatbot. We are building the Financial Answer Machine, an intelligent guide designed to help people navigate a new financial reality.
Underpinned by a proprietary financial system, we are turning “average” advice into personalized, multi-modal financial power. We have closed an over-subscribed seed round and are looking for founding team members to help us build a bridge between the intelligence of AI and the rigid accuracy required for financial freedom. This is a rare opportunity to join at Day Zero and architect a business designed for outsized impact and massive scale.

The Role

Our client is hiring an AI Evaluation Lead to own how we measure the quality of AI-generated financial advice. Getting the advice right matters. A bad output here has real consequences for real people, and this role owns making sure we catch it.
You will work with an AI-generated test case library and automated scoring infrastructure that is already in place. Your job is to make sure we are measuring the right things, interpreting what the results are telling us, and determining what needs to change to keep the system performing well as it scales. Evaluation complexity grows with the platform, and this role grows with it.
This is not a monitoring and reporting role. It requires genuine judgment about AI system behavior, advice quality, and what the data is and is not capturing. You will report to our Head of Revenue & Compliance, work closely with the AI/ML team and founders, and partner with subject matter experts who provide domain judgment on complex or ambiguous cases. But you need enough personal finance literacy to make first-pass quality assessments independently and know when to escalate.

What You’ll Do (The Day-to-Day)

  • Define and validate the evaluation set: what cases we should be testing, whether coverage is sufficient across domains, and where the current framework has gaps.
  • Analyze scoring results to identify highest-frequency case types, patterns in what is performing well versus poorly, and anomalies that warrant closer review.
  • Assess whether current measures are detecting the right failure modes or whether new measures are needed.
  • Review flagged cases and make judgment calls on what the results mean and what should be done about them, drawing on both data and domain knowledge.
  • Own the criteria and calibration for when human review is triggered: defining what rises to that level, what does not, and ensuring the threshold stays well-calibrated as the platform scales.
  • Partner with subject matter experts on cases that require deeper domain judgment, and incorporate their input into evaluation design.
  • Ensure evaluation coverage keeps pace with new domain additions and model changes before they ship.
  • Translate findings into specific, actionable recommendations for the AI/ML team on what needs to change in the system.
  • Evolve the evaluation framework as the system grows, new domains are added, and user patterns shift.

What We’re Looking For

You have worked on AI or ML system quality in a context where outputs had real stakes. You think analytically about what data is and is not telling you. You are comfortable making judgment calls in ambiguous situations rather than waiting for the answer to be obvious. You have enough AI/ML fluency to reason about why a system is producing what it is producing, not just whether the output looks right.
You bring enough personal finance literacy to read an advice response and have a genuine opinion about whether it is directionally sound. You do not need formal credentials or deep expertise across every domain the system covers—you will partner with subject matter experts for the complex judgment calls. What matters is that your review is substantive rather than mechanical, and that you can have an informed conversation with those experts about what you are seeing in the data.
  • Fluency with how LLM-based systems behave in production, including output variance, failure modes, and the limits of automated scoring.
  • Ability to assess whether an eval framework is measuring the right things, not just whether it is running correctly.
  • Comfortable working with behavioral and interaction data to surface patterns and quality signals.
  • Familiarity with evaluation and observability tooling.

Backgrounds that tend to fit:

  • Model evaluation or QA on a consumer-facing AI product, particularly in a regulated or high-stakes context.
  • Model risk or validation with LLM or generative AI exposure.
  • Data science or analytics with ownership of production AI system quality.
  • Operations quality control built around AI- or ML-generated outputs.
  • Financial services or fintech product roles where you developed both analytical depth and personal finance domain familiarity.

This is probably not the right role for you if:

  • Your background is primarily in building models rather than evaluating what they produce
  • Personal finance is entirely unfamiliar territory. You do not need to be an expert, but you need enough baseline literacy to assess whether advice is reasonable and to work productively with the SMEs who provide deeper domain judgment
  • You are looking for a well-defined role with stable processes. The framework is in place but evolving it is a core part of the job
  • You default to manual review rather than thinking systematically about what should be automated and what requires human judgment

How we work

We are a fully remote, distributed team. Periodic in-person get-togethers will be integral to our operating cadence. We’re adults who prioritize outcomes and output over set schedules. We value clear writing, high ownership, fast iteration, direct communication, and thoughtful async collaboration.
As an early team member, you should expect broad ownership, frequent context shifts, and a high degree of autonomy. You will help shape not just the product, but also the technical standards and operating cadence of the company.

Compensation

Salary: 120-140k, plus early-stage option equity.
Final compensation will depend on level, experience, location, and scope of responsibility.
This role is open to candidates based in the United States.

AI Interview

We expect a high volume of applications for this role. To help candidates showcase more than what's on their resume, you'll have the opportunity to complete an AI interview as part of the application process.

As an AI-first company, we embrace AI throughout the hiring process and are excited to meet candidates who are equally curious about and enthusiastic about the technology. This interview is your chance to demonstrate your experience, communication skills, and potential beyond your resume.

title: (Senior) Product Design Engineer – Autonomous Greenhouse Robotics
description:
About the Role

Be part of a mission-driven team developing cutting-edge robotic solutions that shape the future of sustainable agriculture. Work in a collaborative, innovative, and growth-focused environment with global impact.

title: Senior Program Controls Analyst
description:
About the role

  • We are seeking a Senior Program Controls Analyst to lead cost and earned value management efforts on complex, mission-critical programs within aerospace and defense environments.
  • This role is responsible for driving program financial integrity, ensuring forecasts reflect execution reality, and providing leadership with clear, decision-quality insight. You will operate as a trusted partner to Program Managers and Control Account Managers (CAMs), owning the financial narrative of the program.

What you'll do

  • Lead development and maintenance of program cost baselines, including time-phased budgets and control account structures
  • Own Earned Value Management (EVM) processes within Deltek Cobra, ensuring data integrity and compliance with EVMS guidelines
  • Develop, analyze, and defend Estimates at Completion (EAC) and Estimates to Complete (ETC)
  • Perform deep-dive variance analysis and clearly articulate root causes, impacts, and forward-looking risks
  • Partner directly with CAMs and program leadership to validate performance, challenge assumptions, and improve forecast accuracy
  • Lead monthly program financial reviews, including internal leadership briefings and customer-facing deliverables
  • Reconcile cost, schedule, and accounting data across systems (Cobra, ERP, timekeeping) to ensure consistency and audit readiness
  • Support baseline change control processes, including BCR development, impact analysis, and implementation
  • Ensure compliance with ANSI/EIA-748 EVMS guidelines and support DCMA/DCAA audits and surveillance activities
  • Identify cost risks and opportunities and proactively drive mitigation strategies

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in program controls, cost management, or earned value management
  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Deltek Cobra (required)
  • Strong expertise in EVMS principles and ANSI/EIA-748 compliance
  • Proven experience developing and defending EACs/ETCs at the program or control account level
  • Experience working directly with CAMs and program leadership in a client-facing environment
  • High proficiency in Excel and large dataset analysis
  • Strong ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights
  • Experience in aerospace and defense required
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint or equivalent ERP systems
  • Background supporting DCMA or DCAA audits, IBRs, or surveillance reviews
  • Familiarity with integrated cost/schedule environments and cross-functional program controls
  • Experience leading or mentoring junior analysts
  • Active or eligible for a U.S. security clearance

title: Contract Compliance Specialist
description:
Position summary

The core analytical role on the program. Reads the executed agreements and turns them into a working register of obligations — who owes what, to whom, triggered by what, judged against what criteria. Then administers that register day to day: tracking what is due, verifying what arrives, and flagging what is late or non-conforming.

This role suits someone who is precise, patient with dense documents, and comfortable telling a counterparty their submission does not meet the requirement.

Responsibilities

– Review executed agreements, amendments, and exhibits and extract every obligation created

– Capture obligations running in both directions, including those owed by the A&M System

– Identify deemed-approval provisions and track the associated review clocks

– Maintain register entries: responsible party, trigger, due date, acceptance criteria, dependency, status

– Track submittals and reports against contractual due dates; escalate slippage early

– Review incoming deliverables for conformance and document non-conformance in writing

– Maintain the correspondence, transmittal, and acceptance record for each obligation

– Draft notices and deficiency documentation for review and signature

– Support development of the contract-specific procedure sets

Required

– 7+ years in contract administration, project controls, compliance, or project management

– Demonstrated ability to work directly from contract language rather than from summaries

– Rigorous document control discipline and comfort building structured registers

– Strong written English; deficiency documentation must withstand scrutiny

– Experience in a regulated or contractually demanding environment

– Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience

Preferred

– Experience with leases, easements, development agreements, or research agreements

– Paralegal certification, contract management certification (CFCM, CPCM), or similar

– Construction or capital program background

– Regulatory submittal tracking experience

title: Contract Specialist
description:
Contract Specialist

  • Job Location: Remote 100%
  • Job Type: Full-Time
  • Clearance: Eligible for Public Trust

SUMMARY:

This position will support the Department of Veterans Affairs in providing full lifecycle federal acquisition support and business aid services, in all aspects of pre-award and post-award functions (excluding negotiation), using a wide range of contracting methods and types.

General IT systems utilized for this job are EIS (Enterprise Information System), Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams, Adobe Acrobat, Internet Explorer, eCMS, Contract Opportunities, CPARS/PPIRS, SAM, GSA eBuy.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform all acquisitions functions in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR), and all other applicable regulations and policies.
  • Perform all pre-award procurement functions including, but not necessarily limited to, market research/analysis to determine availability of the requirement.
  • Prepare contractual documents such as solicitations, awards, and related documentation using the Electronic Contract Management System (eCMS)
  • Coordinate with requiring activities, industry, and other stakeholders; and complete contractual files.
  • Perform all post-award procurement functions including, but not necessarily limited to, preparing modifications, tracking contractor performance for compliance with terms and conditions of contracts.
  • Prepare letters, memoranda documents, or reports that support contractual actions or recommendations for contracting officer approval and signature and contract close-outs.
  • Conduct comprehensive research and analysis of technical and cost contracts.
  • Read and interpret acquisition policy, and regulations.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2-6+ years of experience in conducting comprehensive federal full life-cycle acquisition support activities with a working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).
  • Bachelor's degree or a certificate in FAC-C or DAWIA Level I-III in Contracting.
  • Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • Contracting experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA)

title: 2026 San Francisco Internship
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Great work starts with a great foundation. And we hope to build a great foundation through our Summer Associate Program. Summer Associates dive into every detail of the business, working to gain an understanding of our clients, their growth aspirations, and what drives their customers.
Summer Associates work with everyone in the firm, collaborating with colleagues across the organization. On any given project, you’ll interact with clients, Partners, Designers, Insights Specialists, Content Strategists, and many others from our rich multidisciplinary bench. The Summer Associate role is organized to cultivate a true understanding of our approach to consulting and develop the skills to get it done.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

While every day will be different, you can expect to:

  • Gain a deep understanding of business and customers.
    You’ll dig into industries, markets, and customer behaviors to understand how our clients grow and how shifting customer needs, digital trends, and market conditions may impact that growth. Through primary and secondary research, you’ll help uncover insights that drive transformation.

  • Collaborate on complex challenges with multidisciplinary teams.
    Working side-by-side with strategists, designers, day-to-day client leads, you’ll help answer big strategic questions on growth, brand, marketing, and transformation. You may be shaping a new brand or exploring a market entry strategy; always contributing your perspective while learning to refine it with feedback.

  • Contribute to creative problem-solving and storytelling.
    You’ll analyze data, participate in ideation sessions, and help shape hypotheses. Then, you’ll turn research into persuasive deliverables (decks, frameworks, and presentations), learning how to frame the “so what” and present insightful, actionable recommendations to internal leaders and clients.

  • Play a role beyond project work.
    Interns also contribute to firm growth and culture from supporting business development and proposals to helping shape office initiatives and thought leadership. It’s a chance to stretch your skills beyond client work and make your mark internally.

  • Learn fast, grow early, and lead with a point of view.
    You’ll have exposure to senior teammates and clients, with mentorship and regular feedback to help you build confidence and sharpen your POV, in written presentations and as a voice in the room. You’ll practice articulating your perspective, iterating with teammates, and shaping best-in-class results.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • A great education: you should be a rising senior, earning a BA or BS degree with demonstrated academic performance
  • Well-developed critical thinking capabilities, problem solving skills, and creative thinking
  • Superior communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Knowledge of, and passion for, brand, digital, and marketing strategy; and, how they impact business outcomes
  • A curious mind with an unrelenting commitment to get to the answer, to test new approaches, learn new skills, and push others’ assumptions
  • Confusion tolerance: comfort with ambiguity and the ability to adapt, flex, and change directions given client, project, and team circumstances, understanding the ever-changing business world

Due to the fact that our internship program is designed to provide full-time offers upon completion, we are unable to move forward with anyone requiring sponsorship now, or in the future. Your submission also confirms that you are interviewing to join our San Francisco office, with the expectation that post-internship should you receive a full-time offer, it will also be in our San Francisco office.

title: Senior Associate
description:
About the Role

At Prophet, our Senior Associates sit at the intersection of rigorous consulting, human-centered thinking, and transformative strategy. As a Senior Associate, you’ll play a key role on critical workstreams across brand, marketing, customer experience, and business transformation; helping Fortune 500 clients and fast-moving challengers alike solve their most pressing growth challenges.

You’ll gain early and consistent exposure to clients, work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams, and mentor junior team members. This is a growth role that is ideal for someone with 3+ years of experience looking to deepen their strategy craft while developing their leadership toolkit.

Our projects span industries, from healthcare and financial services to tech, consumer goods, and beyond, providing unmatched variety and learning opportunities. We value curiosity, courage, and collaboration, and we're looking for individuals who want to think boldly, act insightfully, and create real change.

Your Day to Day

Support the delivery of high-impact client work.

You’ll play a central role on project teams where you’ll help to frame the problem, guide the strategic approach, and ensure the work moves forward smoothly. You’ll work closely with Managers and Partners on a range of brand, marketing, and growth strategy challenges.

Break down complex challenges into clear paths forward.

You’ll help define project approaches, synthesize ambiguous inputs, and support strategic frameworks that guide the team and client toward actionable solutions.

Conduct rigorous analysis and strategic thinking.

You’ll analyze market trends, customer behaviors, and competitive dynamics to generate thoughtful, relevant insights. Your work will connect business context with strategic implications.

Craft compelling deliverables and stories.

You’ll help develop client-ready deliverables that translate strategy into narratives that drive alignment and decision-making.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

You’ll partner with strategists, creatives, and analysts to explore problems from different perspectives and elevate the quality of thinking across the team.

Be a go-to resource for junior team members.

You’ll mentor Associates and Analysts by sharing what you’ve learned, offering feedback, and helping model how we approach our work.

Help grow the firm beyond project work.

You’ll contribute to business development efforts, from drafting points of view to supporting proposal development, and participate in internal initiatives that shape our thinking and culture.

Leverage AI to work smarter and get to insights faster.
You’ll use GenAI and other AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and spark thinking, and as a foundational tool for the work.

Apply strong business acumen to drive strategic thinking.
You’ll bring a sharp understanding of how businesses create value; considering growth levers, operating models, and financial implications to ensure our strategies are both creative and commercially sound.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in strategy consulting or a strategic role on the brand/corporate side
  • Bachelor’s degree required with demonstrated academic performance
  • Strong business acumen: an understanding of how businesses generate value and the financial levers that drive performance
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills: ability to present to clients with clarity and confidence
  • Experience leading others: managing junior team members and navigating up to senior leaders
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
  • Comfort working across industries and functions; a quick study who can pivot between diverse business challenges
  • Passion for client impact and a collaborative mindset
  • Familiarity with AI tools, AI strategy or implementation experience, and/or exposure to GenAI applications

Location: 3+ days a week in office/at client site

Salary: $110,000 - $125,0000

title: Account Director, Mexico
description:
About the role

Vesta is looking for a senior payments leader to manage and expand one of our most strategic telecom partnerships in Mexico. This is not a traditional account management role. The Account Director will operate as a trusted advisor to telecom operators, helping them improve payment performance, reduce fraud exposure, and unlock measurable revenue through better authorization and recovery strategies.


The person in this role will work directly with senior stakeholders at major telecom operators—particularly Telcel—while collaborating internally with Vesta’s fraud, data science, product, and engineering teams. The ideal candidate understands how payment authorization, fraud patterns, issuer behavior, and chargeback dynamics impact revenue in high-volume environments and can translate that expertise into actionable insights for clients.


This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of payments, telecom, and data science, solving complex operational challenges that directly affect billions of transactions.


Most payment processors simply move transactions. Vesta focuses on improving the economics of those transactions. This role allows you to work with some of the largest telecom operators to directly influence revenue recovery, fraud risk exposure, authorization performance, and customer retention.


If you enjoy combining payments expertise, data analysis, and client leadership, this role offers a chance to have meaningful impact at scale.


What you'll do

Lead Strategic Telecom Partnerships

You will own the relationship with key telecom clients in Mexico, serving as their primary advisor on payment performance, fraud mitigation, and authorization optimization.

You’ll engage with senior leadership and operational teams to understand how payment behavior impacts revenue, churn, and customer experience—and help them improve those outcomes.

Diagnose and Solve Payment Performance Issues

Telecom operators process millions of transactions each month. When approval rates drop or fraud patterns shift, it can mean millions in lost revenue.

You will:

  • Analyze approval trends, issuer behavior, and fraud signals
  • Work with internal experts to diagnose root cause
  • Translate complex technical findings into clear client guidance
  • Lead the implementation of performance improvements


Bridge Client Challenges and Internal Expertise

This role sits at the intersection of client operations and Vesta’s technical teams. You will:

  • Translate technical issues raised by clients into actionable problem statements
  • Work with engineering, fraud, and product teams to develop solutions
  • Clearly communicate technical strategies and outcomes back to client stakeholders


Drive Revenue Growth and Long-Term Partnership

Beyond solving immediate issues, you’ll help clients continuously improve their payment economics. You’ll identify opportunities to:

  • Increase authorization rates
  • Reduce fraud losses
  • Optimize payment mix
  • Improve recurring payment stability


Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years in payments, merchant acquiring, fraud prevention, or related fintech roles
  • Deep Payments expertise in card-not-present payments
  • Experience in payment authorization optimization, fraud patterns and mitigation strategies, chargeback management, and high volume recurring billing enviornments
  • Experience working with high-volume digital merchants or telecom operators, particularly Telcel
  • Comfort discussing payment authorization workflows, fraud detection models, transaction routing, and payment recovery strategies, to a level you can translate technical insights into business impact
  • Fluency in Spanish and English
  • Ability to travel regularly to meet with clients including onsite engagement with Telcel

title: SOC Analyst
description:
About the role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our team enhance our cybersecurity operations. As a SOC Analyst, you will monitor, detect, and respond to cybersecurity threats and incidents across critical federal government mission systems and networks. You will work in a fast-paced environment as part of a team dedicated to maintaining the highest levels of security for critical government missions. Your role will include analyzing security event data, escalating potential threats, and contributing to continuous security improvements.


What you'll do

  • Monitor security information and event management (SIEM) systems for alerts, anomalies, and incidents.
  • Conduct real-time threat analysis and triage security events to determine their impact and urgency.
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents by following established procedures and playbooks.
  • Analyze and report on vulnerabilities using Tenable SecurityCenter and similar tools.
  • Help collect and integrate data from disconnected mission system environments to develop centralized visibility.
  • Perform log analysis and review data from various tools, including intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), firewalls, and endpoint protection solutions.
  • Provide detailed incident reports and recommend mitigation strategies to reduce future risk.
  • Assist in the tuning and optimization of SOC tools and technologies to enhance detection capabilities.
  • Participate in red/blue team exercises and simulations to improve SOC readiness.
  • Support compliance and audit activities by maintaining incident response logs and reports.
  • Stay current with the latest cybersecurity trends, tools, and techniques to ensure an effective response to evolving threats.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in vulnerability and endpoint management tools such as Tenable SecurityCenter/Nessus, AppScan, BigFix, and Trellix ePolicy Orchestrator.
  • Familiarity with SIEM tools such as Tripwire Log Center, Splunk, ArcSight, QRadar, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions and vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Knowledge of incident response frameworks and procedures.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting and/or automating data review, analysis, and reporting using Python or similar languages and databases.
  • Experience supporting new federal government directives such as CISA Binding Operational Directives (BOD) and Emergency Directives (ED).
  • Knowledge of intrusion detection and prevention systems, firewalls, and other network security technologies.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, and other workflow, project management, collaboration, and system administration/monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of federal cybersecurity compliance frameworks, such as FISMA, RMF, or NIST 800-53.
  • Knowledge of operational challenges in complex or isolated networks.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex technical data.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration.
  • Experience working in federal government environments, especially NOAA or similar mission-oriented, scientific, or space-based programs, is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with cloud security frameworks (AWS, Azure, or other platforms) is preferred.

Education and Experience

  • BS in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, related disciplines or equivalent.
  • 6+ years of experience in a SOC environment or similar cybersecurity role.
  • At least one relevant security or incident response certification from ISC2, ISACA, CompTIA, or GIAC such as CISSP, GCIH, CEH, or Security+.

Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident who has lived in the United States for at least 3 of the last 5 years and be able to pass a background investigation to obtain a security badge to access applicable government facilities and systems.

title: Software Engineer (Data Platforms)
description:
About the role

Pay Range: £75k-£200k (salary + equity), based in London, UK.

We are hiring a Data Engineer to join Squid as one of our first engineers.

You will work closely with the founders and early engineering team to build the data foundations of our platform for grid operators. The role combines data engineering, software engineering, infrastructure and applied AI.

You will work with large, complex and often inconsistent technical datasets, building reliable systems to ingest, transform, validate, connect and serve them. This is a high-ownership role based in our central London office, with the opportunity to shape our data architecture, engineering practices and product from an early stage.


What you'll do

  • Build production data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating and serving complex datasets.
  • Design scalable data models, schemas and storage systems for structured, semi-structured and geospatial data.
  • Build pipeline orchestration using directed acyclic graphs, or DAGs, to manage dependencies, retries, scheduling and observability.
  • Develop systems for data quality testing, lineage, versioning, reconciliation and change detection.
  • Create tools for combining datasets from different systems while preserving provenance and auditability.
  • Build APIs and services that make processed data available to products, customers and AI systems.
  • Develop workflows for batch processing, event-driven processing and long-running computational jobs.
  • Create monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures, unexpected data changes and quality regressions.
  • Work directly with customers and domain experts to understand source systems and data problems.
  • Use modern AI development tools to accelerate data mapping, validation and pipeline development.


Qualifications

You do not need to meet every requirement. We are looking for strong data engineers who enjoy making difficult, messy datasets reliable and usable.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Professional experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience working with Postgres or similar databases.
  • Experience designing data models, schemas and transformation layers for complex datasets.
  • Experience with directed acyclic graph-based orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with data warehouses, object storage, queues, APIs and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with data quality testing, lineage, observability, versioning or change-data capture.
  • The ability to work with incomplete, inconsistent or poorly documented source data.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review and maintainable system design.
  • An interest in applied AI, data evaluation and building reliable data foundations for AI systems.
  • High ownership, clear communication and a willingness to work directly with technical customers.

Experience with geospatial data, graph data, time-series data, scientific computing, energy data or other complex engineering datasets would be valuable, but is not required.

title: Director
description:
Job Description

Meradia - Director

This is a hybrid position. The ideal candidate is based in the Greater Philadelphia, Boston, or New York City area and is open to partial commuting and occasional travel for work.

Meradia has been a trusted partner in the investment management industry since 1997, offering strategic advisory and implementation services that blend technical expertise with a dedication to client success. KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Deep knowledge of front, middle and back-office operations in investment management organizations, with a strong understanding of institutional client reporting
  • 15+ years of experience in the asset management industry, with expertise across front, middle, and back-office operations
  • Proven track record of success in managing large-scale strategic initiatives, developing operating models, and serving as a thought leader in the financial consulting space
  • Proven business development skills, with the ability to identify and secure new consulting opportunities.

EDUCATION

  • MBA or Master’s degree (preferred).
  • Prior experience in investment management and/or consulting within the industry
  • Professional certifications such as CFA, CIPM, CAIA, or PMP (preferred).

Description de l'emploi

Meradia – Réalisateur(rice)

Meradia est un partenaire de confiance du secteur de la gestion des investissements depuis 1997. Nous proposons des services de conseil stratégique et de mise en œuvre alliant expertise technique et engagement envers la réussite de nos clients. Notre mission est d'aider nos clients à relever des défis complexes, à optimiser leurs opérations et à atteindre leurs objectifs.

Nous recherchons des personnes ambitieuses et talentueuses, passionnées par l'obtention de résultats exceptionnels. Nos consultants collaborent avec des clients diversifiés pour créer des solutions efficaces. Le(la) candidat(e) idéal(e) est une personne proactive et autonome, dotée d'excellentes compétences en communication, d'un sens du détail et d'une expérience avérée dans le secteur financier.

Chez Meradia, nous accordons une grande importance à l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et nous investissons dans leur développement. Nous offrons une rémunération compétitive, des avantages sociaux complets et des opportunités de développement professionnel continu, notamment du mentorat et des événements du secteur. Si vous aspirez à une carrière enrichissante dans le domaine du conseil, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour rejoindre notre équipe!

EXIGENCES

  • Fournir une orientation stratégique pour des initiatives telles que la sélection de l'externalisation, la refonte du modèle opérationnel, la mise en œuvre de la technologie, l'analyse des fusions et acquisitions et la gouvernance des données.
  • Piloter les efforts de développement commercial, identifier et rechercher de nouvelles opportunités pour élargir la clientèle de l'entreprise
  • Assurer la supervision exécutive des principaux engagements des clients et stimuler le développement commercial au sein du secteur de la gestion d'actifs
  • Agir en tant que point de contact principal pour les projets majeurs, en collaborant avec les cadres supérieurs (COO, CTO) pour aligner les résultats du projet sur les objectifs du client
  • Développer des relations de conseil de haut niveau, en tirant parti de l'expertise pour convertir les interactions au niveau exécutif en engagements de conseil à long terme
  • Diriger les efforts de gestion de programme sur les engagements, en supervisant toutes les activités d'exécution quotidiennes
  • Présent lors de conférences sectorielles, représentant l'expertise de l'entreprise et interagissant avec des clients potentiels

  • Recruter, encadrer et fidéliser des professionnels du conseil pour soutenir les objectifs de croissance de l'entreprise
  • Capacité à voyager – Vous passerez probablement beaucoup de temps sur place avec nos clients. Ces déplacements peuvent représenter jusqu'à 50 à 80 % de votre semaine de travail et peuvent être internationaux. De plus, vous devez posséder un permis de conduire valide, car de nombreux clients sont éloignés des transports en commun.

COMPÉTENCES ET APTITUDES

  • Réflexion stratégique : les transformations sont difficiles et le(la) candidat(e) idéal(e) aidera nos clients à les gérer avec succès
  • Très compétent(e) dans la présentation d'idées et de concepts complexes à des audiences de cadres supérieurs
  • Expérience dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions technologiques dans le secteur des services d'investissement
  • Capacité à définir, planifier et exécuter des missions de conseil à grande échelle
  • Expertise dans l'établissement de relations de confiance à long terme avec les clients et les parties prenantes
  • Capacité avérée à diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires et à gérer des initiatives complexes
  • Compétent(e) dans la navigation dans des environnements clients dynamiques et des scénarios de projet difficiles
  • Expérience de la gestion de projets de mise en œuvre et de développement de systèmes qui ont un impact sur plusieurs départements et redéfinissent les processus opérationnels
  • Connaissance pratique des plateformes prenant en charge les fonctions de front, middle et back-office (par exemple, OMS, comptabilité de portefeuille, performance)
  • Expérience avérée dans l'analyse des processus d'affaires et le développement de solutions pratiques qui stimulent l'efficacité, améliorent le service client et réduisent les risques
  • Capacité à évaluer et à documenter les besoins de l'entreprise, y compris les systèmes, les données, l'intégration, les flux de travail, les résultats, les rapports et l'impact économique/opérationnel de chacun
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en test de données
  • Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle, verbale et écrite

CONNAISSANCES ET EXPÉRIENCE

  • Forte expertise fonctionnelle, technique et opérationnelle du secteur de la gestion des investissements
  • Connaissance approfondie des principales solutions de fournisseurs de services et des plateformes technologiques dans le domaine de la gestion des investissements
  • Connaissance approfondie des opérations de front, middle et back-office dans des organisations de gestion des investissements, avec une solide compréhension des rapports des clients institutionnels
  • Plus de 15 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de la gestion d'actifs, avec une expertise dans les opérations de front, middle et back-office
  • Expérience avérée de réussite dans la gestion d'initiatives stratégiques à grande échelle, le développement de modèles opérationnels et le rôle de leader d'opinion dans le domaine du conseil financier
  • Compétences avérées en développement commercial, avec la capacité d’identifier et de sécuriser de nouvelles opportunités de conseil.

  • Solide expérience en matière de leadership éclairé grâce à des publications, des livres blancs et des présentations à des conférences

ÉDUCATION

  • Baccalauréat en informatique , en ingénierie, en finance, en comptabilité, en économie, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (obligatoire)
  • MBA ou Maîtrise (préféré).

  • Plus de 15 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le secteur financier

title: Kennel Assistant
description:
Coldwater Animal Hospital is hiring a part-time Kennel Assistant to work alongside our team of experienced veterinarians, skilled technicians, and devoted support staff to ensure each animal receives the best possible care during their stay with us. If you are enthusiastic, reliable, and excited about helping us maintain our high standards of animal care and customer service, we would love to hear from you!

What to Expect

As you join our mission, expect to be supported in your work and home life with:

  • All the benefits you deserve. Medical, dental, vision, retirement - plus an employee pet discount because we know your pets are family, too. For full-time employees.
  • Paid time off. Catch your breath with a generous PTO policy, allowing you to take the time you need to recharge. For full-time employees.
  • Employee Pet Discounts! Because we know your pets are family, too.
  • 401(k) plan

Salary: $16 - $16.50 per hour, determined by the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications.

Schedule: This is a part time position averaging 20-25 hours per week.

  • Combination of day and evening shifts.
  • Weekday shifts: 7:00 AM–5:00 PM or 12:00 PM–9:00 PM.
  • Two Saturdays per month, typically 8:00 AM–2:00 PM.
  • Evening and weekend availability is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 75% of the role involves husbandry, hospital cleaning, and re-stocking
  • 25% of the role includes hands-on care with animals
  • Monitor the health and comfort of animals, recognize and respond to emergency situations, and report health concerns.
  • Document treatments, activities, and observations.
  • Walk dogs in all weather conditions.
  • Feed and provide scheduled fresh water to dogs and cats.
  • Maintain cleanliness by washing dishes, bowls, litter boxes, kennels, and cages.
  • Change and replace soiled bedding and manage laundry tasks.
  • Bathe animals as necessary before discharge.
  • Perform general housekeeping duties in animal housing, food preparation, and laundry areas.
  • Administer oral and topical medications, including flea and tick treatments.
  • Assist with checking in and out boarding patients, ensuring proper labeling and ID collars.
  • Identify and alleviate stress in boarding animals through interactive play and mental stimulation.
  • Assist veterinarians and vet techs during examinations, treatments, and surgeries
  • Handle and restrain animals safely and compassionately

Qualifications:

  • Must be able to multi-task and take initiative—self-starters thrive here!
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, physical role—you’ll be on your feet 90% of your shift
  • Passion for animals and their well-being
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

About Coldwater Animal Hospital

Coldwater Animal Hospital has been providing exceptional care for pets since 1989. Founded by Dr. Korte, our hospital offers a range of services, including preventive care, dental treatments, dietary management, routine surgeries, and laser therapy to support long, healthy lives for pets.

We are committed to staying up to date with the latest advancements in veterinary medicine while creating a stress-free experience for our patients. From minimizing wait times to using dimmable lights, comfortable exam mats, and gentle handling techniques, we prioritize your pet’s comfort.

At Coldwater Animal Hospital, your pet’s health and happiness are our top priorities, and we’re dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care.

title: Site Reliability Engineer(SRE)
description:
The SRE Role

· SREs are engineers with the right mix of knowledge and skills in software engineering (i.e. programming, data structures, and algorithms) and systems engineering (i.e. applying scientific principles of experimentation and observation to entire systems to improve reliability, performance and operability).

· We constantly evaluate products and services before and after production releases to prevent, identify and fix problems that impact service availability in deploying, configuring, monitoring, recovering, and scaling.

· We participate in on-call rotations to monitor and support our products and services, taking recovery actions prior to and after disruptions.

· We dedicate at least 50% of our time 'engineering away' problems both, directly and through pairing and coaching our team.

· We work side-by-side with SREs in our team applying software engineering principles to resolve problems impacting service uptime or our operational efficiency.

Required Core Skills for all SREs

· Programming in at least one language such as: Java, C#, Javascript, Python or Ruby - experience with other languages is also valuable such as Shell scripting, PowerShell, PERL or PHP.

· Systems configuration and administration: Windows or Linux.

· Analyzing and discovering how all components of a distributed system work together using a broad range of skills and tools.

Possess or will learn quickly

· Applying an evidence based approach to solving system problems under pressure and in real time to provide the fastest path to service recovery.

· System and software configuration management using tools such as puppet, chef or ansible.

· Cloud technologies and platforms such as AWS or Azure using API or configuration tools.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
