title: Solution Architect
description:
EVOCS OVERVIEW

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

As an IT consulting firm, we work with our clients to understand their needs, identify the right technologies, and deliver solutions that improve performance and support their business objectives.

Today, EVOCS is a trusted technology partner to a growing number of organizations and industry leaders. Our team combines technical expertise, business understanding, and a commitment to quality to deliver effective solutions and build lasting client relationships based on responsiveness, consistency, and results.

Solution Architect

Full-time, permanent | Remote-first — United States, Canada, Argentina, or India | Reports to the Chief Technology Officer

🎯 Role Overview

A Solution Architect at EVOCS turns ambiguous business problems into concrete, buildable designs — fast. You sit with a stakeholder or a struggling project team, understand how the business actually operates, ask the questions that surface every edge case (what happens when this branch fires? what does the state machine look like?), and produce a solution the delivery team can build from immediately: the workflow, the components, the integration points, and why each technology was chosen.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a talk-only one. You validate your own designs by prototyping the critical path yourself, and every solution you design, you could build. Your designs must work for non-technical users — the right answer is the simple one, and sometimes it is a process change rather than a technical build.

We are an AI-native firm: we build our own tooling, automate our own operations, and hold our client work to the same standard.

🧩 What You Will Do

Roughly half of your time is client-facing pre-sales and escalation work; the other half is designing solutions for delivery teams and EVOCS's internal operations.

  • Pre-sales solutioning. Produce solution designs, architecture diagrams, and technical approach narratives for RFP responses and client proposals — strong enough that senior leadership only needs to review, not rewrite.
  • Escalation design. Parachute into escalated projects, identify what is actually wrong, and hand the team a concrete solution design within hours — components, integration route, sequence — so they know exactly what to build over the following weeks.
  • Decomposition. Take high-level business problems and break them into requirements, workflows, states, branches, and edge cases, accounting for the exceptions in advance rather than discovering them in UAT.
  • Technology selection. Choose the right platform, data store, and integration pattern for each problem — and defend the choice in front of both engineers and executives.
  • Design validation. Prototype the risky or novel part of a design yourself to prove it works before delivery commits to it.
  • Internal architecture. Design the workflows, automations, and integrations that run EVOCS's own back office, working alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers who build them out.

🧠 What You Will Bring

  • A track record of solutioning across enterprise systems: workflows, integrations, APIs, and data flows across HR, finance, ITSM, or similar platforms.
  • Elite decomposition and requirements skills — the instincts of a high-caliber technical business analyst, applied at architecture level.
  • Data literacy: data modeling and transformation, and grounded opinions on relational vs. document vs. event-log storage for a given problem.
  • Cloud fluency (Azure and/or AWS) and integration depth: API gateways, middleware, event routing, and authentication patterns.
  • Enough engineering ability to prototype: you can personally build a proof of concept for anything you design.
  • AI-native working style: you use modern AI tooling to compress design, documentation, and data work from weeks into hours.
  • Communication range: you can whiteboard with a CFO in the morning and spec an API contract with an engineer in the afternoon.
  • 8+ years across solution architecture, integration architecture, or senior engineering roles.

🚫 What This Role Is Not

  • Not a talk-only architect. If you cannot build a working proof of what you design, this is not the right role.
  • Not a project manager or delivery owner. Delivery managers own client relationships, escalation politics, resourcing, and margin.
  • Not a slide-deck factory. Your artifacts exist so something gets built, not so a meeting gets held.

🛠️ Show Us What You Build

Architecture is easy to claim and hard to verify, so we weight evidence over titles. Portfolios beat certifications here.

  • A system you designed end to end: what the problem was, what you chose, and what you would change now.
  • A prototype or proof of concept you built yourself to de-risk a design before a team committed to it.
  • An integration or data model you are proud of — or one that went wrong and taught you something.
  • A GitHub profile, an architecture writeup, a talk, or a design doc you are free to share.

Send links or short descriptions. One design you can walk through in depth beats a list of platforms you have touched.

⭐ What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Professional services or consulting experience, where architecture is scoped, billable, and defended in front of a client.
  • Depth in one or more enterprise platforms: ITSM, HR, or finance and ERP systems.
  • A pre-sales and RFP record you can describe: what you wrote, what you won, and why.
  • Event-driven architecture, message brokers, and idempotency patterns at real scale.
  • Architect-level Azure or AWS certification — useful, though never a substitute for what you have built.
  • Experience designing for distributed delivery teams across multiple time zones.
  • Working Spanish, given our Argentina delivery hub.

🤝 How We Will Work Together

You report to the Chief Technology Officer. Your designs go to senior leadership for review, not rewriting, and to delivery teams as something they can start building from on day one.

Delivery managers own the client relationship, escalation politics, resourcing, and margin. You own the design and its technical defensibility. That line is deliberate, and it holds.

You will work alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers, who build out much of what you design — for clients and for EVOCS's own back office.

Expect to move between pre-sales, a live escalation, and internal architecture in the same week. If you want to sit inside one platform doing one thing, this is the wrong role.

We are privileged to serve our loyal customer base in our mission to build lasting relationships with our clients based on trust and mutual success. Job Title:

Supplier Development Engineer

Reporting To:

Supplier Quality & Development Engineering Manager

Work Schedule:

Onsite – Torrance, CA

Moog’s Military Aircraft Group has an immediate opening for a Supplier Development Engineer.

  • Primary scope: supplier maturity, capability gaps, launch readiness, and structured risk reduction.

  • Decision posture: coordinates and drives the plan, while aligning technical and business decisions with stakeholders.

Reporting to our Supplier Quality & Development Manager. This on-site position is based in Torrance, CA (Los Angeles area) and offers a 9/80 work schedule.

To be considered for the role, here’s what you’ll need to bring with you:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Manufacturing or Mechanical preferred)

  • Minimum 3 years or more years’ experience of engineering field or Supply Chain Manufacturing Engineering

  • Experience with supplier development, APQP, industrialization, manufacturing readiness, or operations improvement

  • Ability to assess process maturity, capability evidence, and supplier execution risk

  • Strong project-management discipline with clear action tracking and follow-up

  • Clear communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders on risk, expectations, and closure plans

  • 20% to 35% travel, depending on supplier-development and readiness-assessment demand.

As a Supplier Development Engineer, you will:

  • Improve supplier capability, capacity, readiness, and execution before issues become chronic escapes by leading structured supplier-development plans and readiness assessments, including supply-chain implementation for new product introduction and work transfer.

  • Manage supplier capability, capacity, readiness, and risk assessments for assigned suppliers or programs.

  • Manage and track supplier development plans with specific owners, milestones, and closure evidence.

  • Support supplier onboarding, segmentation, capability assessment, and readiness review activities.

  • Coordinate program, sourcing, manufacturing, and quality inputs when supplier maturity is below expectation.

  • Drive clear issue definition and action ownership so development work does not fragment across teams.

  • Focuses on the following commodities: Electro-Mechanical Assemblies, Electronics, Supplier Owned IPs, and Some machining knowledge required.

NPI Implementation in Supply Chain

  • Drive supplier-development plans for NPI, new supplier onboarding, and work transfers with clear readiness gates, owners, and recovery milestones.

  • Coordinate capacity, capability, industrialization, and business-readiness actions needed to launch new parts into the supply base without fragmented ownership.

  • Maintain visibility to open NPI supplier risks and ensure they are integrated into the dashboard and weekly operating cadence.

Measurable KPIs

  • Supplier development plan milestones closed by due date >= 90%.

  • Capability / readiness assessments completed to plan >= 95%.

  • Assigned high-risk supplier actions moved from open to verified closure within target >= 90%.

  • APQP / launch-readiness deliverables completed on time for owned scope >= 95%.

  • Unowned supplier-development actions on assigned portfolio maintained at zero.

title: Strategic Programs Executive
description:
About us

Stoiximan, founded in 2012, is the leading online sports betting and gaming provider in Greece and Cyprus. The company is dedicated to evolving the gaming experience while ensuring entertainment is safe and responsible, with Responsible Gaming at the core of its mission, supported by strict policies and innovative tools.
Stoiximan maintains a broad sponsorship program, fostering strong ties with sports culture. Partnerships include Olympiacos FC, Olympiacos SFP, PAOK BC, PAOK AC, APOEL, Apollon Limassol, the Legends 2004 team, as well as major competitions such as the Stoiximan Super League, Stoiximan GBL, and the Cyprus League by Stoiximan. The company is also an Official Sponsor of the UEFA Europa League and UEFA Conference League, and supports national teams, Olympic champions, and Greek athletics through its cooperation with SEGAS and the Stoiximan Panhellenic Athletics Championships.

Since inception, Stoiximan has shown strong commitment to social responsibility through initiatives like Iroes, Young Heroes, Wheels of Change, and Empower Forward, creating impact and building a better future.

Let’s talk about the role

We are seeking a Strategic Programs Executive to lead the operational delivery of our most critical business initiatives. This role acts as a bridge between strategic vision and actionable outcomes, ensuring high-priority projects move from concept to results. As part of the project management team, you will be responsible for transforming complex organizational challenges into structured workstreams.

As a Strategic Programs Executive, you will:

1. PMO & Operations Support

  • Partner with the PMO team to track milestones and deadlines across departments, ensuring that all workstreams remain aligned and on schedule;
  • Drive the weekly project cadence by synthesizing updates and maintaining our PMO tools as the "single source of truth" for the organization;
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional leads to ensure timely buy-in, clear accountability, and smooth coordination across all project phases;
  • Act as a central point of contact for cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring clear information flow;
  • Proactively monitor project dependencies and timelines, flagging potential "red flags" before they impact delivery;
  • Map business workflows to uncover efficiencies and lead post-project retrospectives to evolve our strategic execution playbook.

2. Strategy & Executive Storytelling

  • Prepare professional presentations and briefing materials for senior leadership, converting complex strategic ideas into clear, visual narratives, while ensuring all team communications and reports meet a "board-ready" standard of clarity and quality;
  • Attend key strategic meetings to capture decisions and translate them into immediate action items and follow-ups.

3. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Perform deep-dives into business data to identify trends and provide the analytical backing for strategic decision-making;
  • Conduct ad-hoc research on industry trends and competitor moves to provide fresh "outside-in" perspectives;
  • Help build and maintain dashboards to monitor the health and KPI progress of our growth initiatives.

What you'll bring:

  • 2-3 years of experience in Management Consulting, Business Strategy, or a corporate PMO role;
  • University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field;
  • Advanced Powerpoint (storytelling & design) and Excel (modeling & analysis);
  • Familiarity with Project Management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira) and a solid understanding of Agile/Waterfall methodologies;
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) is a strong plus;
  • The ability to break down a "messy" problem into a logical framework;
  • Comfortable moving between tactical day-to-day tasks and high-level strategic thinking;
  • A 'get-things-done' attitude with the ability to follow up persistently yet professionally with cross-functional stakeholders;
  • Strong communication skills and the "social intelligence" to manage stakeholders across different levels;
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on maintaining the integrity and quality of critical company priorities from inception to delivery;
  • Comfortable moving between tactical day-to-day tasks and high-level strategic thinking;
  • Fluency in Greek and English.

Stoiximan Perks

  • 🕒 Hybrid flexibility – work your way
  • 💰 Competitive pay & annual bonus – rewarding great performance
  • 🩺 Comprehensive health & life insurance – for you and your loved ones
  • 💼 Private pension plan – investing in your future
  • 👶 Nursery/childcare voucher – supporting working parents
  • 🍽️ Monthly lunch allowance – enjoy good food on us
  • 🏃‍♂️ Onboarding buddy – because starting strong matters

title: Construction Cost Estimator
description:
Job Summary

As an employee with TCM, you will work directly with one of our valued clients (more than likely, it will be at the project site). Schedulers are expected to demonstrate technical expertise and function as a subject matter expert. Depending on the project and the client, you might have a team that reports to you in order to effectively carry out your scope of work.


A construction cost estimator prepares estimates for the costs of construction projects, such as buildings, roads, and bridges. We are looking for a detail-oriented construction estimator to advise on the foreseeable cost of each of our major developments. To this end, the construction estimator should obtain all relevant project specifications, determine the most appropriate building materials, and secure favorable prices on all resources. They should also inspect trends in construction to determine whether your estimates are both reasonable and competitive.

Construction cost estimators work closely with architects, engineers, and vendors to calculate costs. They may specialize in estimating costs for one construction trade, such as electrical, or for a specific type of construction project, such as civil engineering or structural.

Job Responsibilities:

· Work with RG/ TCM to help Owner set initial budgets for all projects

· Oversee cost estimates presented by PM firms during design at varioud design deliverables

· Oversee cost changes processed by other PM firms during construction.

· Prepares and estimates budget costs for construction by studying plans and specifications.

· Evaluates offers to purchase by site requirements, additions, and costing changes.

· Resolves cost differences by analyzing and collecting info.

· Writes up and presents budgets, reports, and project plans.

· Develops bids for construction projects.

· Works closely with architects and other professionals.

· Schedules meetings with clients, site managers, and staff.

· Navigates and understands building codes.

· Processes paperwork and travels to building sites as required.

· Monitors construction processes.

· Stays up to date with safety codes and improvements in construction.

Qualifications and Skills:

· Strong math skills including algebra, geometry, and basic arithmetic

· Ability to navigate specifications and plans

· Proficiency in demonstrating proposals and projects

· Ability to handle multiple assignments at once

· Knowledge of the latest building codes

· Close attention to detail

· Demonstrable experience as a construction estimator.

· Ability to forecast the cost of high-ticket, involved building developments.

· Knowledge of relevant technical and nontechnical documents.

· Exceptional quantitative skills.

· Outstanding research and proposal writing skills.

· Dependable, conscientious, and well-spoken.

Education and Experience Requirements:

· Degree in mechanical engineering, architecture, mathematics or a similar field is required

· At least 5 years of related experience is required

title: Meeting Planner
description:
Citrus Health Group is a new type of agency that brings an empathetic patient focus to the new product commercialization process. Citrus creates hand-picked teams that provide clients with scientific, clinical, pharmacologic, evidence-generation, pricing and reimbursement, market access, affordability, and patient support expertise and experience in their time of need. Client teams are built with talented experts who function as a fluid, agile, and highly energized team.

We are passionate about science; our focus is to effectively communicate science in compelling and engaging ways to drive true value and enable patients to gain access to new medicines. We do so with the highest level of integrity and respect for the ethical nature of our business.

We invite you to join our talented team of dedicated professionals, working closely together to provide the services our clients need, at the time they need them. We are driven by one word, RESPECT. We respect each other, we respect our clients, and we respect the professionals we work with on behalf of our clients. We value every team member and strive for an inclusive and collaborative culture that fosters the best in everyone.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a mid-level Meeting Planner to join our Meeting Services team. The ideal candidate will have experience in client-facing roles, budget management, contract negotiations, and vendor coordination, with the ability to work independently while following company planning SOPs. This role involves managing all logistical components of medical communication programming, including investigator meetings, advisory boards, symposia, congress activities, and web-based teleconferences-and requires a high level of autonomy and accountability for successful program execution.

Responsibilities

  • Manage all logistical elements of each program, including site research, invitation development, confirmations, travel, production, database management, BEO development, on-site coordination, and reporting. Travel required for on-site coordination.
  • Oversee attendee registration process, including database management, participant communications, reporting, and onsite registration desk operations.
  • Adhere to company planning SOPs to ensure consistency and accuracy.
  • Develop and communicate detailed status updates to management and clients, ensuring alignment with project timelines and expectations.
  • Act as the meetings department client-facing liaison for assigned programs, delivering proactive updates and recommendations to ensure satisfaction and program success.
  • Oversee project logistics scope, identifying and processing scope changes as needed.
  • Research and assess hotel, restaurant, and travel options, including:
    • Developing and disseminating RFPs
    • Assessing and developing availability reports to determine appropriate venue options
  • Manage program budgeting and cost projections.
  • Develop clear, concise, professional, and accurate communications for clients, attendees, hotels, travel partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage travel and accommodations for presenters and attendees with approved travel agencies, airlines, ground transportation companies, hotels, and venues.
  • Oversee menu compilation ensuring balance and accommodating various dietary needs within budget.
  • Provide recommendations for effective and budget-conscious audiovisual.
  • Process restaurant, hotel, and catering contracts/payment documentation.
  • Develop and/or manage the development and production of all meeting materials.
  • Travel to and facilitate on-site meeting coordination, managing all program requirements and events, including attendee support, audiovisual, transportation, food and beverage, onsite staff, etc.
  • Manage the full program closeout process, including reconciliation of program costs, updating budgets, ensuring all documentation is complete, and truing up with the reconciliation period.
  • Develop accurate post-meeting reports for reconciliations.
  • Follow expense reimbursement guidelines.
  • Provide final approval on all deliverables to ensure strategic objectives are met and project details are accurate.
  • Ensure compliance with Sunshine Act reporting, PhRMA Code, client-specific business rules, and EX US country-specific compliance requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation for all live meetings.
  • Support Citrus’s management standards by promoting a culture of respect, professionalism, and accountability. Team members are expected to work collaboratively across departments, demonstrate mutual support, and maintain a positive, solutions-focused approach.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Communications, or related field preferred; and 2+ years of industry-specific meeting planning experience preferred.
  • Hotel, restaurant, and travel logistics knowledge, international experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Cvent and MS Office with advanced skills in Excel.
  • Proven meeting coordination experience focusing on client relationships, budgeting, and vendor management.
  • Ability to work independently, follow company SOPs, and manage multiple programs with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to travel onsite as needed (>25%) with potential for travel over weekends and extended periods up to one week.
  • Position requires occasional nonstandard work hours in accordance with project needs, deadlines, deliverables, and urgent client needs.
  • Strong understanding of project management, budgeting, and financial processes involved in meeting logistics.
  • Must be comfortable negotiating and managing ambiguity while working on multiple meetings simultaneously.
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively to meet deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, for effective collaboration with vendors, clients, and internal teams.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.

The estimated salary for this position and similar roles Citrus may consider for applicants ranges from $65,000 to $95,000 per year. This is the approximate pay range that Citrus anticipates it will pay for this and similar positions at the time of this posting. Citrus is committed to offering fair and competitive pay for all employees; consistent with applicable law, final compensation will be determined based on the applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience, along with the position's requirements. Citrus reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

title: Escrow Officer
description:
SUMMARY

As an Escrow Closer 1 , you will assist with the escrow closing process, including compliance with lender instructions, title insurance requirements, and other written instructions. You will be the single point of contact for all parties from the time we receive the transaction through closing. You will prepare all closing documents necessary to ensure title insurance is issued at closing. High levels of accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize, multi-task, and focus on deadlines will determine your success in this role.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for effectively managing the real estate closing transaction. This position requires the Escrow Closer to exercise independent judgment and to possess the knowledge and experience necessary to efficiently handle situations which may arise during the closing process.
  • Understand the escrow process to determine what steps need to be taken to properly cure e title of properties pursuant to the conditions called for in the real estate contract and/or lender instructions.
  • Prepare all closing documents necessary to ensure title insurance is issued at closing.
  • Secure all documents (corrective and others) that may be required for the issuance of title insurance.
  • Single point of contact for borrowers, loan officers, processors and others.
  • Assist customers and clients with closing related questions.
  • Prior to disbursement, confirm all funds are collected, all appropriate documents are checked for accuracy, signatures are collected, and acknowledgements and legal descriptions are correct.
  • Collect all taxes due, HOA dues, and any delinquencies and/or principal and interest.
  • Verify against the closing disclosure or settlement that all disbursements have been paid correctly.
  • Prior to recording, verify all legal documents for correct acknowledgements, legal, and lien information.
  • Manage and develop client relationships to ensure future real estate closing transactions.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Customer-first: you care deeply about our customers (Borrowers, Lenders and internal customers) and you understand that we exist, first and foremost, to serve a customer's needs.
  • Solutions-orientation: you thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, and are able to shift gears comfortably. You can decide and act without having the total picture.
  • Both a thinker and a “doer”: you’re a strategic thinker who can go deep on a business and understand its core drivers, and how various processes throughout the business interplay with each other. You’re biased towards action, and have a knack for making things work, even with limited resources.
  • A creative problem solver: you have a proven track record of thinking “outside the box” to solve complicated problems. You have a global perspective, sound business judgment, and are truth-seeking in your solutioning and decisioning. You are also willing to roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to solve the problem.
  • Highly collaborative: you’re a strong communicator with the ability to motivate, inspire, and influence cross-functional teams. You’re a natural planner and organizer, and can effectively manage bandwidth and resources inside and outside your organization to bring about the successful completion of key objectives and initiatives.
  • Eager to drive impact: you believe results matter. You’re motivated to drive improvements in the business as reflected in operating metrics, our P&L, and reduced pain points for internal and external customers.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • A minimum of 1-3 years’ experience in the title and escrow industry
  • Excellent customer service skills are required, including the ability to interact professionally and knowledgeably with Borrowers, Loan officers, Processors, and Underwriters
  • Familiarity with Refinance transactions and requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of the escrow process and mortgage lending regulations
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills. Deadline-driven.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams


Preferred Qualifications:


Minimum 1 year of experience in escrow closing

  • Experience with Qualia/Resware is strongly preferred. Experience with Softpro or similar software will also be considered.
  • Multi-state residential closing experience strongly preferred


Work Schedule:

  • Flexible scheduling available, including late shifts to support extended operating hours.


  • Saturday work may be required based on volume or deadlines.


  • Standard shifts typically fall between 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time, with late shifts ranging from 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM or 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM, depending on team needs.


  • All work is performed remotely, supporting refinance transactions nationwide.

title: Senior Infrastructure Pre-Sales Architect
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a strategic and technically adept Senior Infrastructure Pre-Sales Architect to join our team. In this role, you will act as a trusted, independent advisor to our clients, helping them navigate complex infrastructure decisions. Your primary focus will be designing tailored solutions across an ecosystem of market leading vendors that meet the customers technical, business and financial needs.


Must have: Experience Operating within a fast-paced Technology Advisor, Value-Added Reseller (VAR), Managed Services Provider (MSP), and/or Systems Integrator (SI) environment, where you bridge the gap between technical reality, business needs and leveraging vendors to get your clients what they need..

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

1. Client Advisory & Financial Architecture

  • Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Analysis: Lead financial modeling engagements to help clients evaluate the economic trade-offs of Hyperscalers (Public Cloud) vs. Private
  • Architecture Approach and Strategy: Advise and document our client’s architecture, and facilitate solution design from vendors based on the architecture needs of our customers
  • Business Case Development: Translate complex technical architectures into compelling business justifications and financial presentations for C-level executives (CIO, CTO, CFO).

2. Solution Architecture & Pre-Sales Engineering

  • Discover & Design: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to understand client business outcomes, technical requirements, and pain points. In a cloud environment, provide guidance on client application workloads to determine the most cost-effective, secure, and performant hosting environments.
  • End-to-End Scoping: Author, often with our Vendors, comprehensive Statements of Work (SOWs), High-Level Designs (HLDs), partner with Vendors for Bill of Materials (BOMs), and technical proposals that blend hardware, software, and professional/managed services, including security and an understanding of our vendor ecosystem’s portfolio
  • Vendor-Agnostic Advocacy: Maintain an independent worldview to evaluate, recommend, and assemble the absolute best-of-breed solutions for the client, free from rigid vendor bias that comes from the legacy VAR world.

3. Collaboration & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Client Directors to drive pipeline velocity, increase deal sizes, and achieve revenue targets.
  • Delivery Hand-off: Ensure seamless transition of won business from the pre-sales phase to the post-sales delivery and engineering teams.
  • Thought Leadership: Establish a strong point of view over time of where client architectures, best practices, and top tier vendor solutions are today and where they are going

Ideal Experience and Qualifications

  • Industry Background: Minimum of 7 years of pre-sales architecture experience specifically within a Technology Advisor, VAR, MSP, or Systems Integration (SI) firm.
  • Services Integration: Proven track record of architecting complex solutions that successfully wrap hardware/software technology with professional and managed services.
  • Hybrid/Multi-Cloud Expertise: Deep architectural understanding of major Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside Private Cloud stacks (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Pure, etc).
  • Core Infrastructure: Strong foundations in traditional data center technologies, including enterprise storage, compute, networking, and hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
  • Financial Literacy: Strong proficiency in CapEx vs. OpEx models (including TCO for Hyperscalers, Private Clouds and Hybrid environments. Foundational grasp of cloud consumption economics, and cloud financial management (FinOps).
  • Consultative Mindset: Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills; ability to command a room ranging from system administrators to CFOs.
  • Stakeholder Management: You’ll be working with the trusted clients and long term relationships of experienced Founders and sales people while triangulating with vendors across our ecosystem.
  • Autonomy: Ability to thrive in a highly independent, self-driven environment.

title: Strategic Data & Analytics Engineer (Cloud Data & Agentic Infrastructure)
description:
The Role

We are seeking a forward-thinking, consultative Data & Analytics Engineer to design, build, and maintain enterprise marketing data models, ontologies, and semantic context layers. In this role, you will act as a strategic bridge between business leaders and technical execution—partnering directly with clients to understand their strategic goals and translating those business requirements into scalable, warehouse-native data infrastructure.

Beyond core data engineering, you will spearhead how our clients' data ecosystems adapt to an evolving agentic future. You will architect the semantic models and data integration patterns required to power autonomous AI agents, both native to modern cloud data platforms (such as Databricks and Snowflake) and across connected MarTech platforms (such as Salesforce, Hightouch).

What You'll Accomplish

  • Consultative Requirements & Architecture: Partner with key business stakeholders to uncover core business goals, mapping complex business domain needs into unified data engineering solutions, semantic layers, and robust warehouse architectures.
  • Agentic & AI Data Readiness: Architect forward-looking context layers and semantic models designed specifically for AI/LLM-driven engines and autonomous agents—ensuring data ecosystems (from modern cloud warehouses to activation platforms like Hightouch and Salesforce) are structured for reliable execution.
  • Taxonomy & Metadata Engineering: Design scalable data models (e.g. Medallion/Multi-layer architectures) to house controlled classification hierarchies, unified asset tags, and standardized business glossaries across marketing channels.
  • Identity & Semantic Modeling: Build and maintain deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution models and graph-like bridge tables to resolve customer identities across CRM IDs, device tokens, and digital touchpoints.
  • Cross-System Pipeline Integration: Lead the technical integration of complex cross-system datasets, developing high-performance ingestion and transformation pipelines to unify marketing metadata, CDP activation models, DAM content, and real-time telemetry.
  • Data Governance & Quality: Implement enterprise governance, business glossaries, access controls, and data cataloging (e.g., Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon) to enable secure self-service analytics and reliable AI execution.

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture building production-grade data pipelines and semantic models.
  • 2+ years in a client-facing, consultative, or strategic lead role—demonstrated ability to run discovery, map business goals to technical architectures, and present solutions to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Willing to travel 25% a year and up to twice a quarter minimum.
  • Consultative Mindset: Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, translate non-technical business strategies into clear technical specifications, and articulate technical trade-offs to executives and cross-functional teams.
  • Strategic Vision for AI/Agents: A keen interest in the shift toward agentic AI, with an understanding of how data modeling, semantics, and context layers must adapt to support autonomous workflows across data platforms and marketing engines.
  • Cloud Data Platform Expertise: Hands-on experience designing production pipelines and semantic data models across modern cloud data platforms, with deep expertise in Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent architectures.
  • Advanced Data Engineering Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/PySpark, data pipeline orchestration, and modern data stack tooling (e.g., dbt).
  • Domain & Integration Knowledge: Experience with marketing technology (MarTech), Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), reverse ETL tools (e.g., Hightouch, Census), and enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, CRMs).
  • Data Modeling Fundamentals: Proven track record in multi-dimensional schema design, identity resolution modeling, graph/hierarchical structures, and API payload parsing (nested JSON/REST).
  • Relevant Certifications (Preferred): Professional Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer certifications in Databricks or Snowflake.

Preferred Certifications

  • Databricks: Certified Data Engineer Professional or Certified Analytics Engineer.
  • Snowflake: SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced Architect.
  • dbt: dbt Cloud Developer Certification.

Mindset

  • Forward-Thinking AI Perspective: Active interest and practical awareness of agentic AI concepts (e.g., tool use, LLM context retrieval, autonomous agent workflows) and how data modeling must evolve to serve them.
  • Remote & Autonomous: Ability to manage complex deliverables independently in a distributed, fast-paced environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
  • Remote flexibility
  • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
  • Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

Why SH/FT:

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SH/FT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

Comp & Benefits

The US salary range for this role is $120,000 to $140,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

title: Senior Software Engineer II, Ads Data Solutions Engineering
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Ads DSE team builds the core capabilities that power Instacart's off-platform advertising, secure data collaboration (cleanrooms), automated taxonomy management, and their associated platform foundations. We are hiring a Senior Engineer II (L6) to co-own the technical roadmap, modernize our data solutions infrastructure, scale off-platform integrations and measurement capabilities, extend our cleanroom collaboration capabilities, and automate taxonomy change management workflows. This role is pivotal for cross-team collaboration, developer productivity, and AI-driven development initiatives.

You are a senior technical leader who designs and ships scalable, data‑intensive systems; drives cross‑team execution; and raises engineering standards. You’ll partner closely with Product, Data Science, Data Platform, and Governance teams to build reusable abstractions and deliver high‑impact features across our pillars: Off‑platform, Data collaboration (cleanrooms), Ads Taxonomy, Platform, and New Initiatives (AI). You will mentor L4/L5 engineers, act as an IC tech lead (no direct reports), and help define a future on‑call model and SLOs.

About the Job

  • Technical leadership and roadmap
    • Lead architecture for reusable, scalable systems across off‑platform workflows, cleanrooms, taxonomy automation, and the Ads Data Solutions Platform.
    • Evolve core abstractions, testing, CI/CD, observability, and cost efficiency; proactively drive modernization.
    • Propose and drive initiatives on behalf of engineering management; align stakeholders and manage dependencies.
  • Pillar execution
    • Off‑platform: expand and harden integrations with external advertising platforms; design privacy-forward activation and identity workflows; reduce reliance on third-party intermediaries; and build measurement ingestion pipelines for performance signals such as reach, frequency, and conversions.
    • Data collaboration (cleanrooms): extend our cleanroom orchestration and governance tooling (multi-cleanroom support, policy enforcement), develop reusable query templates and partner configurations, optimize pipelines for cost and performance, and scale secure data collaboration deployment and management.
    • Ads Taxonomy: lead intake automation (UI + backend) and release workflow improvements to reduce manual effort and cycle time.
    • Platform: assist with platform modernization and developer tooling improvements; contribute to an on‑call/SLO strategy as we mature operations.
  • AI‑first engineering
    • Use AI‑assisted tools daily for design, coding, tests, and docs; define team prompt patterns and workflows; identify AI opportunities in internal tools and ops.
  • Product quality, privacy, and security
    • Translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic phases (POC, pilot, production) with clear SLAs/SLOs.
    • Champion security‑by‑design, data governance, and privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR/CCPA) across pipelines.
  • Mentorship and collaboration
    • Mentor engineers up to L5; set code quality and review standards.
    • Build cross‑team partnerships (Ads Manager, Measurement Science, Data Platform, Privacy/Legal, and external platforms).

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven senior‑level impact
    • 8+ years of software engineering experience (typically 10+ for this level) delivering and operating large‑scale backend/data systems; led cross‑team projects and architectural decisions.
  • Backend and data engineering
    • Strong in Python and one of Ruby or Go; services/APIs (REST/gRPC); integrations with third‑party APIs (e.g., Meta, Google, The Trade Desk).
    • Data pipelines with DBT and Airflow; Spark/Databricks; advanced SQL and performance tuning.
    • Snowflake and AWS experience; cost‑aware design; workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal) and event‑driven patterns.
  • Ads/cleanrooms/privacy
    • Experience with ad‑tech/programmatic and measurement integrations; cleanrooms (Snowflake DCR, shares/listings); identity/matching (UID2, RampID) and deconfliction.
    • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance practices (GDPR/CCPA) in data workflows.
  • Platform excellence
    • CI/CD, containers, test strategy; observability (metrics/logs/tracing) with tools like Datadog; incident readiness and SLO thinking.
  • AI fluency (must‑have)
    • Demonstrated, recent hands‑on use of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI‑based assistants) to improve speed and quality.
    • Experience defining reusable prompts/workflows for team use and contributing to AI‑enabled internal tools or automation.
    • Ability to evaluate when to apply AI vs. deterministic systems; familiarity with evaluation, guardrails, and security/privacy implications in AI usage.
  • Collaboration and communication
    • Clear technical writing; stakeholder management; ability to drive consensus and unblock execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with UID2/TTD integrations, Roku/Pubmatic/NBCU, or Meta Advanced Analytics/Google ADH pipelines.
  • Catalog/taxonomy, entity lineage, or custom hierarchy systems.
  • Snowflake governance patterns, partner data collaboration at scale.
  • Vendor/partner management and external API certification programs.
  • Building AI‑powered internal tools (e.g., Slackbots, data assistants).

Why this role is a great opportunity....

  • Lead foundational, high‑visibility initiatives and translate them into measurable impact on revenue, efficiency, and partner adoption.
  • Co‑own the technical roadmap with scope to define abstractions, standards, and AI‑first workflows across multiple pillars.
  • Ship impactful features end‑to‑end: direct UID2 activation, Share Manager extensions, taxonomy intake automation, and platform modernization.
  • Collaborate with strong cross‑functional partners and enjoy occasional trips to our Toronto office to connect with the broader engineering community.
  • Help define our future on‑call model and operational excellence standards as we scale.

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

title: GIS Data Expert
description:
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in GIS data conversion, cleansing, validation, and quality assurance, with a proven track record in converting utilities and infrastructure as-built drawings and data into structured, accurate, and topologically valid Enterprise GIS datasets.

The role will involve working closely with GIS teams, technical stakeholders, and clients to ensure the quality, accuracy, connectivity, and integrity of enterprise GIS data and support utilities and infrastructure data transformation initiatives.

1. GIS Data Conversion & Transformation

  • Convert utilities and infrastructure as-built drawings and data into structured GIS datasets.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and preparation for Enterprise GIS environments.
  • Ensure converted datasets comply with defined GIS data models, standards, and specifications.

2. GIS Data Quality Assurance & Validation

  • Conduct comprehensive GIS data validation and QA/QC activities.
  • Identify and resolve spatial, attribute, topology, and connectivity issues.
  • Ensure GIS datasets meet defined accuracy, completeness, consistency, and quality requirements.
  • Validate network connectivity and applicable spatial and topological rules.

3. Utilities & Infrastructure GIS

  • Work with utilities, infrastructure, and land-related GIS datasets.
  • Understand spatial relationships, network structures, and topological behaviors across utility and infrastructure assets.
  • Apply appropriate validation and connectivity rules to ensure data integrity.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reliable Enterprise GIS datasets.

4. Enterprise GIS & Geodatabase Management

  • Work extensively with the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem, particularly ArcGIS Pro and Enterprise Geodatabases.
  • Support the development and implementation of enterprise geodatabase structures.
  • Work with feature classes, relationships, domains, subtypes, topology, and network-related data structures.
  • Ensure GIS data is properly structured and maintained according to enterprise requirements.

5. GIS Data Automation & Process Improvement

Develop and automate GIS data transformation and ETL workflows using Python, ArcGIS ModelBuilder, and/or FME.

  • Identify opportunities to improve GIS data conversion, validation, and QA/QC processes.
  • Support the optimization and standardization of GIS data management workflows.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geomatics, Geography, Surveying, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Additional qualifications in GIS or spatial data management are preferred.

Professional Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience specifically in utilities and infrastructure as-built conversion to GIS.
  • Strong experience in GIS data extraction, conversion, cleansing, validation, and QA/QC.
  • Strong experience working with utilities, infrastructure, and land GIS datasets.
  • Experience with spatial relationships, topological behaviors, network connectivity, and GIS validation rules.
  • Experience working with Enterprise GIS environments.
  • Experience in consulting or client-facing environments is preferred.
  • Candidates must be native Arabic speakers.
  • Ability to join as soon as possible due to the urgency of the requirement.

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem.
  • Strong proficiency in ArcGIS Pro.
  • Strong experience with Enterprise Geodatabases.
  • Knowledge of GIS data conversion, cleansing, validation, and QA/QC.
  • Knowledge of GIS topology and network connectivity.
  • Experience with Python, ArcGIS ModelBuilder, and/or FME for GIS data transformation and ETL automation is preferred.
  • Knowledge of enterprise geodatabase design, including:
    • Feature classes
    • Relationships
    • Domains
    • Subtypes
    • Topology
    • Network-related data structures
  • Understanding of satellite imagery types, characteristics, applications, and major satellite imagery/data vendors is preferred.

Certifications

  • Esri-related GIS certifications.
  • Professional GIS, Geomatics, or related certifications.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and data quality.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Consulting and client-facing mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and support urgent project requirements.

Language Requirements

  • English: Professional proficiency.
  • Arabic: Native / Fluent.

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Business Unit: Strategy & Transformation

title: Controller
description:
In a world of noise, we find the signal — the pulse of potential. We weave the strands of talent, vision, and purpose into organizations that endure. Blending intelligence with intuition, we honor the human art of connection at the heart of every great company.

About the Job

We are partnered with a private family office overseeing a diversified real estate investment, development, and property management portfolio in Los Angeles on the search for its next Controller. This is a hands-on financial leadership role with direct ownership of the accounting function, serving as a core member of the finance team.

The portfolio spans commercial real estate holdings, including shopping centers, and requires a Controller who can maintain accurate, audit-ready books while supporting lenders, tax reporting, and day-to-day property operations.

This person will be responsible for owning cash management, financial reporting, and compliance end-to-end, while bringing the accuracy, discretion, and rigor this ownership structure requires.

The Mandate

This organization is very clear about what it is — and is not — seeking.

They are not looking for a Controller who only reviews numbers after the fact, or one unwilling to stay hands-on with day-to-day accounting operations.

They are seeking a builder–operator of the finance function: a Controller who can manage cash, own reporting, supervise staff, and keep a complex commercial real estate portfolio's books accurate, compliant, and audit-ready — end to end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage cash, including loan paydowns and draws.
  • Prepare financial statements for internal review, lenders, and government agencies' tax reporting.
  • Supervise accounts receivable, including accurate tenant billing of rent and CAM, and posting of tenant receipts.
  • Oversee CAM reconciliation and collection.
  • Supervise monthly reconciliations of the general ledger.
  • Prepare and file all local and tax returns, including city business licenses, permits, and personal property taxes.
  • Coordinate submission of year-end financials to the CPA for tax return preparation.
  • Provide back-up coverage for accounts payable management, including vendor documentation and 1099 processing, monthly bank reconciliations, property tax appeals documentation, collections, and other accounting functions.
  • Review lender loan statements to validate interest charged and loan balances.
  • Prepare monthly 401(k) spreadsheets reflecting employee/employer contributions for transmittal to the plan administrator.
  • Generate and submit semi-monthly payroll to the payroll provider.
  • Maintain and update real estate schedules and other databases.
  • Oversee accounting staff.

Ideal Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting (minimum).
  • 5-7 years minimum accounting experience in commercial (shopping center) real estate.
  • Proficiency in Yardi Voyager (version 7s and later updates).
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office (version 2024 and later upgrades), and proficient in Excel and Claude AI.
  • Adept at planning and analyzing financial information.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities and relationships.
  • Energetic team player who works well with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience overseeing accounting staff.

Location & Work Model

  • Los Angeles, California
  • On-site

Compensation

  • Base salary: $135,000.00 to $165,000 DOE
  • Benefits: Paid time off, health insurance sharing, 401(k), direct deposit, and paid parking.

$135,000—$165,000 USD

title: Product Lead
description:
Description

Thanks are looking for a Product Lead to drive our technical product strategy as we scale, rapidly and globally. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of advertising technology - you will work closely with our founders, CTO, product and engineering team to refine our product vision, align priorities, and ensure we build an innovative, scalable, and unbeatable ad network.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute the technical product strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals while bringing structure through effective prioritization
  • Work closely with our high-performing engineering team to translate business objectives into actionable development plans
  • Lead AI and automation initiatives to increase team output and efficiency - potentially developing Thanks' AI strategy
  • Analyse user behavior, market trends, and data insights to support informed product decisions
  • Run benefit analysis (both short-term and long-term) to guide product strategy
  • Own the end-to-end technical product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch and iteration
  • Define key metrics that quantify our USP and build a roadmap around these insights
  • Get deep in the weeds with engineers - writing tickets, grooming backlogs, and solving technical challenges
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create seamless and engaging ad experiences for our partners and customers

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Product management experience across various technology environments, including startup or scaleup settings
  • Technical product background with a thorough understanding of modern software engineering; able to "speak code" and keep pace with a high-performing engineering team
  • Expertise working with data, automation, and ideally AI to increase team output and efficiency
  • Aptitude for quickly digesting complex topics and translating them into actionable insights
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong numerical literacy and data analysis skills
  • Owner mentality; self-starter with a bias for action who can identify problems and solve them rapidly
  • Ability to bring structure through rigorous prioritisation, while remaining comfortable with the chaos of a high-growth environment
  • Strong-willed yet empathetic leadership style with outstanding collaborative skills
  • Entrepreneurial thinking, ability to "outsmart" with innovative ideas and approaches

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of or experience with adtech (though definitely not required - we have internal expertise)
  • Experience working in the US or with US-based teams
  • Experience as a founder or in an early-stage startup
  • Computer science or engineering background, or experience building software products for fun - we don’t need you to be able to code, but we do need you to love creating complex technical products

Benefits

Why Join Thanks?

Joining Thanks means becoming part of a Sydney-based, global-from-day-one, well-funded startup tackling one of advertising's biggest challenges: ad fatigue. We're redefining ad experiences with industry-leading engagement that not only captivates but also delights and rewards consumers.

Here's why you'll love working with us:

  • Direct Impact: Your work will shape our products and trajectory as we scale rapidly
  • Work with Founders: Report directly to the CEO and work closely with the founding team
  • Ownership and Autonomy: We'll give you the right tools, freedom, and collaborative environment to succeed and achieve your biggest goals
  • Competitive Package: Enjoy a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and stock options
  • Growth Trajectory: Thrive in an environment of rapid change, constant challenges, and endless opportunities
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a benefits package designed to support your needs and wellbeing
  • Flexibility: Work flexibly, with two required days (Tuesdays and Thursdays) at our Bridge Street office in Sydney

We're tackling big challenges in advertising technology by creating our own ecosystem - not copying what exists. If you're excited to innovate, influence, and grow at a rapidly scaling company, we'd love to hear from you - let’s build something extraordinary together!

title: Publications Technology Specialist
description:
Citrus Health Group is a new type of agency that brings an empathetic patient focus to the new product commercialization process. Citrus creates hand-picked teams that provide clients with scientific, clinical, pharmacologic, evidence-generation, pricing and reimbursement, market access, affordability, and patient support expertise and experience in their time of need. Client teams are built with talented experts who function as a fluid, agile, and highly energized team.

We are passionate about science; our focus is to effectively communicate science in compelling and engaging ways to drive true value and enable patients to gain access to new medicines. We do so with the highest level of integrity and respect for the ethical nature of our business.

We invite you to join our talented team of dedicated professionals, working closely together to provide the services our clients need, at the time they need them. We are driven by one word, RESPECT. We respect each other, we respect our clients, and we respect the professionals we work with on behalf of our clients. We value every team member and strive for an inclusive and collaborative culture that fosters the best in everyone.

We are seeking Publications Technology Specialist to join our Medical Communications (MedComms) team who will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and ongoing management of scientific publication management systems used to support client publication planning and execution within a medical communications environment. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for publication databases and related technologies, ensuring data integrity, operational efficiency, compliance, and seamless support for internal teams and external clients.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in scientific publication platforms such as iEnvision, PubsHub, Pubstrat, or comparable publication planning and tracking systems. The individual will partner closely with publication leads, account teams, clients, and vendors to maintain high-quality publication data and enable effective publication planning, tracking, reporting, and compliance activities.

Key Responsibilities

Publication Database Administration & Management

  • Serve as the primary administrator and internal expert for publication management systems and databases.
  • Manage day-to-day maintenance, configuration, updates, troubleshooting, and optimization of publication platforms.
  • Maintain accurate and current publication records, including manuscripts, congress presentations, abstracts, timelines, authorship details, and associated metadata.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and integrity of data across systems and reporting tools.
  • Oversee system permissions, user access, role assignments, and security protocols.
  • Coordinate software upgrades, enhancements, integrations, and vendor-supported initiatives.

Client & Stakeholder Support

  • Partner with client publication teams to support review and deadline tracking of any projects moving through system.
  • Provide system onboarding, user training, guidance, and ongoing support to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain user guides, SOPs, workflows, and best practices documentation related to publications database use.
  • Respond to user inquiries and troubleshoot system or data-related issues in a timely manner.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal teams and software vendors.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Generate routine and ad hoc publication reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytics for internal teams from publications database.
  • Support tracking of ongoing reviews, review deadlines, and compliance reporting.
  • Assist teams with extracting and interpreting publication data to support business and client needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and operational efficiencies.

Compliance & Process Excellence

  • Work with Client Services and Project Manager leads to ensure publication systems and processes align with applicable industry standards, client requirements, and compliance expectations.
  • Support client publications database audit readiness through accurate documentation and data management practices.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance data quality, operational effectiveness, and user experience.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of publication operations workflows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with publication professionals, project management, IT, medical writers, account teams, and clients to support successful publication delivery.
  • Participate in strategic initiatives related to publication systems, data governance, and operational scalability.
  • Support integration of publication databases with other operational or reporting platforms where applicable.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience managing scientific publication databases or publication management systems within a medical communications, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare environment.
  • Demonstrated mastery of publication management platforms, including systems such as iEnvision, PubsHub, Pubstrat, or similar tools.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in publication database administration and data management.
  • Strong understanding of publication lifecycle management and scientific publication workflows.
  • Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, and data exports.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and familiarity with data visualization or business intelligence tools is a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance, quality control, and system administration principles.

Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced client services environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Highly organized with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within medical communications agencies or publication planning organizations.
  • Familiarity with publication compliance standards, authorship tracking, and congress planning processes.
  • Experience supporting global publication teams and external stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of system implementation, migration, or integration projects preferred.

title: Director, Deal Execution & Legal – Energy & Microgrids
description:
Edged has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s data center infrastructure. We are seeking a Director, Deal Execution & Legal – Energy & Microgrids to work directly with high-impact, complex energy and power transactions across our U.S. project portfolio, including microgrids, on-site power generation, gas-fired generation, and renewable energy solutions serving hyperscale data centers.

This role is our first dedicated legal transactions hired on the energy side and so will cover a broad mandate, from power joint venture formations and equipment supply agreements to PPAs, energy services agreements, gas supply arrangements, and project finance closings. The right person brings both legal depth and strong commercial judgment, and is comfortable taking senior leadership’s direction on deal strategy and running with it through execution. You will support term sheet negotiations, manage outside counsel through definitive documentation, and ensure that our agreements reflect how we think about risk, economics, and control.

Edged is highly selective about the people we bring on board because our mission depends on it. Progress happens quickly and we must be able to trust one another to be transparent, communicative, strategic, reliable, and driven. We seek ultra-creatives and superstar performers with a sense of humility and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. We offer flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  • Support the structuring and negotiation of power and energy joint ventures, partnerships, and co-investment arrangements, including multi-tiered PowerCo / project company structures, LLC agreements, term sheets, etc.
  • Support negotiation of PPAs, energy services agreements, and microgrid / behind-the-meter energy infrastructure agreements with data center operators and other large-load customers
  • Support negotiation of equipment supply agreements (generators, turbines, fuel cells, BESS, etc.) and O&M agreements, including warranties, performance guarantees, SLAs, governance, exits, etc.
  • Support negotiation of natural gas supply and transport agreements, pipeline construction agreements, utility interconnection agreements, and related energy infrastructure contracts
  • Support project finance transactions, working with lenders and financial advisors on commitment letters, loan documentation, guaranty agreements, security packages, and intercreditor arrangements
  • Support EPC / GMP construction contracting for power generation and microgrid facilities, including back-to-back flow-down of customer obligations to contractors
  • Direct and manage outside counsel, conveying deal strategy, assigning workstreams, reviewing work product, and ensuring the business perspective is reflected in all documentation; manage legal budgets and timelines
  • Advise on intellectual property matters related to transactions, ensuring the company’s proprietary technology is appropriately protected through ownership provisions, licensing structures, and collateral carve-outs
  • Conduct commercial and legal due diligence on potential partners, co-venturers, lenders, and counterparties; provide strategic advisory on credit risk, structural risk, and deal alignment
  • Support deal execution end-to-end, from term sheet through close, balancing legal rigor with commercial objectives

Skills & Requirements

Education / Experience

  • JD from accredited law school
  • Barred in at least one U.S. State or the District of Columbia
  • 7–12 years of experience in transactional work related to energy, power generation, or project development, with meaningful time spent on the principal or sponsor side, or at a law firm advising developers, sponsors, or independent power producers on similar transactions
  • Experience in microgrids, distributed energy resources, gas-fired generation, or renewables, strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with gas supply, transport, and pipeline construction agreements, strongly preferred
  • Experience with energy infrastructure serving data centers or other mission-critical loads, strongly preferred
  • Experience with technology licensing or IP protection in joint venture structures, strongly preferred
  • Prior in-house experience at an infrastructure developer, independent power producer, or energy-focused investment platform, strongly preferred

Specific Skills / Abilities

  • Self-starter with exceptional judgment and business acumen; strong commercial mindset and enjoys being close to the business
  • Hands-on experience negotiating JV/LLC agreements, PPAs, equipment supply agreements, and project finance loan documents
  • Working knowledge of U.S. energy regulatory frameworks relevant to on-site generation, interconnection, and retail/wholesale power sales
  • Proven ability to manage outside counsel effectively, reviewing output, and holding firms accountable to the business objectives of each deal
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and balancing legal precision with business strategy
  • High emotional intelligence with excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to build trust with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Track record of independently handling complex deals and translating legal considerations into actionable business guidance
  • Comfortable working as the sole dedicated transactions professional initially, partnering directly with senior leadership and outside counsel
  • Desire to grow with an ambitious, scaling organization

Great Place to Work

Enjoy…

A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.
A flexible, autonomous work environment.
A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.
Growth and travel opportunities.
A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

About Edged

Edged is a fast-growing global network of carbon neutral, zero-water data centers that lead the industry in energy efficiency. The Edged platform is backed by a deep technology stack including advanced waterless cooling, renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment and currently has more than a dozen major projects in construction worldwide, with many more in development.

​​​​Position: Director, Deal Execution & Legal – Energy & Microgrids
