  • Communicate clearly about what you are building, why it matters, progress updates, risks, and key learnings.
  • Identify gaps and interdependencies across systems and proactively ship solutions that improve organizational efficiency.
  • Facilitate brainstorming and strategy sessions, distilling complexity into products that solve real problems.

What You’ll Do: 30-60-90 Day Plan

First 30 Days: Learn, Align, and Build Context

In your first 30 days, you will develop a deep understanding of EllieMD’s business, customers, Brand Partner model, product ecosystem, operational workflows, and strategic priorities:

  • Build a deep understanding of EllieMD’s mission, healthcare platform, Brand Partner network, customer experience, current product priorities, and cross-functional workflows.
  • Meet with key stakeholders across Leadership, Product, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Compliance, Fulfillment, Customer Support, Data, and Go-to-Market to understand goals, pain points, constraints, and dependencies.
  • Map the end-to-end customer and Brand Partner experience across digital touchpoints, physical product flows, fulfillment, support, compliance, and operational handoffs to identify early risks, gaps, and opportunities.

First 60 Days: Prioritize, Define, and Drive Execution

By 60 days, you will begin translating business strategy, customer needs, Brand Partner insights, and operational realities into clear product priorities and execution plans:

  • Synthesize learnings from stakeholders, customers, Brand Partners, data, operations, and market context into clear product insights, roadmap recommendations, and success metrics.
  • Own or co-own one or more product areas or initiatives, creating clear PRDs, user stories, technical requirements, operational workflows, launch plans, and post-launch support requirements.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized backlog that balances customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, operational readiness, compliance, physical product dependencies, and scalability.

First 90 Days: Ship, Measure, and Scale Impact

By 90 days, you will be actively driving product outcomes, improving execution quality, and helping EllieMD ship products and experiences that work reliably across digital, physical, operational, and customer-facing environments:

  • Lead one or more product initiatives from concept through launch, iteration, or measurable milestone completion in partnership with Product, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Compliance, Fulfillment, Support, Brand Partner, and Go-to-Market teams.
  • Ensure product launches are supported by clear requirements, operational readiness, quality checks, compliance considerations, fulfillment plans, support documentation, success metrics, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Use data, customer feedback, Brand Partner insights, support trends, and operational learnings to improve the product, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and shape the roadmap for future growth.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven ability to build and scale products from early stages.
  • Experience building or managing products in hardware, connected devices, physical products, healthcare products, regulated products, supply chain-heavy environments, or operationally complex systems.
  • Strong hardware-oriented product mindset, with the ability to think beyond screens and software flows into real-world usage, operations, fulfillment, quality, reliability, compliance, and customer support.
  • Ability to translate business and user needs into product requirements that account for both digital experiences and physical product constraints.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, which may include Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Vendors, Compliance, Quality, Customer Support, and Go-to-Market stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of how product decisions affect downstream execution, including sourcing, vendor coordination, launch readiness, fulfillment, onboarding, support, and customer satisfaction.
  • Strong track record of balancing user experience and technical scalability in products you have built.
  • Data-driven approach, with experience digging into data, defining clear goals, and driving teams to ship products that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven ability to translate strategic vision into products that customers use and love.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hardware products, connected health devices, consumer health products, medical devices, diagnostics, wellness products, or other physical-product-driven businesses.
  • Experience working with hardware/software ecosystems where digital interfaces, operational workflows, and physical goods must work together seamlessly.
  • Familiarity with product development cycles that include vendor management, supply chain planning, quality assurance, packaging, fulfillment, logistics, inventory, returns, or customer support operations.
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-heavy physical product environments, including healthcare, FDA-regulated products, consumer health, wellness, medical devices, or diagnostics.
  • Experience partnering with external manufacturers, vendors, distributors, fulfillment partners, or operational teams.
  • Experience in startups, healthcare, health-tech, or wellness industries.
  • Experience with e-commerce, subscription systems, or marketplace platforms.
  • Familiarity with direct sales, MLM, affiliate, or partner network models.
  • Experience working with regulated industries or compliance frameworks, such as HIPAA, FDA, or healthcare compliance.
  • Proficiency with product management and collaboration tools such as Linear, Figma, Miro, or similar platforms.
  • Technical background or strong fluency in working with engineering teams.

Who You Are

  • A product manager with a hardware-informed mindset who understands that product quality depends on the entire end-to-end experience, not just the software interface.
  • Someone who can think across digital, physical, operational, and customer experience layers to build products that work in the real world.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in environments where software, hardware, supply chain, compliance, operations, and customer experience intersect.
  • A systems thinker who understands dependencies across physical products, digital tools, operational workflows, partner enablement, and end-user outcomes.
  • Someone who can pressure-test ideas against real-world constraints, including feasibility, cost, timing, reliability, compliance, fulfillment, and supportability.
  • A builder who thrives at the intersection of vision, systems, and execution, and ships products that prove it.
  • Someone who can think strategically while remaining hands-on in shipping and iterating on products.
  • Deeply customer-focused and committed to understanding user needs and building products that solve real pain points.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and resourceful, with the ability to drive products from concept to launch.
  • A strong communicator who creates clarity and alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working side-by-side with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to build high-quality products.
  • Passionate about improving healthcare experiences and building products that support both customers and partners.
  • Aligned with EllieMD’s core values: Accountability, Collaboration, Excellence, Integrity, and Care.

Compensation & Structure

  • Benefits: Planned upon full-time conversion.

title: Vice President of Product Development
description:
Why we need you

Springboard Collaborative invites talented and passionate candidates to apply for the position of (internal title - Product Development Leader). The Vice President of Product Development will be responsible for overseeing both curriculum and application development to align the organization's product strategy with overall enterprise goals. A successful candidate will have experience in managing large teams, developing and driving product/service roadmaps, and implementing high-fidelity services in early education classrooms. This is a remote position, and candidates must be eligible to work and reside in the United States.


Springboard Collaborative closes the opportunity gap by closing the gap between home and school. By enlisting families as teaching partners, Springboard increases students’ access to instructional time, thereby improving learning outcomes. We envision a world in which educators and families work together to help children unlock their full potential. The Vice President of Product Development supports this goal through continuous product improvement that fuels academic development and meets the evolving needs of districts, teachers, parents, and students.


The Vice President of Product Development will supervise the Curriculum and Instruction leader, the Product Engineering leader, the Program Services leader, and four product owners. The Vice President of Product Development will report to the President and work as part of the Senior Leadership Team. This is a great opportunity to support an entrepreneurial team to maximize the impact of a rapidly growing organization.


You can read more about the requirements, competencies, goals, and responsibilities below. We'd love to have you join us!

This is important

We are an equal opportunity employer. Diversity is more than a commitment at Springboard Collaborative - it’s at the core of what we do and how we do it. No one can solve a problem better than those who experience it firsthand. That’s why Springboard aspires to hire a diverse team that reflects the marginalized communities we serve.


We also know that having a diverse workforce makes for a better workplace. Springboard’s hiring process seeks individuals who value diversity across race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, and more.


Finally, if you’re passionate about an open role, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed on the job description!

Here are your priorities in the first year:

  • You are responsible for the adoption and fidelity of a new decision making framework and ways of working cross functionally, called the Pillars and Capabilities decision framework, across the Product Development team.
  • You will identify and execute improvement opportunities that result from an externally managed randomized control trial aiming to evaluate program efficacy and establish external credibility of our model.
  • You will integrate the Program Services team into the product development team, and support their acclimation into development ways of working and operating procedures.
  • You will ensure our new Family App and Program Fidelity App are ready to extend the value of our programming, and drive utility, satisfaction, and outcomes.

Here are your responsibilities within and beyond the first year:

You own the strategic product portfolio and oversee product lifecycle execution to drive on-time feature delivery and learning outcomes.

  • Act as the strategic bridge between Program Development, Curriculum & Instruction, and Technology teams; ensuring that science of learning, instructional design, and rigorous evidence of student outcomes directly drive product design.
  • Define and maintain a unified, multi-year product lifecycle roadmap that balances component-level roadmaps with platform-wide strategies.

You lead and manage the product development teams, individual contributors, and departmental resources.

  • Recruit, mentor, and coach a highly skilled, mission-driven team, establishing a high-performance culture grounded in intellectual honesty, speed, and customer empathy.
  • Manage and optimize the annual departmental budget to maximize product development margins and ensure a positive budget variance.
  • Champion an outcome-driven culture where the team prioritizes OKRs (student development, retention, and family/educator engagement) over raw feature output.

You own the team operating playbook and elevate the discipline of product management through strong leadership and consistent reinforcement of best practices.

  • In collaboration with the Project Management Office and agile/scrum facilitators, maintain consistent, lightweight agile rituals, artifacts, and communication patterns that maintain momentum.

You oversee the development and maintenance of customer-facing technology.

  • Lead engineering and product owners on core architecture decisions, product/system performance, trade-offs, and critical build-vs-buy evaluations.
  • Ensure all digital software is architected for seamless institutional deployment. Enforce strict student data privacy policies and ensure the digital product portfolio complies with accessibility standards.

You ensure product development is aligned with go-to-market initiatives and delivery.

  • Collaborate with executive leaders to design, experiment with, and deploy strategic pricing and packaging models.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to coordinate successful launches, pilot recruitment, pricing tests, and comprehensive post-launch enablement.

You are responsible for understanding and driving product efficacy through continuous product discovery, rapid prototyping, and customer feedback loops that validate investments before scaling development.

  • Define, instrument, and track product performance metrics to guide post-launch roadmap adjustments.
  • Maintain a rigorous system of continuous user testing, cohort analyses, and classroom pilots to translate customer insights and pain points into actionable roadmap improvements.
  • Lead continuous market mapping and competitive analysis to identify product differentiators, whitespace opportunities, and emerging educational service/product/technology trends.

What you offer us

Here are the competencies we expect the right candidate to have:

  • Coaching & mentoring - You inspire and motivate a high-performing growth team, attract and retain top talent, and create a collaborative, accountable, results-driven culture. You provide timely constructive feedback to encourage continuous improvement and train team members to develop skills, improve performance, and achieve goals.
  • Strategic Prioritization & Resource Alignment - You have the ability to objectively weigh competing product initiatives against strategic value, organizational capacity, and technical feasibility, making high-integrity trade-off decisions that maximize long-term product impact and return on investment.
  • Product Strategy - You have the capacity to formulate a cohesive, forward-looking vision that translates market needs, user pain points, and organizational goals into prioritized, value-driven product roadmaps.
  • Life Cycle Management - You have deep fluency across the entire product development lifecycle - from early-stage validation and customer discovery to launch, scaling, and post-release optimization - ensuring enduring product health and value.
  • Delivery Coordination - You have the skill to foster shared accountability and maintain execution velocity across product and cross-functional teams to ensure predictable, high-quality product releases.
  • Evidence-Based Insights & Data Literacy - You have the aptitude for synthesizing research results into a coherent evidence base that informs product pivots, validates hypotheses, and measures core outcomes.
  • Product & Solution Fluency - You have a deep conceptual and operational understanding of pedagogical value propositions, allowing you to articulate how product capabilities directly resolve core user needs in education.
  • Sector Expertise - You have a comprehensive understanding of the educational landscape, including pedagogical trends, school system structures, funding cycles, and regulatory constraints, and how these external factors shape product design and adoption.
  • Performance Measurement & Decision Support - You have the capability to define, instrument, and track clear success metrics (such as engagement, retention, and learning outcomes) to make objective, data-informed investment and resource allocation decisions.

Here are the requirements we expect the right candidate to have:

  • 10+ years of progressive product management experience in a fast-paced environment, with a proven track record of driving products from initial strategy through successful market delivery.
  • 5+ years of direct people management experience with a proven ability to attract top-tier talent, restructure teams in accordance with evolving strategic goals, and mentor teams.
  • Impeccable verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills shown through demonstrated experience working directly with educational C-suite-level stakeholders.
  • Experience leading/collaborating with curriculum development and engineering teams, showing the ability to engage credibly and balance long-term technical feasibility and scalability with near-term product velocity.
  • Experience partnering with Go-to-Market stakeholders to support pilots, state adoptions, and sales-led or product-led growth motions.
  • Deep knowledge of the K-12 educational landscape and a strong understanding of the science of learning, instructional design, and curriculum development.
  • Proficient in Agile, Scrum, and Human-Centered Design frameworks.

Here are our nice-to-haves for the right candidate:

  • Experience with the delivery of educational services

While this description provides an overview of the goals and responsibilities of the Vice President of Product Development, we are seeking candidates who demonstrate flexibility and can adapt to evolving needs in an entrepreneurial environment.

What we offer you

Compensation

Our compensation values: At Springboard, compensation equity is integral to how we operate and to our commitment to competitiveness, pay equity, performance-based rewards, transparent & equitable career growth, and progressive benefits.


Compensation for this role: The compensation for a candidate who meets the position requirements will be $252,699. Springboard does not negotiate the offered salary during the offer conversation.

Benefits

At Springboard, we feel it is important to take care of our employees, which is why we offer a competitive benefits package. These benefits include the following:

  • The usual stuff - Medical insurance with a cash stipend for those who waive Springboard coverage. Options include PPO and High Deductible/HSA.
  • We’ll take care of it - We fully cover your short & long-term disability coverage.
  • Securing your future - We match up to 6% of your salary in 403(b) retirement contributions after your first twelve months at Springboard.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) is important - Four weeks (20 days) annually. At Springboard, time off doesn’t need to be earned to be used. Everyone gets access to their time at the start of the calendar year.
  • Holidays! - All 11 federal holidays, two extra floating holidays, weekdays between December 25th - January 1st, and your birthday!
  • Under the weather? - We don’t cap the number of sick days available to employees.
  • Paid Leave - Parental Leave (12 weeks after the first 6 months of employment). Marriage Leave (five days).
  • Technology - All employees receive a Springboard laptop and an optional monitor. Springboard uses Google Workspace and Asana.
  • We are committed to your development - We provide personal & professional development funding of $2000/year.
  • Your wellness is a priority - Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides support for stress/anxiety, finance, law, family, substance abuse, grief, and more.
  • Transparency is key - We ensure regular opportunities to discuss individual and organizational development and our commitment to equity. Consistent and structured real-time feedback is foundational to Springboard’s culture.

Location and travel

Applications are welcome from any location within the United States. This role can be performed remotely but will require 10-20% travel, almost fully self-directed. Required travel will include quarterly leadership team and annual org-wide retreats, along with (rare) funder- or partner-requested in-person meetings. Self-directed travel will include program visits and general team management needs.


Springboard requires in-person employees at a Springboard facility or participating in in-person programming or events to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 unless a medical or religious exemption is approved. Being fully vaccinated means an individual is at least two weeks past their final dose of a CDC-authorized COVID-19 vaccine regimen. As a condition of employment, newly hired employees will be asked to provide their COVID-19 vaccination status and proof of vaccination, as required.


Please note that this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Location: Puerto Rico


We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team to architect, develop, and enhance our secure document generation platform. The ideal candidate will demonstrate technical leadership through innovative software design and implementation using Go, Python and TypeScript to deliver exceptional user experiences while maintaining the highest security standards.

About the Role

This position will join our small but growing engineering team focused on building our core product offerings. The successful candidate will have significant autonomy in making software design decisions and implementing best practices throughout our application stack. As we prepare for commercial growth, this role is critical to ensuring our applications are well-architected, maintainable, and deliver exceptional value to our users.

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate a deep understanding of software design principles, patterns, and practices, not just coding proficiency. The ideal candidate should have well-formed opinions about application architecture, API design, state management, and testing strategies, backed by real-world experience. We value team members who can articulate the "why" behind technical decisions and who approach software development as a craft that creates business value.

As a distributed team, we place high value on proactive communication, transparency, and a bias for action. Your ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, mentor junior developers, and take initiative on impactful projects are essential qualities for success in our environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Architecture & Development

  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable application architectures across the full technology stack
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Go and Python with a focus on performance and security
  • Create responsive, intuitive frontend interfaces using React and TypeScript following modern best practices
  • Optimize application performance and resource utilization throughout the technology stack
  • Independently design, develop, and maintain high-performance web applications and APIs
  • Architect solutions for scalability and efficiency, ensuring robust backend systems and intuitive frontend interfaces

Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex feature development from conception through deployment
  • Make sound architectural decisions balancing technical excellence with business needs
  • Provide mentorship and code reviews to help junior developers grow their skills
  • Champion software quality through testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing
  • Manage deployment processes, handle complex troubleshooting, and ensure reliable system operations
  • Drive continuous improvement within the team through knowledge-sharing sessions

Product Innovation

  • Collaborate with product managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Propose innovative approaches to solving user problems through software
  • Continuously research and evaluate new technologies that could benefit our platform
  • Participate in product planning to provide technical perspective on feasibility and approach
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices

Quality & Best Practices

  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Establish and maintain coding standards and best practices for the engineering team
  • Design for security and privacy from the ground up in all application components
  • Create self-documenting code and technical documentation where appropriate
  • Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and define timelines

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years experience in full-stack software development with demonstrated technical leadership, preferably in a startup
  • Strong proficiency in backend development using Go and/or Python
  • Advanced experience building frontend applications with React and TypeScript
  • Experience designing, building, and documenting RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms
  • Production experience with Docker containerization and container orchestration
  • Experience running applications in production on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of relational database design and query optimization
  • Excellence in writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Strong communication skills and experience mentoring junior developers
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive attitude with a passion for mentoring and supporting the engineering organization

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Experience building applications on top of AI/Large Language Models
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture and message queues
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and practices
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible work environment with options for remote work or at our offices
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) to support work-life balance

Our Values

  • We Touch Reality - Customers and their stories are not foreign. We actively seek out engagement with them, whether calling them on the phone, meeting through conferences, or listening to interactions with product/sales.
  • They Win, We Win - Above all else, no other metric matters more to measuring our performance as an Engineering organization than Customers succeeding through our product. We build for them, not ourselves.
  • Bias for Action - When you see a problem you can solve, fix it. We don't wait for someone else to tell you it's your job, we seize the initiative. For major architectural changes, features, or anything that affects other teams' work, we give people a heads up but don't wait for consensus to start exploring solutions.
  • Shared Ownership - We all own the outcomes, not just our individual pieces. When something breaks, we focus on fixing the system together rather than finding who's at fault. Mistakes are inevitable, how we handle them as a team defines us.
  • Transparency First - We emphasize keeping engineering discussions and topics in the public forum, not tucked away in DMs or private channels. Those spaces are specifically for conversations that cannot be had elsewhere.

Join Us

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer - Snowflake & dbt Cloud
description:
Are you looking for a forward focus environment where you are continually challenged, and the atmosphere is affirming? Do you want to be a part of a team where you are often out of your comfort zone, but you wake up excited to go to work each day? How about a place where people are growing because they desire change and growth is modeled and expected?

WHO WE ARE:

Premier Trailer Leasing is a 'USA Today Top Workplace' and one of the largest trailer leasing and rental companies in the nation, specializing in long-term leasing and short-term rental services for over-the-road vans, flatbeds, refrigerated equipment and chassis with an inventory of 70,000 trailers and a growing network of locations across the United States. At Premier you will find an environment where you are seen, heard and valued. Join us and experience what it means to live a culture of C.A.R.E!

JOB SCOPE:

Premier Trailer Leasing is building its next-generation Enterprise Data Platform to support its continued growth as part of a hybrid data modernization plan.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an experienced Snowflake builder. You will help design and implement a greenfield Snowflake environment, establish the engineering practices surrounding it, and deliver governed, production-grade data products supporting reporting, operational integrations, APIs, and future AI workloads.

We are looking for someone who has built and operated this kind of platform before, brings practical lessons from prior implementations, takes ownership, and constructively challenges technical assumptions. As the platform and team grow, you will establish the standards and patterns future data engineers will follow.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Greenfield Platform Build: Partner with Data Leadership to design and implement a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt Cloud, managed ingestion and CDC tooling, appropriate custom integrations, and GitHub-based workflows.
  • Engineering Standards & Operating Model: Establish repeatable practices for environments, Git workflows, modular development, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment controls, rollback, documentation, monitoring, access, and production support.
  • Data Architecture & Modeling: Build a layered architecture spanning raw ingestion, conformed enterprise models, and published marts or data products. Design canonical models that standardize core business entities, definitions, relationships, and rules.
  • Ingestion & CDC: Design and operate resilient ingestion patterns for SQL Server, ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, REST APIs, files, and semi-structured data using managed CDC and ingestion platforms alongside custom integrations where appropriate.
  • Legacy Decoupling: Work with Data Leadership and the SQL Server team to profile legacy sources, inventory dependencies, identify data-quality risks, reconcile existing outputs, and migrate consumers from direct source-system access to governed data products.
  • Quality, Reliability & Observability: Establish automated testing, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, schema-change controls, CDC-lag monitoring, alerting, failure handling, retry and replay patterns, runbooks, and production support expectations.
  • Security, Cost & Performance: Design Snowflake environments, roles, service accounts, access patterns, workload isolation, monitoring, and consumption controls that support least privilege, auditability, performance, and responsible cloud spend.
  • Data Delivery: Publish governed data products for Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, internal and customer-facing APIs, custom applications, and a DBA-managed SQL Server serving layer for approved legacy and latency-sensitive consumers.
  • Technical Ownership & Collaboration: Serve as the technical lead for the platform, owning technical quality, production readiness, design patterns, documentation, and platform stability while collaborating with Data Leadership and the data team, as well as infrastructure, security, and application teams.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • Proven Greenfield Snowflake Experience: 7+ years of progressive data engineering or data platform experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for at least one production greenfield Snowflake implementation or major platform modernization into Snowflake.
  • Deep Snowflake Experience: Practical expertise with Snowflake architecture, warehouse and workload design, RBAC, security, cost governance, performance tuning, semi-structured data, monitoring, and production operations.
  • dbt Cloud Expertise: Hands-on experience establishing and operating dbt Cloud with GitHub for modular transformation development, testing, lineage, documentation, environment management, CI, and production deployment.
  • Production Pipeline Ownership: Experience designing and operating resilient ingestion, CDC, transformation, and delivery pipelines, including schema drift, freshness, reconciliation, failure recovery, retry, replay, and incident response.
  • Data Modeling & Quality: Expertise designing conformed enterprise models, dimensional marts, and durable canonical data products supported by automated testing and data-quality controls.
  • Software Engineering Practices: Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Git and GitHub workflows, automated testing, code review, modular development, CI/CD, and controlled production releases.
  • Security, Governance & Cost Discipline: Experience establishing practical access controls, environment separation, service-account and secrets patterns, auditability, production-change controls, and consumption monitoring.
  • Pragmatic Technical Leadership: A hands-on builder who communicates tradeoffs clearly, challenges assumptions constructively, and takes ownership of reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production delivery.
  • Location: Must be based in, or willing to commute to, the Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week.

PREFERRRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience migrating or decoupling consumers from legacy Microsoft SQL Server environments into Snowflake.
  • Experience with SQL Server CDC and near-real-time ingestion.
  • Experience with Dynamics GP, enterprise CRM systems, or similarly complex operational platforms.
  • Experience with Azure Blob Storage, semi-structured documents, images, or other unstructured data.
  • Experience with reverse ETL, operational data delivery, customer-facing data APIs, or application integrations.
  • Experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish a growing data engineering function.

TECH STACK:

  • Primary Platform: Snowflake
  • Transformation, Testing & Lineage: dbt Cloud
  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub, GitHub Actions, dbt Cloud CI
  • Ingestion & CDC: Managed ingestion platform, SQL Server CDC, REST APIs, files, and custom integrations
  • Primary Sources: SQL Server, Dynamics GP (ERP), CRM, SaaS applications, Azure Blob Storage, APIs, and semi-structured data
  • Consumers: Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, APIs, custom applications, SQL Server serving layers, and future AI and machine-learning workloads

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
At Chexy, we're building modern financial tools for Canadians - starting with their largest expenses. We turn rent, tuition, insurance, and other big bills into opportunities to build credit, earn rewards, and gain financial flexibility.

We're the first platform in Canada that lets users pay nearly any bill using their credit card, while unlocking meaningful benefits like cashback, points, and credit-building tools. With ~$2B in annual payment volume and hundreds of thousands of transactions a month, we're building financial infrastructure that needs to be fast, reliable, and bulletproof.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the product surface of Chexy end to end: our web app (Next.js), our mobile app (Expo / React Native), and the TypeScript backend-for-frontend that serves both. You'll be the most senior product engineer on the team.

This is an ownership role. You'll set the bar for product quality, decide how features are structured across web, mobile, and BFF, and be the person the team looks to when a flow is broken and nobody knows why. Over time we'd like you to become the owner of our mobile app - in addition to the rest of the stack, not instead of it. You'll ship the user-facing side of things that don't exist yet in Canada: a chequing account, a card we issue, instant payouts.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the product surface across web, mobile, and the BFF - architecture, quality bar, observability, and roadmap
  • Lead the design of new product flows for chequing, card issuance, and instant payouts across every client
  • Own onboarding and activation end to end - the biggest lever in the company
  • Make the BFF the single reliable contract for web and mobile: strict schemas, versioning, and backward compatibility for app builds in the wild
  • Grow into owning mobile: release process, OTA updates, store submissions, and the health of the app
  • Set the technical bar: review architecture, write the patterns others follow, and push back when something isn't right
  • Mentor product engineers through reviews and pairing
  • Work directly with the CTO and product on what we build next and in what order

What Senior Means Here

  • You make trade-off calls without waiting to be told, and you're right most of the time
  • You surface problems early and specifically - before they hit users
  • You disagree openly, then commit fully
  • You multiply the team - patterns, reviews, mentoring - rather than only shipping your own work
  • You own outcomes, not tasks. If your domain is broken, that's yours to fix, not someone else's to notice

Who We're Looking For

  • Substantial experience shipping production TypeScript across the stack - React/Next.js at scale, plus a real backend (Node - Hono, NestJS, Express - with a proper data layer)
  • React Native / Expo in production, or a strong desire to own it and the judgment to get there fast
  • You've owned a product surface before - not "worked on," owned - through launches, incidents, and redesigns
  • You care about correctness in ways most product engineers don't: schemas, auth boundaries, idempotent mutations, money shown right
  • You have taste, and you can explain it
  • You already build with AI coding tools every day and have strong opinions about where they fail
  • You've been early somewhere and liked it - you're comfortable making decisions with 70% of the information and revisiting them when the picture changes
  • You communicate clearly in writing and don't need a manager to tell you what matters

Bonus Points

  • Fintech or another domain where a wrong number is a real problem
  • Design-system ownership, accessibility, or i18n (we ship in English and French)
  • Datadog RUM or similar frontend observability

How We Build

We're early. The roadmap moves as we learn from users, partners, and regulators - sometimes week to week - and you'll regularly pick things up outside your title. The people who do best here find that energizing. They'd rather make a call with most of the information than wait for all of it, they get curious instead of frustrated when a requirement changes halfway through, and they've usually been early somewhere before and wanted to do it again.

The way software gets built is changing faster than anyone's best practices can keep up, and we're not pretending otherwise. Most of what we ship is written with AI tools - but that's the least interesting part. The interesting part is working out what that means for how we review, test, and take responsibility for code: what you hand to a model and what you never do, what "I read the diff" means when the diff is two thousand lines, how a small team keeps quality up while moving faster than it should be able to. We're writing that playbook as we go, and we want people who want to write it with us, not people waiting to be handed it. We care a lot about attitude - someone who brings energy into a room rather than absorbing it. When something breaks, they're already on it before anyone asks.

Why Join Chexy?

Build payments infrastructure that matters: Your code moves ~$2B a year for tens of thousands of Canadians

🤖 Work the way engineering works now: AI-native tooling, category-defining technology, and end-to-end ownership

Join a tight-knit team: Work directly with the founders and CTO, who trust you to make real decisions

Early equity: Access equity in a high-growth fintech

Toronto office: We work in-office 5 days a week

How We Hire

We keep our hiring process clear and human. You'll go through a mix of conversational interviews and technical deep-dives designed to show how you think, how you've solved real problems, and how you work with others.

We use AI tools to help us organize and review applications; every decision about who we interview and who we hire is made by a person. This posting is for an existing vacancy. If you interview with us, we'll let you know within days of your last interview whether a decision has been made.

Chexy is an equal opportunity employer. If you require any accommodations or support during the hiring process, let us know and we'll do our best to help.

Know someone who would be a perfect fit? Let them know!

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Senior Product Engineer

Net New


About Nomad

Nomad is building the financial operating system for fleets: fuel cards, real-time transaction processing, invoicing, and working-capital finance, increasingly automated by production AI. We are a small, fast-moving team that cares deeply about doing right by our customers, which in our business means getting the numbers exactly right, every time.


About the Role

Nomad runs a lean, AI-native engineering team by design — small, high-ownership, and built to force-multiply with the best tools available rather than scale headcount. As a Senior Product Engineer, you don't just own your own tickets end to end — you set the pattern for how the whole team does it. You turn vague, cross-cutting problems into work other engineers can pick up, you own the AI and agentic conventions the rest of the team inherits, and the standard you set is still being followed you've moved on to the next thing.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, is comfortable operating with minimal process, and has experience building and scaling SaaS products.


What You'll Own

  • The full workflow, not just the ticket: turning an ambiguous problem into a shipped, monitored outcome, using AI and agentic tools as the default way that work gets scoped, built, and verified.
  • The pattern other engineers follow — a service's quality bar, its AI/agent conventions, and the review standard — not just your own code.
  • A domain you can hand off. When you're heads-down elsewhere, the area you own stays healthy without you.
  • The judgment call on what AI should and shouldn't touch in your area, and why — and the accountability when that call is wrong.


What You'll Do

  • Take a vague problem statement — from a customer, from Ops or Sales, from a metric that looks wrong — and turn it into a validated ticket, then own it through design, build, ship, and monitor: you watch the number it was meant to move, and you are the first to know when it is wrong.
  • Talk to the person who hit the problem before you design the fix — a customer call, an Ops shadow session, a Sales thread — not only when Support escalates it.
  • Treat any figure that reaches an invoice, a payout, or a reconciliation report as needing a named source and a second, independent way to check it — when a change touches money, the before-and-after numbers are part of the pull request, not a follow-up.
  • Decompose a large, ambiguous change into small, reviewable pull requests instead of landing it big-bang and share at 70% for feedback rather than polishing to 100% in private.
  • Use coding agents as your default way of writing code and read every line before it merges — your name on the pull request means you understand what it does and would own the incident it causes.
  • Own the agent setup for a repo or service — the instructions, skills, and conventions other engineers inherit — and design the workflows, verification gates and failure paths that other people actually use, not just ones that work for you.
  • Review work across services you don't own, and treat “changes requested” as a normal, expected outcome — not a rare escalation.


What We're Looking For

  • 4–7 years shipping production software, with real, demonstrable ownership of a domain — not just tickets assigned to you.
  • Startup and SaaS experience required, with experience operating effectively in fast-paced, high-ownership environments with minimal process, and building, maintaining, or scaling SaaS products or platforms.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools, with evidence you've built something with them that other people now rely on — a shared prompt, a skill, a workflow, a convention.
  • A track record of taking ambiguity and turning it into work other people can execute, including work you don't do yourself.
  • Comfort reviewing and being accountable for code and systems outside your own immediate area.
  • Strong judgment about trade-offs — including the judgment to say no to a shortcut that trades long-term health for short-term speed.
  • Experience operating with minimal process in a small team, where your call is usually the only call.


How We Work

We'd rather stay small and force-multiply with the best tools available than scale headcount to solve a tooling problem. That means less specialization, more ownership, and a high bar for judgment at every level — and at Senior, it means the patterns and conventions you set are what everyone else inherits. If you want to be the person whose call on architecture, AI usage, and workflow design becomes the way the team works, this is that role.


What We Offer

•Competitive compensation package of $120,000–$140,000

• Flexible work schedule.

• Growth and development opportunities.

• Team outings and social events.

• Excellent extended medical, dental, and vision benefits plan.


At Nomad, we love using AI to make our processes smarter—it helps us draft engaging job descriptions, organize information, and stay on top of details.

Feel free to use AI tools to prepare, research, or practice for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT fans 👀!). But when it comes to the conversation, we want to meet the real you—no AI substitutes needed. Bring your authentic, unfiltered self, and we promise we’ll do the same.


And don’t worry—real people are behind every step of our hiring process. Every application is personally reviewed, and you’ll always interact with humans throughout interviews. No bots, just genuine connections.


Let your journey at Nomad begin!

title: Career & Curriculum Associate
description:
What does world-class career coaching look like? If you're a career development professional with a clear eye for what quality career coaching means and are interested in being part of a high-growth AI nonprofit, we're looking for you! CareerVillage.org, an award-winning global tech nonprofit, is defining what high-quality AI career coaching looks like for ourselves and the field. We’re seeking a mission-driven, full-time Career & Curriculum Associate with deep expertise in career development to support this work. If you have a background as a career coach, advisor, or instructional designer, and are excited to translate your knowledge into AI-driven tech, we’d love to hear from you!

About CareerVillage.org

CareerVillage.org is dedicated to democratizing access to career information and advice for underrepresented people. As our Career & Curriculum Associate, you’ll be a leader in taking the content and effectiveness of our AI Career Coach, Coach, to the next level.

What you’ll do

This is an individual contributor role that reports directly to our Coaching & Learning Expert.

Please note: This role sits at the intersection of two ever-evolving fields: career development and AI. The responsibilities of this role will change as CareerVillage adapts to field learnings. Candidates who are adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity, and embrace a growth-mindset for learning new technology will be a great fit.

  • Create and improve content: Lead the creation of new career development content and continuously update 50+ existing career topics to keep pace with learner needs, partner requests, and organizational strategy. This involves developing and maintaining prompts grounded in instructional design principles, that tell Coach how to interact with users step by step (no technical expertise required, you will learn on the job, though comfort with new tools is a must!)
  • Manage the content feedback loop: Collect, prioritize, and incorporate feedback from various stakeholders, and handle ad-hoc content requests from across teams as they arise.
  • Translate coaching best practices into quality control systems: Support the development of evaluative criteria that measures whether Coach is delivering high quality, personalized coaching. Contribute to benchmark creation: Support our field-building efforts to identify and prove what quality career coaching looks like in an AI context.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Success, and other teams to bring content to life, ensuring they align with the platform’s mission and goals.
  • Champion career development excellence: Bring expert knowledge of career advising to guide content strategy, ensuring that all activities are transformative and accessible for learners from diverse backgrounds.

What you bring

  • 3+ years experience as a career advisor, coach, or in a related field coaching people through career exploration, career planning, and job searching, ideally with a diverse group of beneficiaries.
  • Instructional designer experience or Career Coaching Certification (i.e., CPCC, BCC, GCDF, NCDA certifications, etc.)
  • Experience translating coaching or advising expertise into written, structured learning content with defined objectives and success criteria.
  • Experience working in a very high-growth, fast-paced, rapidly-changing work environment (i.e., a company or nonprofit that doubled its size multiple years in a row, and you loved it)
  • Familiarity with established career development theories, pedagogical frameworks (i.e. Bloom’s Taxonomy), skills assessment, and competency-building techniques.
  • Ability to articulate curriculum concepts clearly and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Ability to manage and refine multiple curriculum projects simultaneously, with a focus on quality and learner outcomes.
  • Preferred requirements:
    • Experience helping job seekers finding employment outside the United States
    • And/or experience helping job seekers find employment in trade industries.

About you

We know that applying for a job can be intimidating. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we know there are many skills and backgrounds that will contribute to success in this role. The ideal candidate will have many of the following:

  • You are comfortable transitioning to a role where you are no longer coaching humans (you’ll be coaching AI, which involves lots of time independently evaluating or updating prompts).
  • You are comfortable operating within an established framework. CareerVillage has already defined core frameworks and design principles for Coach - you'll bring deep career-coaching expertise to execute, stress-test, and extend that vision (not build it from scratch).
  • Confidence and interest in diving into new technology and a willingness to learn.
  • You are mission-driven and committed to developing transformational social impact technology.
  • Experience working with learners from underserved communities or interest in education and social impact.
  • Ability to manage a collaborative peer review process with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring content meets the highest standards.
  • A flexible, iterative approach to developing curriculum. This means comfort working with the constraints of existing strategy and the patience to test and refine content based on feedback.
  • Comfort working across teams and bringing structure and clarity to complex content projects.

What we offer

  • An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and make an impact on the world
  • A chance to see the impact of your work on millions of people
  • A chance to work with like-minded people who are working together on something ambitious and purposeful
  • A fantastic and supportive organizational culture
  • Starting salary of $85,000-$100,000
  • 401K matching
  • $1,500 Professional Development budget
  • Very generous vacation policy

Location

We are a remote-first organization and can hire for this role within the United States. Candidates must be physically located in the U.S. and eligible to work here. We expect employees to work within normal business hours in the Pacific, Mountain, Central, or Eastern time zones. Hybrid work is optional in NYC. CareerVillage.org has team members worldwide, with our HQ in Palo Alto, CA.

Hiring process

Please expect a minimum of 3 rounds in the interview process (initial phone screening, possible skills assessment, and typically two interview rounds).

CareerVillage is an equal opportunity organization that celebrates diversity (for more information about our approach, check out our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Guidelines). Diversity includes race, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, size, religion, sexual orientation, parental status, socioeconomic background, and many other parts of an individual’s identity. We are a fair choice employer: qualified applicants with a history of arrest or conviction are welcome to apply and will be considered for this role. Each team member’s perspective is integral to our success, and fostering an inclusive environment is everyone’s responsibility. At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

As an advisor to HR Leadership and the business, you'll collaborate with team members and key stakeholders to realize strategic analytics initiatives, conduct people research, and experiment to solve critical business and HR challenges. Key focus areas include predicting great hires, turnover, and supporting employee engagement goals.

In this dynamic, fast-paced environment, you'll work with a diverse group of smart individuals, demonstrating strong teamwork, adaptability, and curiosity. As a data-driven People Analytics Specialist, you will thrive on challenges and make a meaningful impact within an international, ambitious, yet informal setting.

Our Technology Stack

Our tech stack includes an ever-evolving range of systems and technologies, and we have the freedom to choose the best solution for each challenge. We actively invest in exploring, adopting, and developing new technologies that add value.

Currently, our team utilizes Python to build and manage data infrastructure, ETLs, and data integrity, ensuring secure data flows across databases and servers in multiple environments like Elastic, AWS, and SQL. You'll also build and enhance existing reporting solutions on Qlik and Python.

Who You Are
  • 3+ years of experience in People Analytics or Analytical Advisory roles
  • BS, MS, or Ph.D. in an analytical/quantitative/psychology-related field of study
  • Excellent analytical, project management and communication skills
  • Experience in data analysis/ visualization using preferably Python, SQL, and Qlik
  • Ability to work successfully in a fast-moving and competitive environment
  • Desire to work in a team environment is a must.

What You Can Expect

Working at IMC means embracing dynamic challenges and a steady stream of diverse projects. Our quick feedback loop allows for continuous improvement and learning. Our workforce is equally diverse, comprising individuals from various nationalities and backgrounds, united by their technical expertise and collaborative approach. We empower our employees to take on significant responsibilities and support them in making an impact from day one. As a People Analytics Specialist, you'll gain insights into all aspects of our work, making your job even more exciting and fulfilling.

We offer a flat organizational structure and a collaborative culture that fosters idea-sharing and technology exchange between teams and offices. You'll have opportunities to travel between offices and explore different parts of our organization. Traveling required approx. 15%.

Our Hiring Process

For your success, we've detailed our hiring process, including tips on applying and interviewing with us, on our website. Now it's your turn! Apply today to embark on an amazing journey with IMC.

IMC: Join a World-Class Global Market Maker

IMC is a world-renowned market maker with offices in Europe, the US and Asia-Pacific. We use algorithmic trading and advanced technology to buy and sell securities across multiple trading venues. Our vital role, at the centre of the financial markets, provides liquidity for buyers and sellers worldwide.

In the late 1980s, IMC quickly identified the importance of technology in the fast-evolving trading environment. Our passion for innovation continues to drive us today. Although our company has grown rapidly over recent decades, we still approach our work with the same entrepreneurial spirit, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and innovation. We like our people to think for themselves and we give them the responsibility and support they need to make an impact. This means real work as well as dedicated training programmes and mentors.

While we work hard, we also have a lot of fun – whether solving complex problems or taking part in team-building, leisure and sporting activities. IMC also enables its employees to contribute to a better society through our foundation.

title: AI Cybersecurity Director
description:
EVOCS OVERVIEW

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

As an IT consulting firm, we work with our clients to understand their needs, identify the right technologies, and deliver solutions that improve performance and support their business objectives.

AI Cybersecurity Director

Cybersecurity Department | Hybrid: Denver, CO or Ashburn, VA (3 days onsite, 2 days flexible per week)

EVOCS Overview

EVOCS's journey began with a mission to empower businesses with advisory expertise, empowered with ideal technologies to provide them with comprehensive solutions to grow and prosper.

Founded by a team of passionate experts, EVOCS has grown into a trusted partner to a growing number of leaders across their respective industries. Our roots in employee-managed operations reflect our commitment to quality, consistency, and client success.

If you enjoy working in a hyper-fast-growing company, are eager to be part of an agile team, and want to be part of our success story, then let's talk!

🎯 Role Overview

As the AI Cybersecurity Director, you will serve as the technical and security authority for artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and large language model (LLM) systems deployed across a global data center and critical infrastructure operator's operational, OT, and enterprise environments.

You will be responsible for ensuring AI systems are architected, deployed, and operated with appropriate controls for data protection, model integrity, access governance, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop decision enforcement -- so AI delivers business value without introducing unacceptable cyber, operational, safety, workforce, or regulatory risk.

🧩 What You Will Do

Essential Functions

  • Establish enterprise governance for detection, classification, and management of unauthorized (shadow) AI across business units, in coordination with centralized AI functions
  • Define and enforce security architecture standards for AI, ML, and LLM platforms across cloud, hybrid, on-prem, and OT-adjacent environments
  • Provide security design oversight and approval for AI systems, including data pipelines, model hosting, inference paths, APIs, and integrations
  • Define enterprise methodology for AI security assessment covering architecture, design, and implementation across applications, agents, and workflows
  • Ensure AI architectures enforce segmentation, least privilege, deterministic behavior, and fail-safe operation, particularly where OT or critical infrastructure data is involved
  • Establish AI-specific incident response playbooks and lead response to AI-related security, safety, or governance incidents
  • Enforce controls preventing unauthorized model retraining, autonomous learning, or use of live production or OT data outside approved intent
  • Define security requirements for explainability, traceability, and output validation where AI influences operational, workforce, safety, or compliance outcomes
  • Drive alignment with ISO 42001 and related AI governance standards across applicable teams

AI Data Protection and Trust Boundaries

  • Enforce protections against prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination risk, unauthorized context expansion, and external model training exposure
  • Ensure sensitive enterprise, operational, personnel, and contractual data is not exposed to or retained by external AI platforms without approved safeguards
  • Approve and oversee AI data ingestion pipelines, enforcing purpose limitation, data minimization, and classification requirements
  • Validate encryption, access logging, retention, and deletion controls for data used by AI systems
  • Define and enforce controls preventing cross-domain data correlation that violates trust boundaries or governance constraints

AI Threat, Risk, and Monitoring Management

  • Perform AI-specific threat modeling, including risks such as data poisoning, model theft, inference abuse, output manipulation, and decision integrity compromise
  • Integrate AI threats into enterprise cybersecurity and OT risk models, including definition of compensating controls and escalation for systems exceeding risk tolerance
  • Own and maintain the AI risk register covering confidentiality, integrity, availability, explainability, data quality, model drift, adversarial attacks, and business impact
  • Ensure AI systems generate telemetry, logging, and audit trails sufficient to detect misuse, drift, or anomalous behavior
  • Integrate AI security monitoring into SOC, SIEM, and enterprise incident response workflows

OT and Critical Infrastructure Safeguards

  • Enforce prohibitions on autonomous AI control of OT assets, including power, cooling, building management systems, fire suppression, and physical access systems
  • Validate one-way data flows, read-only access models, and manual override requirements where AI consumes OT telemetry
  • Partner with OT and infrastructure teams to ensure AI enhances visibility and decision support without compromising safety, reliability, or uptime
  • Oversee security reviews of vendor-provided and embedded AI capabilities, including model behavior, data handling, and contractual protections
  • Define and enforce minimum security and governance requirements for AI vendors, including audit rights and termination conditions

🧠 What You Will Bring

The top candidate will have the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, or risk engineering roles
  • Hands-on experience securing data pipelines, APIs, cloud platforms, and analytics or ML-enabled systems
  • Strong understanding of identity, access management, encryption, logging, and secure system design
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) -- bilingual or near-native level
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills -- comfortable engaging executives, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders via email, calls, and meetings

Key Skills & Competencies

  • AI and machine learning security
  • LLM and generative AI risk management
  • Security architecture and threat modeling
  • Data protection and access governance
  • Incident response and forensic analysis
  • Cross-functional technical leadership

Ideally you have...

  • Direct experience securing AI/ML platforms, LLMs, or analytics pipelines
  • Experience with cloud security (Azure, AWS, GCP) and SaaS-based AI platforms
  • Familiarity with OT, critical infrastructure, or safety-critical environments
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or cloud security certifications

We are privileged to serve our loyal customer base in our mission to build lasting relationships with our clients based on trust and mutual success. Build and maintain web services

Integrate third-party systems and webhooks

Raise the bar on testing and quality

Support CI/CD and operational excellence

Contribute to build pipelines, deployments, and environment management so changes ship safely and frequently. You’ll add logging, monitoring, and alerting to make issues visible and debuggable quickly.

  • 0–3+ years of professional experience building production web backends with Node.js. or Python and front-end frameworks such as React
  • Proven ability to build and maintain APIs (REST/GraphQL), including auth and data validation.

Apply Now

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you're excited about the mission and have strong technical communication skills and the ability to ship clean, well-tested code, we’d love to hear from you.



eternal.ag is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.

The Data Science & Strategy Team at Birch Hill is currently recruiting Summer Analysts for a four-month internship beginning in May 2027. The internship is open to students graduating in 2028.

The internship offers students the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects. Successful candidates will utilize a variety of tools and skillsets to solve problems and to support the strategic objectives of Birch Hill’s portfolio companies. Birch Hill is a Canadian mid-market private equity firm with a long history of driving growth in its portfolio companies and delivering returns to its investors. Based in Toronto, Birch Hill currently has over $6 billion in capital under management. Since 1994, the firm has made 74 investments, with 60 fully realized. The Data Science & Strategy Team focuses on creating value for our companies by enabling data-driven decision making through advanced analytics and AI. title: Data Scientist I
description:
About You

You’re endlessly curious, adaptable, and detail-obsessed in the best way. You love rolling up your sleeves to wrestle messy data into shape, making it clean, usable, and ready to reveal its secrets. You’re excited to learn from seasoned teammates but are also comfortable working independently on well-defined problems from day one.

You thrive in a collaborative, friendly, and nerdy environment where people genuinely love what they do. You chase the thrill of deep focus, appreciate your teammates’ brainpower, and hunger for the rush of solving problems no one else has dared to tackle. These are the kinds of challenges that stay with you—in the shower, as you fall asleep, tugging at your brain in the best possible way.

You’re interested in politics, and the ways in which public opinion is created and shaped. You understand the power of narratives to shape the world around us, and want to play a part in the high-stakes, real-world battle over hearts and minds.

Most importantly, you bring humility, patience, and a commitment to detail. You bring focus and efficiency to your work, knowing when to go deep and when to ship ‘good enough.’ You see this role as a chance to sharpen your craft, learn fast, and make a real contribution to high-stakes, real-world problems.


About the role

At Tavern Research, we’re building models to understand and influence how people form opinions online. That means taking on problems like tracing how narratives spread through social platforms, or analyzing how different messages land with different audiences. The data is messy, the questions are ambiguous, and the stakes are high.

As a member of the Data Science team, your role is to help make this work possible. You’ll dive into raw, noisy datasets to clean, structure, and prepare them for analysis. You’ll run exploratory analyses to surface patterns, build features, and support experiments. You’ll contribute to modeling tasks end-to-end, helping turn difficult, open-ended questions into tangible, testable results. While you’ll collaborate closely with senior modelers, we expect new hires to ramp quickly and take ownership of clearly scoped modeling and data tasks.

From day one, you’ll be hands-on with real-world data and problems that matter. You’ll have support from senior team members, but you’ll also be expected to bring rigor, patience, and persistence to your work. Over time, as your skills deepen, you’ll have opportunities to take ownership of increasingly complex modeling projects, building toward the point where you can design and lead experiments yourself.


We value in-person collaboration and expect employees to work regularly from our Chicago office.


Responsibilities

  • Work hands-on with real-world, unstructured data: cleaning, debugging, and engineering features that support effective models.
  • Support the design and execution of numerical experiments by handling data prep, fitting models, and running standard analyses.
  • Contribute to feature engineering and model building, taking ownership of clearly defined components of modeling projects.
  • Write clean, well-documented Python code using standard data science libraries.
  • Assist with model evaluation, diagnostics, and performance monitoring.
  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers to scope and execute tightly defined tasks.
  • Learn and apply best practices and emerging tools in machine learning, AI, and causal inference.

Qualifications

We know it’s rare to check every box. If you meet most of these, we encourage you to apply:

  • This role is designed for early-career candidates with 0–3 years of experience or equivalent hands-on project work who are eager to grow into more advanced modeling responsibilities.
  • Strong academic or applied background in data science and software engineering or closely related fields.
  • Experience building statistical models (beyond differential equations or simulations).
  • Demonstrated experience working with messy, real-world datasets.
  • Proficiency in Python and standard data science libraries.
  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts like embeddings, supervised and unsupervised ML methods, and agentic systems
  • Clear understanding of the data science concepts behind work you’ve done (not just “I ran the code”).
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Humility, patience, and attention to detail.
  • We especially value candidates who have independently built data or modeling projects outside of coursework, including internships, research, or production data work.
  • Bonus: exposure to model deployment, large language models, or causal inference.

To be explicit: you don't need a degree to work here. You just need to be exceptional at what we're asking from you.

Benefits

  • Premium health insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Office closed for all federal holidays
  • 401k match
  • Equity

Tavern Research is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Director, Email Development and QA
description:
Location: Remote, US, EST time zone

The Role

As Director of Email Development & QA, you will lead a team of 10-15 developers and QA specialists delivering pixel-perfect campaigns for our Fortune 100 financial services client. You will own the production ecosystem—driving efficiency, automation, and 100% SLA compliance—while collaborating to translate business strategies into scalable technical architectures. This role also involves pre-sale scoping and leading the integration of AI within our workflows.

This role reports directly to our SVP, Managing Director.

What You’ll Accomplish

Business Leadership and Team Development

  • Directly manage a team of 10-15 FTEs and contractors, in North America and offshore, overseeing recruiting, performance management, and career development.
  • Establish technical standards and engineering culture to ensure high-quality, reusable code based on responsive design systems.
  • Architect and optimize the end-to-end development pipeline to maximize resource utilization and profitability.
  • Partner with cross-functional leads to ensure accurate project scoping, resourcing, and timely delivery.

AI-Native Practice Leadership

  • Lead the integration of AI-assisted development tools, code generation, testing automation, and other AI-enabled workflows across the team.

Client Delivery and Technical Oversight


  • Architect, document, and continuously optimize the end-to-end development-to-QA pipeline; eliminate workflow redundancies, automate manual tasks, and champion production-line efficiency.
  • Along with our Senior Creative Director, oversee the governance, maintenance, and scalability of the agency’s fully responsive modular email design systems and template frameworks.
  • Connect abstract data requirements to advanced technical solutions, acting as the senior authority on complex personalization logic, API frameworks, custom scripts, and platform capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
  • Own the quality and integrity of developer and QA output across client engagements, from scoping decisions through to deployment.
  • Partner with client, project and delivery leads to ensure work is scoped correctly, resourced appropriately, and delivered on time.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and escalation support on complex or high-risk deliverables.
  • Maintain visibility across active engagements to identify risk early and keep delivery on track.
  • Track, analyze, and enforce strict compliance with internal and client-facing Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Act as the ultimate technical safety net; intercept execution failures and deliverability roadblocks to diagnose root causes and implement agency-wide improvements.

Scoping, Resourcing & Burn Management

  • Participate in pre-sale conversations to assess development requirements, translate business needs into technical scope, and develop accurate level-of-effort estimates.
  • Identify opportunities to build reusable frameworks, accelerators, and development assets that improve delivery speed and consistency across engagements.
  • Understand the broader financial landscape of client retainers; flag out-of-scope development requests and balance resource costs (internal vs. contractor spend) to maximize delivery profitability.

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 10+ years in email engineering, with 4+ years leading technical teams in an agency or consulting environment.
  • Expertise in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Journey Optimizer, and rendering tools like Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • Proven ability to scope custom development, contribute to Statements of Work (SOWs), and manage stakeholder expectations regarding timelines and complexity.

  • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking.
  • Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients.

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world’s most recognized brands. As Director of Engineering and Development, you will shape how our clients build and scale technology solutions, lead a team of talented engineers doing genuinely complex work, and have a real voice in how SH/FT’s engineering practice grows and evolves.

title: Plant Director
description:

Start-Up & Operational Readiness (Pre-Production Phase)

Plant Operations & Production Ownership (Post-Start-Up)

• Deliver against production targets for output, yield, and on-time delivery.

• Establish and monitor KPIs to drive operational performance and accountability.

• Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks to ensure consistent throughput and efficiency.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

• Build and sustain a world-class safety culture from start-up through steady-state operations.

• Ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, and company safety standards.

• Own plant quality systems to ensure products meet all specifications and customer requirements.

• Implement corrective and preventive actions to address safety and quality issues.

• Establish clear expectations, accountability, and performance management systems.

• Reinforce Niron’s culture, values, and mission as the site scales.

• Partner with the People Team on workforce planning, engagement, and retention.

• Drive improvements in efficiency, cost, yield, and cycle time.

• Standardize processes and ensure disciplined execution of operating procedures.

• Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making and performance management.

Systems, Processes & Infrastructure

• Stand up and optimize plant systems, including ERP, MES, and maintenance programs.

• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.

• Ensure robust preventive and predictive maintenance programs are in place.

• Build scalable infrastructure to support future growth and capacity expansion.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, R&D, and start-up leadership to ensure successful process transfer and ramp.

• Collaborate with supply chain to ensure material availability and inventory optimization.

• Align with corporate leadership on production goals, timelines, and strategic priorities.

• Serve as the primary operational leader for the Sartell facility within Niron Magnetics.

Financial & Performance Management

• Report on plant performance and provide insights to senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring
