• 12+ years of manufacturing operations leadership, including a site-level leadership role.

• Process safety experience in hydrogen, ammonia, or comparable service.

• Hands-on experience commissioning and starting up a new plant or production line.

• Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong track record of driving safety, quality, and operational performance.

• Experience in a start-up, greenfield, or high-growth manufacturing environment.

• Ownership of site-level P&L or plant financial performance.

title: DVM Student Externship/Preceptorship Program - AniMed Animal Hospital
description:
We're making an investment in the next generation of veterinary doctors!

As part of the professional veterinary curriculum, colleges encourage off-campus educational experiences in practices outside of the teaching hospital. Practical experience in a well-run and contemporary practice can be a valuable component of your veterinary education, preparing you to deliver better care after graduation. Our program is dedicated to contributing to your practice-readiness and to help you hit the ground running after graduation.

Our program structure:

Our externships are flexible—they can range from two to eight weeks during the year, according to your college curriculum – but are typically two or three weeks in length. Your schedule will include days, evenings and weekends.

Our externship rotations are designed to allow students, under veterinary supervision, to practice the problem-solving, technical and communication skills that they have acquired during their clinical preparation. Externs are given the opportunity to work alongside our veterinary team and are encouraged to participate in all aspects of patient care. A stipend of $250 per week will be provided.

What you'll be doing:

Externs experience the typical caseload of a small animal practice. Under the supervision of your mentor doctor you will gather histories, perform physical examinations, develop diagnostic and therapeutic plans, scrub in to surgery, assist in the management of medical cases, provide wellness care, develop your client communication skills, polish your technical skills and produce appropriate medical records (SOAPs) within the time limits of daily practice.

Who we're looking for:

Extern students are expected to be enthusiastic and effective participants in our patient care activities, upholding the professional and ethical standards of our practice. Students participating in the externship program are suggested to review the Veterinary Practice Act in regard to the scope of duties that may be performed, and to be familiar with the type and degree of veterinary supervision that is required. These should be followed carefully in order to protect both yourself and our practice.

As a veterinary student extern, we expect you to dress and behave in a professional manner and to meet the expectations that we have of all team members as outlined in our employee handbook.

Requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited DVM program.
  • You are authorized to work in the United States.
  • You must carry professional liability insurance. AVMA PLIT liability insurance is free for all student members of the AVMA. You may apply for this coverage on their website. Please check to make sure your coverage is current and submit a certificate of coverage with your application.

About us:

As sponsors of the Veterinary Externship Program, we see ourselves to be part of your educational team, providing instruction, mentoring and evaluation of the students who participate. You will be assigned a mentor and work on the learning objectives as defined by your college program or to meet your specific goals. At the end of the externship your mentor will provide a written evaluation of your performance as required by your college program.

We look forward to working with you!

description:

Department: Baseball Operations, Research and Development

Location:

About the A's:

The A's are a baseball team founded in 1901. They have a rich history, having won nine World Series championships and 15 American League pennants. The A's are known for pioneering the "Moneyball" approach to team-building, which focuses on using statistical analysis to identify undervalued players.

In addition to their success on the field, the A's also have a positive and dynamic work culture. They have been recognized twice as the Front Office Sports, Best Employers in Sports.

The A’s are defined by their core pillars of being Dynamic, Innovative, and Inclusive. Working for the A's offers the opportunity to be part of an innovative organization that values its employees and strives to create a positive work environment.

Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our enterprise data architecture. This role will be responsible for supporting and growing our Microsoft SQL Server environment that turns raw data from vendors, MLB, and internal coaching and scouting reports into actionable reports, advanced data models, and a best-in-the-industry frontend platform. We are also looking to scale up our medallion architecture in the face of new advances and challenges around cloud computing, artificial intelligence and automation, and truly large datasets. This role will work with our various Research and Development groups (data engineers, software developers, technology coordinators, and analysts), as well as Baseball Operations and IT leadership to build our future in Las Vegas.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, lead development of, and maintain enterprise data architecture, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and operational data platforms.
  • Design, lead development of, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for baseball data.
  • Manage and develop team members, providing technical guidance, setting priorities, supporting professional growth, and ensuring alignment with organizational data architecture and engineering goals.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies in cloud computing, data engineering, AI, and data management, and provide guidance on major technology and platform decisions.
  • Collaborate with Baseball R&D groups to optimize the storage, cleaning, querying, and delivery of datasets to solve complicated problems.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Work experience in data architecture, data engineering, database development, and ability to design and build a bronze/silver/gold data architecture.
  • Fluency with SQL and Python in an ETL/ELT context.
  • Proven experience leading and developing team members, whether through direct people management or a team lead capacity.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Understanding of data lake architectures and implementations.
  • Willing and able to work a non-traditional schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required to support events and critical business operations.
  • Willingness to travel as needed, including to conferences, conventions, Spring Training in Arizona, and Athletics game operations in West Sacramento during the 2027 season.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Familiarity with machine learning and AI data architectures.
  • Working knowledge of the baseball industry and data sources in professional baseball.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD practices
  • Experience leading large-scale data modernization or migration initiatives.

Social Impact & Belonging are in our organizational DNA. Our commitment to these values is unwavering – on and off the field. Together, we continue to build an inclusive, innovative, and dynamic culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates belonging and amplifies all voices. Combining a collaborative and innovative work environment with talented team members, we've created a workforce in which every team member has the tools to reach their full potential.

Job Title

Department

4

Location

Glasgow, UK Head Office

The Quality team:

Our Quality team are the trusted guardians of BYOMA’s commitment to skin barrier health, ensuring every product meets the highest standards of safety, regulatory and quality, while amplifying the customer voice and driving continuous improvement. We enable rapid, responsible growth by partnering across the business to balance risk, accelerate innovation and build lasting consumer trust.

The role:

Reporting to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance, the Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance Executive plays a key role in supporting the delivery of robust regulatory, safety, and quality compliance across all products, retailers, and jurisdictions. The role works closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to proactively manage regulatory requirements, coordinate product documentation, track regulatory change, review technical and product information, and support the business in achieving timely, compliant, and high-quality product launches. The Executive will contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes and provide a reliable point of expertise within the Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance function.

Role Responsibilities

Regulatory & Compliance Management

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations, industry standards and regulatory guidance, proactively monitoring regulatory developments and leading horizon-scanning activities to assess potential business impacts.
  • Lead the collation, review and coordination of documentation required to establish and maintain Product Information Files (PIFs), ensuring records remain complete, accurate, traceable and audit-ready throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Review and assess product claims, ingredient listings, packaging, artwork and labelling to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and internal requirements, providing guidance and challenge where required.
  • Liaise directly with the Responsible Person and external regulatory partners to support product assessments, notifications, registrations and market access activities.
  • Own the day-to-day management of compliance records, trackers and regulatory databases, ensuring data integrity, traceability and launch readiness.
  • Manage the maintenance, renewal and ongoing compliance of product certifications, accreditations and registrations across applicable markets.
  • Conduct regulatory risk assessments and proactively identify, assess and escalate regulatory risks and/or non-compliances to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance.

Pre-Production Quality Assurance

  • Embed Quality-by-Design principles throughout product development activities, ensuring regulatory, safety and quality requirements are considered from concept through to launch.
  • Review supplier, manufacturer and raw material documentation to confirm regulatory compliance, manufacturing suitability and alignment with BYOMA quality standards.
  • Participate in new product risk assessments, identifying potential product safety, quality and compliance risks and ensuring mitigation plans are established.
  • Coordinate product registration and notification activities across relevant markets and regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Manage regulatory and quality approval workflows for new product launches, ensuring all required activities, approvals and supporting evidence are completed prior to handover to Supply Chain.

Technical Documentation & Testing

  • Review technical documentation relating to formulation, packaging, stability, compatibility, PET and other validation activities to ensure compliance with approved specifications and internal requirements.
  • Coordinate and oversee testing programmes, ensuring evidence is complete, traceable and available to support product launch decisions.
  • Review consumer-facing copy, claims and artwork, providing regulatory guidance and approval to ensure compliance with applicable requirements and claims substantiation standards.
  • Evaluate testing outcomes and product performance data, escalating risks, failures, trends and non-conformances where appropriate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted regulatory and quality partner to Product Development, Design, VM, Marketing, Supply Chain and Customer Service teams, providing pragmatic guidance that balances compliance requirements with commercial objectives.
  • Partner with Product Development to ensure innovation pipelines align with regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, laboratories, consultants and regulatory agencies to support compliant and efficient product development activities.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service to review customer complaints, product concerns and emerging consumer trends, identifying opportunities for corrective action, risk reduction and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with Quality Control and Supply Chain partners to support investigations, deviations, CAPAs and product quality improvements.
  • Ensure clear communication, effective record management and end-to-end traceability across all regulatory and quality activities.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead risk-based assessments relating to new product launches, formula changes, packaging modifications and regulatory developments, ensuring mitigation plans are defined and monitored.
  • Maintain awareness of regulatory developments across global markets and communicate potential impacts to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support internal audits, inspections and compliance reviews, identifying improvement opportunities and driving closure of resulting actions.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System, driving increased compliance maturity, documentation control, traceability and operational effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Regulatory Affairs & QA KPIs, dashboards and reporting tools to support data-driven decision making and governance.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency and strengthen regulatory and quality performance.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience working in a Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance capacity for a beauty brand/manufacturer; with strong regulatory knowledge and technical expertise
  • Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail with a structured and methodical approach to work.
  • Excellent organisational and planning skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional confidence to challenge, escalate, and seek clarity where required.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and improvement-focused mindset.

Equal opportunities for everyone

BYOMA is an equal opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our team. We are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Consultant
description:
Job Description

Meradia – Consultant

Meradia has been a trusted partner in the investment management industry since 1997, offering strategic advisory and implementation services that blend technical expertise with a dedication to client success. Our mission is to help clients navigate complex challenges, streamline operations, and achieve their goals.

We seek ambitious, talented individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results. Our consultants collaborate with a diverse range of clients to create impactful solutions. The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter with strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a proven background in the financial sector.

At Meradia, we prioritize and invest in our employees' growth and offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and continuous professional development opportunities, including mentorship and industry events. If you seek a fulfilling career in consulting, we encourage you to apply to join our team!

REQUIREMENTS

  • Provide guidance and strategic insights to clients through the successful development and integration of new systems and operational processes
  • Conduct in-depth operational and technology assessments to identify inefficiencies and recommend solutions that drive client service improvement, operational efficiency, and risk reduction
  • Document existing operational procedures and define new processes based on business analysis
  • Provide clients with research and insight relating to software applications and technology, operations processing, reporting, and investment performance measurement
  • Develop and maintain project plans, status memos, procedural and operational documentation
  • Mentor and lead junior consultants on assigned projects
  • Manage systems implementation projects impacting multiple departments, including configuration of tools like SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, FactSet, Charles River, BNY/Eagle, and others
  • Stay informed of capital market and technology trends to deliver innovative solutions and value-added services to clients
  • Consultant(s) should be flexible with an appetite to both lead efforts and approach problems as a business analyst (testing, sql queries) and everything in between, given client needs
  • Ability to travel - you will likely spend a significant amount of time onsite with our clients. This travel can be as much as 50% to 80% of a work week and maybe international. In addition, you must have a valid driver's license as many clients are not within range of public transportation.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strategic thinking; transformations are difficult and the ideal candidate will help our clients navigate them successfully
  • Experience designing, developing and implementing technology solutions in the investment services industry
  • Experience managing systems implementation and development projects that impact multiple departments and redefine operational processes
  • Proven record of analyzing business processes and developing practical solutions that drive efficiency, improve client service, and reduce risk
  • Ability to assess and document business requirements including systems, data, integration, workflows, output, reports and the economic/operational impact of each
  • Analytical and data testing skills with tools like Excel, PowerBI, Alteryx, and/or Tablaeu
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Functional, technical, and operational expertise of the investment management industry
  • Fundamental knowledge of front, middle and back-office operations in investment management organizations, with a understanding of institutional client reporting
  • Knowledge of a broad range of investment management products including US and global equities, fixed-income and derivative products, private credit, hedge funds, and commercial real estate
  • Understanding of multi-currency portfolio accounting and fund administration platforms
  • Deep experience in back and middle-office operations, ideally performance measurement, portfolio analytics and/or benchmark relative attribution analysis
  • Basic knowledge of data query tools and SQL preferred
  • MBA, CFA charter holder or candidate, CIPM or CAIA designee, or candidate preferred
  • Experienced with tools like SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, FactSet, Charles River, BNY/Eagle, and others
  • Knowledge of cloud services & data modeling principles (nice-to-have)

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience specializing in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Accounting, and/or Management
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the financial industry
  • Prior experience in investment management and/or consulting within the industry (preferred)
  • Prior experience in Performance, Data or Trading investment operations (preferred)

Description de l'emploi

Meradia – Consultant(e)

Meradia est un partenaire de confiance du secteur de la gestion des investissements depuis 1997. Nous proposons des services de conseil stratégique et de mise en œuvre alliant expertise technique et engagement envers la réussite de nos clients. Notre mission est d'aider nos clients à relever des défis complexes, à optimiser leurs opérations et à atteindre leurs objectifs.

Nous recherchons des personnes ambitieuses et talentueuses, passionnées par l'obtention de résultats exceptionnels. Nos consultants collaborent avec des clients diversifiés pour créer des solutions efficaces. Le(la) candidat(e) idéal(e) est une personne proactive et autonome, dotée d'excellentes compétences en communication, d'un sens du détail et d'une expérience avérée dans le secteur financier.

Chez Meradia, nous accordons une grande importance à l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et nous investissons dans leur développement. Nous offrons une rémunération compétitive, des avantages sociaux complets et des opportunités de développement professionnel continu, notamment du mentorat et des événements du secteur. Si vous aspirez à une carrière enrichissante dans le domaine du conseil, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour rejoindre notre équipe!

EXIGENCES

  • Fournir des conseils et des informations stratégiques aux clients grâce au développement et à l'intégration de nouveaux systèmes et processus opérationnels
  • Effectuer des évaluations opérationnelles et technologiques approfondies pour identifier les inefficacités et recommander des solutions qui favorisent l'amélioration du service client, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la réduction des risques
  • Documenter les procédures opérationnelles existantes et définir de nouveaux processus basés sur l'analyse commerciale
  • Fournir aux clients des recherches et des informations relatives aux applications et technologies logicielles, au traitement des opérations, aux rapports et à la mesure de la performance des investissements
  • Élaborer et maintenir des plans de projet, des notes d'état d'avancement, des documents procéduraux et opérationnels
  • Encadrer et diriger les consultants juniors sur les projets assignés
  • Gérer des projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes impactant plusieurs départements, y compris la configuration d'outils tels que SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, FactSet, Charles River, BNY/Eagle et autres
  • Rester informé(e) des tendances du marché des capitaux et de la technologie pour proposer des solutions innovantes et des services à valeur ajoutée aux clients
  • Les consultants doivent être flexibles et avoir la volonté de diriger les efforts et d'aborder les problèmes en tant qu'analyste commercial(e) (tests, requêtes SQL) et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux, compte tenu des besoins du client.
  • Capacité à voyager – vous passerez probablement beaucoup de temps sur place avec nos clients. Ces déplacements peuvent représenter jusqu'à 50 % ou 100 % d'une semaine de travail, et peuvent être internationaux. De plus, vous devez posséder un permis de conduire valide, car de nombreux clients sont éloignés des transports en commun.

COMPÉTENCES ET APTITUDES

  • Réflexion stratégique : les transformations sont difficiles et le(la) candidat(e) idéal(e) aidera nos clients à les gérer avec succès
  • Expérience dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions technologiques dans le secteur des services d'investissement
  • Expérience de la gestion de projets de mise en œuvre et de développement de systèmes qui ont un impact sur plusieurs départements et redéfinissent les processus opérationnels
  • Expérience avérée dans l'analyse des processus d'affaires et le développement de solutions pratiques qui stimulent l'efficacité, améliorent le service client et réduisent les risques
  • Capacité à évaluer et à documenter les exigences commerciales, y compris les systèmes, les données, l'intégration, les flux de travail, les résultats, les rapports et l'impact économique/opérationnel de chacun
  • Compétences analytiques et de test de données avec des outils tels qu'Excel, PowerBI , Alteryx et/ou Tableau
  • Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle, verbale et écrite

CONNAISSANCES ET EXPÉRIENCE

  • Expertise fonctionnelle, technique et opérationnelle du secteur de la gestion des investissements
  • Connaissance fondamentale des opérations de front, middle et back-office dans des organisations de gestion des investissements, avec une compréhension des rapports des clients institutionnels
  • Connaissance d'une large gamme de produits de gestion de placements, notamment les actions américaines et mondiales, les produits à revenu fixe et dérivés, le crédit privé, les fonds spéculatifs et l'immobilier commercial
  • Compréhension des plateformes de comptabilité de portefeuille multidevises et d'administration de fonds
  • Expérience dans les opérations de back et middle-office, idéalement en mesure de performance, en analyse de portefeuille et/ou en analyse d'attribution relative de référence
  • Connaissances de base des outils de requête de données et de SQL préférées
  • Titulaire ou candidat(e) à la charte MBA, CFA, désigné CIPM ou CAIA, ou candidat(e) préféré(e)
  • Expérience avec des outils tels que SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, FactSet, Charles River, BNY/Eagle et autres
  • Connaissance des services en nuage et des principes de modélisation des données (un atout)

ÉDUCATION

  • Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente spécialisée en informatique, systèmes d'information, ingénierie, économie, finance, comptabilité et/ou gestion
  • 5+ années d'expérience pertinente dans le secteur financier
  • Expérience préalable en gestion des investissements et/ou en conseil au sein du secteur (préférable)
  • Expérience préalable dans les opérations d'investissement en performance, en données ou en négociation (préférable)

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the role

GradGuard’s Technology team works hard, moves fast, and has each other’s backs. As we step into an exciting new phase of growth, we’re looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer that’s ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and build something meaningful. You'll spend most of your time in PHP/Laravel services built on event-sourced, event-driven patterns, working within financial workflows where data consistency and security aren't optional, including integrations with payment processing platforms like Stripe. You'll also build and consume both REST and GraphQL APIs, and bring it all to life on the frontend with Vue 3, Nuxt, and TypeScript.


The ideal candidate for this role is a proactive, inventive professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is committed to building high quality, efficient, scalable, and impactful software solutions. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, excellent teamwork, desire to collaborate, and the ability to effectively communicate complex insights to stakeholders at all levels.


This is position is remote and open to candidates in most U.S. states, with the exception of: California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington, and Washington, D.C.


What you'll do

  • Architect, implement, and support PHP/Laravel backend services, prioritizing data consistency, security and performance within event-sourced financial frameworks.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (including product and design) to develop sites from scratch or enhance existing websites and software to meet business requirements.
  • Develop, implement, and support features with quality and performance utilizing PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Write automated unit, functional, and end-to-end tests to support both feature development and bug fixes.
  • Provide code recommendations and design optimizations to improve the usability, scalability, and performance of the applications, and drive adoption.
  • Assist in sharing, servicing, and mentoring our existing web engineering team.
  • Deeply understand technical details of owned features and their interactions with other systems.

Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of software engineering industry experience.
  • Advanced experience with PHP MVC frameworks, preferably Laravel.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture, including asynchronous, queue-driven processing (e.g., Laravel Jobs/Queues or equivalent).
  • Experience with event-sourcing architecture and libraries.
  • Experience working with modern front-end technologies, like Vue3, Nuxt, TypeScript and Tailwind.
  • Experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience collaborating and working with cross-functional teams (including product and design).
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming design patterns.
  • Advanced experience with relational or non-relational databases, such as MySQL, and MongoDB.
  • Experience in building and consuming both REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience integrating with payment processing APIs, such as Stripe.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience with JavaScript build tools, such as Vite.
  • Ability to create, support, and enhance front-end component libraries.
  • Enjoy making the team better via mentorship and experience.

About the role: The Senior Packaging Engineer plays an integral role in driving sustainable growth across Mars Snacking. In this position, you will lead end-to-end technical packaging projects - engineering innovative materials, structures, and production processes that balance brand performance, quality, and environmental sustainability.

What you’ll do:

  • Pioneer Sustainable Packaging & Circularity: Accelerate the transition towards circular packaging by qualifying sustainable substrates (e.g., recyclable barrier films, paper-based transitions, PCR content) whilst safeguarding product shelf-life and quality.
  • Plant Scale-Up & Line Runnability: Design and lead on-site factory trials in Ballarat to validate material-machine interactions, optimise machine running parameters, and troubleshoot line challenges alongside manufacturing teams.
  • Stage-Gate Project Leadership: Manage development workstreams with disciplined stage-gate governance to ensure on-time delivery across new product launches, brand renovations, and supply security.
  • Value Leadership & Cost Optimisation: Partner with Commercial, Supply, and packaging suppliers to identify efficiency opportunities across material specifications, lightweighting, and cost structures.
  • Technical Governance & Compliance: Lead technical review and formal sign-off for packaging specifications, artwork, and testing protocols (barrier, transit, shelf-life) in line with food safety and industry standards.
  • Capability Building & Mentorship: Drive continuous improvement in packaging processes, support global harmonisation programmes, provide informal technical guidance and coaching to junior team members, and role-model the company's Five Principles and culture.

What will you bring?

  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Materials Science, Food Science, Mechanical/Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline (formal packaging technology qualifications highly regarded).
  • End-to-End Packaging Development: 5+ years of experience taking consumer and customer packaging from concept through to full commercialisation.
  • Food & FMCG Manufacturing Exposure: Practical experience with packaging materials and automated high-speed packaging equipment used within the food industry.
  • Technical Project Management: Proven track record leading technical projects across quality, efficiency, and growth initiatives with experience in designing, running, and troubleshooting pilot and plant-scale trials in a manufacturing environment.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence: Demonstrated ability to engage, collaborate with, and influence a diverse group of internal and external partners.

Why you’ll love working for Mars:

title: Senior Product Manager (PST, Remote)
description:
About EllieMD

EllieMD is on a mission to revolutionize healthcare by empowering individuals with pharmaceutical-grade products and a network of dedicated Brand Partners. We believe healthcare should be accessible, transparent, and built on trust.

Inspired by the wisdom, strength, and nurturing nature of elephants, our name reflects our commitment to care, integrity, and empowerment. We are dedicated to ensuring that our customers, partners, and community feel supported, valued, and protected.

As a member of our team, you will help bring this mission to life by upholding our values of accountability, collaboration, excellence, integrity, and care. We are looking for individuals who take pride in delivering high-quality experiences and thrive in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Position Overview

EllieMD is seeking a rigorous, execution-oriented, Senior Product Manager or Director, on the West Coast, to help build and ship products that drive the evolution of our healthcare platform.

This is a high-impact, highly collaborative role for someone who can translate strategic vision into clear product requirements, user outcomes, and shipped solutions. The ideal candidate is comfortable working closely with executive leadership, especially the CEO, while partnering across Design, Engineering, Data, Operations, Compliance, Customer Support, and Brand Partner teams.

We are looking for someone with strong product fundamentals, excellent judgment, and a bias toward action. You should be able to deeply understand customer and Brand Partner needs, identify the highest-value product opportunities, prioritize effectively, and drive cross-functional teams toward measurable outcomes.

This role is well-suited for a product leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly without sacrificing quality, and understands that great products must work across the full customer journey. You will own products from concept through launch and beyond, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, driving toward clear success metrics, and continuously iterating based on user feedback, business needs, and data.

What You'll Do

  • Partner directly with the leadership team, including the CEO, to translate strategic vision into products that customers and Brand Partners love.
  • Deeply understand and represent the voice of EllieMD’s customers and Brand Partners in everything you build.
  • Translate customer, Brand Partner, operational, and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user outcomes, and shipped solutions.
  • Define success metrics, prioritize product problems, and ship solutions that achieve measurable business goals.
  • Own and drive one or more products from concept through launch and beyond, maintaining accountability for outcomes and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Operations, Compliance, Customer Support, and Brand Partner teams to learn quickly, iterate rapidly, and ship high-quality products.
  • Build and maintain product backlogs that balance quick wins with long-term strategic initiatives.
  • Drive progress against milestones, resolve blockers, and maintain healthy team execution.
  • Gather and analyze user research, product insights, customer feedback, Brand Partner input, business data, and market analysis to inform product decisions and prioritization.
  • Create structured product documentation, including PRDs, user stories, technical specifications, workflows, launch plans, and post-launch success criteria.
  • Coordinate effectively across functions to ship products that work seamlessly across the customer journey.
  • Communicate clearly about what you are building, why it matters, progress updates, risks, tradeoffs, and key learnings.
  • Evaluate the trade-offs among customer experience, business impact, technical feasibility, operational readiness, compliance, scalability, and speed of execution.
  • Identify gaps and interdependencies across systems and proactively ship solutions that improve organizational efficiency.
  • Facilitate brainstorming, prioritization, and strategy sessions, distilling complexity into products that solve real problems.

What You'll Do: 30-60-90 Day Plan

First 30 Days: Learn, Align, and Build Context

  • Develop a deep understanding of EllieMD’s mission, business model, customers, Brand Partner network, product ecosystem, operating rhythms, and strategic priorities.
  • Build strong working relationships with the CEO, leadership team, and key cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Compliance, Customer Support, and Brand Partner teams.
  • Review existing product roadmaps, documentation, customer journeys, analytics, support feedback, operational workflows, and current product priorities.
  • Identify the most important customer, Brand Partner, and business problems that the product team needs to solve.
  • Assess current product processes, backlog structure, communication cadences, success metrics, and launch practices.
  • Begin developing a clear point of view on immediate product opportunities, execution gaps, risks, and areas needing stronger alignment.

First 60 Days: Prioritize, Structure, and Drive Execution

  • Translate strategic priorities into clear product initiatives, requirements, milestones, and measurable success metrics.
  • Build or refine product documentation, including PRDs, user stories, product briefs, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, and launch readiness plans.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to prioritize high-impact product work and ensure teams are aligned on goals, scope, tradeoffs, and timelines.
  • Drive execution against one or more priority product initiatives, helping remove blockers and maintain momentum.
  • Establish clear communication routines for product updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and key learnings.
  • Use customer feedback, Brand Partner insights, operational input, and data to validate priorities and inform product decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for quick wins that improve the customer experience, Brand Partner experience, internal efficiency, or business outcomes.

First 90 Days: Ship, Measure, and Scale

  • Launch or materially advance priority product initiatives that deliver measurable value to customers, Brand Partners, or internal teams.
  • Measure product performance against defined success metrics and synthesize learnings from data, user feedback, stakeholder input, and operational results.
  • Iterate on shipped products based on real-world usage, customer needs, Brand Partner feedback, and business priorities.
  • Strengthen product operating practices across documentation, prioritization, roadmap planning, stakeholder alignment, and post-launch measurement.
  • Develop a clear product roadmap recommendation for the next phase of growth, balancing quick wins, strategic initiatives, technical needs, and operational priorities.
  • Proactively identify larger system gaps, dependencies, and product opportunities that can improve EllieMD’s ability to scale.
  • Demonstrate ownership, judgment, and execution leadership by driving products from ambiguity to clarity, alignment, launch, and measurable impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven ability to build and scale products from early stages.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Ability to work in person when needed with the CEO.
  • Strong product fundamentals, including customer discovery, problem definition, prioritization, requirements writing, roadmap planning, execution management, launch planning, and post-launch iteration.
  • Proven ability to translate strategic vision into products that customers use and love.
  • Strong track record of balancing user experience, business impact, technical feasibility, operational complexity, and scalability.
  • Data-driven approach, with experience digging into data, defining clear goals, and driving teams to ship products that deliver measurable impact.
  • Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Customer Support, Go-to-Market, and executive stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and influencing without direct authority.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Job Title: Assistant Controller
Job Category: Full-Time or Part-Time Employee
Headquarter Location: Missoula, MT
Work Location: In-office, Hybrid or Remote
Salary: Competitive, based on experience


About TOMIS

TOMIS is a digital marketing agency and software company built for the tours and activities industry — we help operators like whitewater outfitters, ski resorts, and adventure companies grow. Our software brand, Yonder, serves operators across North America, Australia, and New Zealand. Based in downtown Missoula, Montana, with team members across the U.S. and internationally, we’re a small, fast-moving team of nearly 50 that values ownership, curiosity, and getting things right the first time.


About the Role

We’re hiring an Assistant Controller to own our books end-to-end. You’ll run the monthly close in QuickBooks Online, keep revenue tied out to Stripe, reconcile across our U.S. and international entities, and produce the financials our leadership team, board, and investors rely on. You’ll work directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff and with our outside CPA firm.

This is a hands-on role. Our books have grown faster than the process around them, and your job is to make them clean, current, and defensible — first by untangling what’s there, then by building the controls and routines that keep it that way. You’ll be the person who can look at a balance that doesn’t make sense, trace it back through the bank feed, the Stripe sync, and the journal entries, and fix both the entry and the reason it happened.

This is a great fit for someone who has owned a close before and wants real, unsupervised ownership of a growing company’s finances — without the layers of a large corporate accounting department.


What You’ll Do

Monthly Close & Books

  • Own the monthly close in QuickBooks Online — bank and credit card reconciliations through a finalized balance sheet and P&L — within the first 10 business days of the following month
  • Own QuickBooks bank rules and bank-feed hygiene: audit existing rules, fix ones that mispost or split transactions, and keep new activity landing in the right accounts and classes
  • Maintain a clean chart of accounts — catch and correct duplicate accounts, mis-postings, and misclassified liabilities
  • Maintain department/class-based revenue and expense allocations across business lines and entities, including monthly allocation entries
  • Maintain accrual-basis financials alongside QuickBooks, including deferred revenue, prepaids, and accrued liabilities, so management reporting reconciles to the books
  • Record and document complex or one-off transactions — capital contributions, intercompany loans, financing notes, and acquisition-related entries — and tie debt and equity balances out to the underlying agreements and cap table
  • Clean up and reclassify historical balance sheet detail, working with our outside CPA on prior-year adjustments and tax preparation support
  • Manage vendor records in QuickBooks (setup, de-duplication, classification)


Revenue & Multi-Entity Reconciliation

  • Reconcile Stripe revenue (synced via Synder) to QuickBooks each month across multiple Stripe accounts, including failed payments, refunds, credit memos, and payout timing, and keep suspense and undeposited-funds accounts cycling to zero
  • Reconcile intercompany activity between TOMIS (QuickBooks) and Yonder (Xero), including charges that land in the wrong entity, and maintain the intercompany loan balance
  • Support multi-currency activity across our U.S., Australian, and New Zealand books
  • Investigate and correct general ledger posting errors surfaced during internal review, and put fixes in place so the same error doesn’t recur


Employee Benefits & Payroll Reconciliation

  • Reconcile 401(k) contributions (employee, employer, and Roth) against payroll each pay period and support the annual retirement plan audit
  • Reconcile HSA and health/dental contributions; catch and correct benefit invoices that overstate expense
  • Reconcile payroll tax liability accounts against what’s actually been filed
  • Run payroll each pay period in partnership with the Chief of Staff


Financial Reporting & Investor/Board Support

  • Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheet, cash reporting, and AR/AP aging
  • Produce year-to-date financials for board and investor review on a monthly cadence, and keep our reporting dashboards (currently Fathom) current
  • Respond to investor due-diligence requests and recurring quarterly financial-data asks
  • Support reporting and covenant requirements tied to our venture debt and investor relationships
  • Pull together supporting financial documentation for grant applications and similar one-off requests


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of accounting experience, including at least a year owning a monthly close end to end without a review layer above you
  • Deep QuickBooks Online proficiency — chart of accounts, classes, bank rules, journal entries, and the bank feed — to the point where you can diagnose why a balance is wrong, not just that it is
  • Solid accrual accounting fundamentals: revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accrued liabilities, and the difference between cash-basis books and accrual-basis reporting
  • Comfortable reconciling many bank, credit card, and payment-processor accounts and running discrepancies to ground
  • Proactive about flagging things that look off, and comfortable working independently on a small, hybrid team — you’ll often be the only accountant in the room
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
  • High attention to detail and follow-through — this role is judged on accuracy

Nice to have

  • Experience with a subscription/SaaS or services-based revenue model
  • Experience reconciling Stripe or a similar payment platform, ideally with a sync tool like Synder
  • Multi-entity or multi-currency experience; exposure to Xero
  • Time at a CPA firm or under a Controller
  • Familiarity with financial reporting tools like Fathom or similar
  • Prior exposure to 401(k)/HSA benefits administration
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, or CPA track — not required if your experience shows you can do the job


Physical Working Conditions:

The following physical requirements represent those that are required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Sitting – [90%]
  • Standing – [5%]
  • Walking – [5%]
  • Bending – [Occasionally]
  • Kneeling – [Some]
  • Lifting – [Up to 25 pounds]
  • Reaching – [Regularly]
  • Telephone Use – [Yes]
  • Computer Use/Manual Dexterity – Yes
  • Ability to travel – [10%]


Position Highlights:

This is an extremely exciting time to join the TOMIS team as there is an exceptional degree of growth potential. This position does require time spent regularly working in our office, but we’re flexible about also allowing remote work. We’re hiring extremely motivated people who want to build the best possible product, and who don’t need constant oversight or a rigid schedule. If you join our team and share our goals, we’ll respect your time and let you do great work because you want to, not because we told you to.


  • Company has established true product-market-fit in an untapped industry with high-growth potential
  • Office located in the heart of downtown Missoula
  • Professional development opportunities and career growth within TOMIS
  • The job is “seriously fun, even when it’s stressful, which I can’t say about previous companies I’ve worked for.”


Benefits:

The Assistant Controller position offers practical work experience and an opportunity to work for a Montana-based startup with exponential room for growth. This position will involve challenging opportunities, real-world projects, and regular interaction with stakeholders.


  • Competitive salary, unlimited PTO, and opportunities for growth
  • Company health insurance & dental/vision plans
  • Matching 401K Plan
  • Amazing outdoor industry discounts
  • Monthly wellness stipends, professional development stipends, & paid client visits
  • Powder day ski policy
  • Downtown Missoula office
  • Remote-friendly, hybrid workplace option
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Culture: collaborative environment, continuous learning opportunities, community involvement, networking opportunities, work hard play hard, conference travels, team holiday & spontaneous functions

title: Investment Associate - Distressed Debt & Special Situations
description:
About Oak Hill Advisors

Oak Hill Advisors, L.P., including its affiliated investment advisors (the “Firm” or “OHA”), is a leading global credit-focused alternative asset manager with over 30 years of investment experience. OHA works with institutions and individuals and seeks to deliver a consistent track record of attractive risk-adjusted returns. The Firm has approximately $112 billion in assets under management (AUM) across credit strategies, including private credit, high yield bonds, leveraged loans, stressed and distressed debt and collateralized loan obligations as of June 30, 2026. With over 400 experienced professionals across seven global offices, OHA brings a collaborative approach to offering investors a single platform to meet their diverse credit needs. OHA is the private markets platform of T. Rowe Price Group, Inc. (NASDAQ – GS: TROW). For further information about OHA, please visit

Overview

Oak Hill Advisors is seeking an experienced distressed investor to join its Distressed Debt and Special Situations team in New York. The team, comprised of five dedicated investment professionals, manages approximately $7-8 billion of capital dedicated to stressed, distressed and special situations investing across industries and geographies. The position will work extensively with portfolio management, trading and the Firm's sector-focused research analyst staff.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in fundamental valuation as well as a deep understanding of the structural and process-related considerations associated with distressed investing, including liability management transactions, in-court and out-of-court restructurings, and creditor organization dynamics. The candidate should be able to shepherd an investment through its entire life cycle, from idea generation through underwriting, execution and ultimately monetization, while operating with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Engage actively in markets and the distressed community to source and generate differentiated investment ideas.
  • Underwrite investment opportunities through comprehensive industry, company and capital structure-specific due diligence.
  • Build and oversee complex financial analyses, including operating forecasts, liquidity analyses, recovery and waterfall analyses, and restructuring scenarios.
  • Evaluate capital structures and assess relative value opportunities across debt and equity securities, including identification of fulcrum securities and creditor-on-creditor risk.
  • Analyze legal documentation, including credit agreements, indentures and intercreditor agreements, to assess structural protections, documentation vulnerabilities and liability management risk.
  • Conduct scenario analysis and rigorous stress-testing of investment theses.
  • Prepare and present investment memoranda and recommendations to the internal investment committee.
  • Participate in creditor committees, steering committees and ad hoc groups in potential and ongoing restructurings, including involvement in negotiations and restructuring processes.
  • Work closely with legal advisors, financial advisors, restructuring professionals and other external stakeholders involved in distressed situations.
  • Monitor existing portfolio investments and identify changes in credit fundamentals, liquidity position, valuation or restructuring outcomes.
  • Assist in the development and training of junior investment professionals, where appropriate.
  • Participate in client meetings and discussions regarding the market environment and particular investments, as appropriate.
  • In-Office Requirement: Employees are required to follow the in-office work schedule. Currently, OHA's US Credit team in New York follows a hybrid model where employees work in-office Monday through Thursday. Employees have the flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. This schedule is subject to change based on organizational needs and policies.
  • Must be available to work after hours, when necessary, which could include nights and/or weekends.
  • Contribute to additional projects and initiatives supporting the Distressed Debt and Special Situations platform

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree from a top-tier program preferred; Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record required.
  • 2-5 years of investment experience in distressed investing, special situations, restructuring advisory, leveraged finance, private credit or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience underwriting, evaluating and executing distressed or special situations investments, financings or restructuring transactions.
  • Established relationships within the distressed investing and restructuring community, including exposure to financial advisors, restructuring counsel and other market participants.
  • Deep understanding of corporate finance, capital structures, bankruptcy processes, liability management transactions and creditor rights.
  • Strong financial modeling, valuation and credit underwriting skills.
  • Outstanding analytical judgment and investment acumen, with the ability to distill complex situations into clear investment theses and recommendations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a good blend of confidence and humility.
  • Self-starter with excellent work ethic, attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and competing deadlines.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced team environment and collaborate with a broad variety of constituents, both internal and external.

Compensation

The expected base salary for this position is based on a wide range of factors, including the individual’s experience and skills for the role and market considerations. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Employees may be eligible for an annual discretionary performance-based bonus, which is determined based on firm and individual performance.

title: Senior TPRM Analyst
description:
EVOCS OVERVIEW

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

As an IT consulting firm, we work with our clients to understand their needs, identify the right technologies, and deliver solutions that improve performance and support their business objectives.

Today, EVOCS is a trusted technology partner to a growing number of organizations and industry leaders. Our team combines technical expertise, business understanding, and a commitment to quality to deliver effective solutions and build lasting client relationships based on responsiveness, consistency, and results.

Senior TPRM Analyst

🎯 Role Overview
As a Senior TPRM Analyst, you are the experienced hand on the third-party risk team. You own the complex vendor reviews — the cloud providers, MSPs, and critical technology vendors where a shallow assessment creates real exposure — and you are the person escalations land on when a finding is contested or a risk needs to be accepted at the leadership level.

You are also the one who writes what goes up. Executive-ready risk summaries, escalation memos, and risk acceptance recommendations come from you, and they need to be right the first time. This is a senior individual contributor role: depth of judgment, not headcount, is what makes you effective here.

We are hiring two Senior TPRM Analysts.

🧩 What You Will Do

Vendor Risk Assessment and Due Diligence
- Own end-to-end risk assessments for the highest-criticality third parties, including cloud service providers, managed service providers, and critical technology vendors
- Read SOC 2 Type II reports and ISO 27001 certificates for what they actually say — scope carve-outs, excluded systems, qualified opinions, exceptions in the testing results, and complementary user entity controls — rather than confirming that a document exists
- Evaluate control evidence, penetration test summaries, remediation plans, and security questionnaire responses, and challenge answers that do not hold up
- Set inherent and residual risk ratings, define compensating controls, and track remediation commitments to closure
- Assess vendor security posture in context: data classification, access model, integration depth, and business criticality

Fourth-Party and Supply Chain Analysis
- Map fourth-party and subcontractor dependencies behind critical vendors, including where the work is actually performed
- Analyze vendor concentration risk and identify single points of failure across the third-party portfolio
- Assess geopolitical and jurisdictional exposure, including offshore delivery locations, data residency, and sub-processor chains
- Incorporate security ratings and continuous monitoring signals into ongoing vendor risk views, and separate real signal from noise

Escalation, Reporting, and Governance
- Serve as the escalation point for contested findings, vendor pushback, and time-pressured reviews tied to contract or go-live deadlines
- Write executive-ready risk summaries that state the risk, the business impact, and the recommendation in language leadership can act on
- Run risk acceptance conversations with senior business, technology, and procurement stakeholders — documenting the decision, the owner, and the expiration
- Present third-party risk posture, trends, and exceptions to governance forums and senior leadership
- Support and improve the TPRM program itself: assessment standards, tiering criteria, evidence requirements, and playbooks that raise the floor for the whole team
- Mentor junior analysts on evidence review, write-up quality, and stakeholder handling

🧠 What You Will Bring
The top candidate will have the following qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, risk, audit, or compliance
- At least 5 of those years in third-party risk management or vendor risk specifically
- Demonstrated experience assessing cloud providers, MSPs, and critical technology vendors — not only routine or low-criticality suppliers
- Fluency reading SOC 2 reports and ISO 27001 certifications, including the ability to identify scope carve-outs, qualified opinions, and control exceptions
- Fourth-party and supply chain risk analysis: vendor concentration, criticality tiering, geopolitical exposure, and subcontractor dependencies
- Proven ability to write executive-ready risk summaries for senior audiences
- Experience leading escalation and risk acceptance conversations with senior stakeholders, including holding a position under pressure
- Working knowledge of common control frameworks — NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001/27002, CIS — and how they map to vendor assessments
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills — this role involves frequent interaction with vendors and internal stakeholders via email, calls, and meetings


Key Skills and Competencies
- Third-party and vendor risk assessment
- Audit report and control evidence analysis
- Fourth-party and supply chain risk
- Executive risk communication and reporting
- Risk acceptance and exception governance
- Stakeholder management and escalation handling

Ideally you have…
- Certifications that matter here: CTPRP or CTPRA especially, along with CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor
- Hands-on platform experience with ProcessUnity, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer
- Working experience with security ratings tools such as SecurityScorecard, BitSight, RiskRecon, or Black Kite
- Exposure to regulated environments and the vendor oversight expectations that come with them
- Experience contributing to TPRM program design, not only executing assessments

title: Director, Engineering & Development
description:
About SH/FT

SH/FT is a client services business that focuses on implementing and activating technology and data to make sales and marketing work. Our people bring combined experience across technology, data and analytics, business strategy, and campaign operations to accelerate our clients’ businesses. We keep pace with change in modern marketing and technology in order to create effective, scalable, and future-proof solutions for clients that span both the Fortune 500 and emerging industry leaders. We have also built strong relationships with the world’s most influential martech platforms and are key partners to them and their clients.

The Role

As Director of Engineering and Development, you’ll lead SH/FT’s engineering practice across platform engineering, web and web application development, and custom software development. You’ll own the people, the craft, and the output of the engineering team — setting technical standards, building capacity, and ensuring delivery quality across client engagements. This role also involves participating in pre-sale scoping, representing SH/FT’s engineering capabilities in client-facing settings, and contributing a clear point of view on how AI is reshaping software development.

What You’ll Accomplish

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead and develop a team of front-end engineers, back-end engineers, architects, and solutions engineers
  • Set and uphold technical standards, code quality practices, and engineering culture across the team
  • Build team capacity and capability intentionally, identifying skill gaps and creating development pathways that keep the team ahead of client needs
  • Create structure and process where it is needed, without over-engineering the way the team works
  • Foster an environment where engineers can do their best work, ask hard questions, and grow professionally

AI-Native Practice Leadership

  • Bring a clear, informed point of view on how AI is changing software development, delivery workflows, and what it means for how a professional services engineering team should be structured and operate
  • Champion the integration of AI-assisted development tools, code generation, testing automation, and other AI-enabled workflows across the engineering team
  • Help SH/FT and its clients think through the implications of AI on custom development timelines, cost structures, and build-versus-buy decisions
  • Stay current on the AI development landscape and translate that into practical guidance for both the team and client stakeholders

Client Delivery and Technical Oversight

  • Own the quality and integrity of engineering output across client engagements, from architecture decisions through to deployment
  • Partner with project and delivery leadership to ensure engineering work is scoped correctly, resourced appropriately, and delivered on time
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and escalation support on complex or high-risk deliverables
  • Maintain visibility across active engagements to identify risk early and keep delivery on track

Pre-Sale Scoping and Client Engagement

  • Participate in pre-sale conversations to assess custom development requirements, translate business needs into technical scope, and develop accurate level-of-effort estimates
  • Show up with confidence and credibility in client-facing settings, including discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and executive presentations
  • Help clients understand the trade-offs between custom development and platform-native capabilities, including total cost of ownership, timeline, and long-term maintainability
  • Contribute to RFP and RFI responses, ensuring technical accuracy and a clear articulation of SH/FT’s engineering approach and differentiators

Practice Development

  • Identify opportunities to build reusable frameworks, accelerators, and engineering assets that improve delivery speed and consistency across engagements
  • Partner with the VP of Technology Services and other practice leads to shape how SH/FT positions and grows its engineering and development capabilities

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 8 or more years in software engineering or development roles, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment

title: Unarmed Security Officer
description:
As a Security Officer, you will observe and report activities and incidents at an assigned client site, providing for the safety of client property and personnel; while making periodic tours to check for irregularities and to inspect protection devices and fire control equipment.

Additional responsibilities for this Officer include:

• Controlling access to client site or facility through the admittance process; assisting visitors with a legitimate need to gain entry to the facility; screening visitors and client employees in an efficient manner in order to expedite their admittance to the site or facility.

• Providing an atmosphere in which all client employees and visitors know that the client responds to and cares about their needs; providing a courteous, respectful and pleasant interaction with each client employee and visitor as perceived from their point of view; presenting a good image of the client.

• Communicating in a manner that is open, honest and responsive in all situations; to the extent authorized, provides information regarding the site and surrounding area as requested by visitors.

• Monitoring entrances and exits; acting to prevent unapproved or unlawful entry; loss prevention, controlling entrances, the movement of people and vehicles, and parking; operating a gate and examining vehicle contents.

• Monitoring remote entrances using closed circuit television; operating remote access devices; in a calm manner directs persons who cause a disturbance to leave the property.

• Patrolling assigned site on foot or in vehicle; checking for unsafe conditions, hazards, unlocked doors, violations, blocked ingress and egress, mechanical problems, and unauthorized persons; inspecting buildings and grounds using appropriate equipment and protective gear.

• Protecting evidence or scene of incident in the event of accidents, emergencies, or investigations; setting up barriers and signage, and providing direction or information to others.

• Preparing logs or reports as required for site; writing and/or typing reports and/or entering information in a computer using standard grammar; inspecting control logs and taking action as required.

• Observing and reporting incidents or suspicious activity to client representatives, company management, life/safety personnel or public safety authorities as appropriate for the circumstances and/or as required by the site.

• Responding to incidents of fire, medical emergency, bomb threat, flooding, water discharge, elevator emergency, hazardous materials, inclement weather, and other incidents or conditions following procedures established for the site, by the company, and/or through training or certification.

• Acting to ensure that all property removal is conducted within appropriate policy requirements and in accord with client standards; identifying client products or materials among items carried by client employees or visitors.

title: Lucrător Comercial
description:
De ce să lucrezi cu noi?

Oamenii sunt în centrul a tot ce facem, așa că este esențial să-ți oferim un mediu potrivit pentru a da tot ce ai mai bun. Pachetul de beneficii este atent conceput pentru tine:

  • O echipă unită și mereu alături de tine. Vei primi sprijin și încurajare încă din prima zi – și vei simți un spirit de echipă unic.
  • Diversitatea ne unește. Toată lumea este binevenită. Echipele noastre sunt formate din persoane de toate vârstele și originile, cu talente și personalități diferite.
  • La noi fiecare zi este diferită – și exact aceasta este partea frumoasă! La Primark nu te vei plictisi niciodata pentru că magazinele noastre sunt pline de viață, iar fiecare zi aduce ceva nou.
  • Un loc de muncă stabil Oamenii noștri sunt mereu orientați către viitor, iar aici, asta înseamnă o carieră stabilă, pe termen lung. Oriunde te alături echipei noastre, ai libertatea să-ți construiești drumul profesional așa cum îți dorești.
  • Oportunități reale de dezvoltare Prin programul nostru “Grow With Us" dedicat colegilor din rolul de Retail Assistant, poți să îți descoperi potențialul și să faci primii pași către un rol de management. Mulți dintre managerii noștri au început astfel!
  • Proiecte speciale – programul “Bolster” Ai oportunitatea de a călători și de a participa la deschiderile de noi magazine Primark, unde poți să împărtășești experiența ta cu noii colegi din Europa Centrală și de Est (Polonia, Cehia, Slovacia, România, Ungaria, Slovenia).
  • Sprijin pentru sănătate și bunăstare Prin programul “Let’s Talk” – poți beneficia gratuit de consiliere psihologica juridică și financiară atât pentru tine cât și pentru familia ta.
  • Reducere pentru angajați Beneficiezi de o reducere de 15% disponibilă în toate magazinele Primark din România
  • Mediu de lucru prietenos Fiecare magazin Primark este conceput cu vestiare și băi proprii, dar și cu o zonă de relaxare dotată cu automate pentru gustări și cafea.
  • Indemnizație de transport Pentru că starea ta de bine este importantă, indiferent că vii la servici cu mijlocul de transport in comun, cu masina personala sau iti place sa mergi pe jos, lunar beneficiezi de o indemnizatie de transport.
  • Tichete de masă Lunar vei primi tichete de masă în valoare de 35 lei pe zi.

Rolul este potrivit pentru că îți place să:

  • Oferi servicii excelente clienților în magazin, la casele de marcat și în cabinele de probă , de asemenea să aduci un zâmbet pe fețele oamenilor.
  • Creezi experiențe plăcute de cumpărături prin a le oferi clienților ajutor cu mărimile sau informații despre produse.
  • Te ocupi de recepționarea livrărilor, aranjarea produselor și menținerea unui aspect atrăgător al magazinului.
  • Sprijini echipa de management în procesul de comandare a produselor și contribui pe suprafața de vânzare la ceea ce videm.

Pentru că ești unic(ă)

Celebrăm diversitatea și știm că fiecare persoană aduce stilul și personalitatea sa unică în magazinele noastre. La Primark nu există un „model standard”.

Te potrivești perfect cu noi dacă:

  • Ești o persoană activă și îți place să lucrezi într-un mediu dinamic.
  • Ai o atitudine pozitivă și ești dornic(ă) să înveți lucruri noi.
  • Ești o persoană grijulie, care se simte bine lucrând în echipă.
  • Ești de încredere și atent(ă) la detalii.
  • Ai peste 18 ani și ești disponibil(ă) pentru lucru în ture și în weekend.


Fie că ai experiență în retail, fie că ești la început de drum – la noi ești binevenit(ă). Pentru noi contează atitudinea și implicarea ta.


APLICĂ ACUM

Nu mai aștepta – alătură-te nouă și găsește-ți locul la Primark! :)
Pentru că tu ai acel ceva special.

Moda și cultura noastră nu este una standardizatǎ. Promovăm oportunități egale de angajare și ne străduim să creăm un loc de muncă inclusiv unde oamenii pot fi ei înșiși, să aibă acces la oportunități și să prospere împreună.

  • Warm, professional communication style with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and families.
  • Fully compliant to work, including an Enhanced DBS (or willingness to obtain) and Right to Work in the UK.
  • Flexible and reliable, able to work live‑in rotational patterns and travel with clients when required.

Desirable

  • Competitive Pay: Rates reflective of the specialist skills and private nature of the work.

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to join a team that sits at the intersection of product development and consulting delivery.

We’re a bit different from a typical company. We build our own AI-powered products, while also working closely with clients to deliver real-world solutions. That means you’ll be exposed to a constant flow of ideas, challenges, and opportunities and you’ll help shape which ones actually turn into something real.


If you enjoy building fast, learning constantly, and working on things that don’t come with a predefined playbook, you’ll feel right at home.

🧩 What you will do

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and iterate on full stack applications across multiple projects
  • Contribute to both internal products and client-facing solutions, often at the same time
  • Work primarily with TypeScript (frontend & backend), Python, React, PostgreSQL, and Azure Cloud, while staying open to new tools when they make sense

  • Move quickly from idea → prototype → validation → iteration (or discard)
  • Collaborate closely with teammates across overlapping projects, sharing context and supporting each other
  • Take ownership of problems: spot them early, propose solutions, and drive them through

📚 How we think about building

  • Experimentation is part of the job: not everything will work and that’s the point
  • Fast iteration over perfection: we build, validate, and move on if something isn’t good enough
  • AI is a tool, not a crutch: we actively use AI in our products and workflows, but we’re fully accountable for what we ship. Humans validate the output

🧠 What you will bring

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated Staff-level scope and technical leadership
  • Strong experience building and shipping software across the stack
  • Comfort operating in environments where you won’t know everything upfront and a willingness to learn quickly
  • Ability to work independently while staying aligned with a collaborative team
  • Experience (or strong interest) in AI-driven products and systems
  • A pragmatic mindset: you balance speed with quality and know when to go deeper
  • Curiosity and flexibility to pick up new technologies as needed

👥 Our Values

We are privileged to serve our loyal customer base in our mission to build lasting relationships with our clients based on trust and mutual success. We strive to deliver exceptional quality and consistency through a white-glove approach. By empowering businesses with tailored solutions and insights, we help them achieve their goals and navigate the ever-evolving tech landscape.
